rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: What'll it be?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You enter a squalid shack on the fringe of the marketplace. The familiar smell of fish fills the air. Flies buzz haphazardly around a downcast man behind the counter.
rows.raw_text: You enter a squalid shack on the fringe of the marketplace. The familiar smell of fish fills the air. Flies buzz haphazardly around a downcast man behind the counter.

rows.text: You're the new fisherman, eh? Surprised they found a new one so fast.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: You're the new fisherman, eh? Surprised they found a new one so fast.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What happened to the other one?
rows.raw_text: What happened to the other one?

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: He...it takes a certain type of person to last out here. It's not a life for everyone.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: He...it takes a certain type of person to last out here. It's not a life for everyone.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's your name?
rows.raw_text: What's your name?

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: There's no sense getting familiar. You'll be on your way like the rest of them soon, no doubt.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: There's no sense getting familiar. You'll be on your way like the rest of them soon, no doubt.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Anyway, to business. I'll pay you for fish. [C1]Bigger and fresher means more money[/C1]. Some species are just worth more, too.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Anyway, to business. I'll pay you for fish. [C1]Bigger and fresher means more money[/C1]. Some species are just worth more, too.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Other towns on other islands might pay you different...but while you've still got a debt outstanding here, I'd suggest you work on paying it off first.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Other towns on other islands might pay you different...but while you've still got a debt outstanding here, I'd suggest you work on paying it off first.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: So, let's see what you've got.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: So, let's see what you've got.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: What've you got for me today?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: What've you got for me today?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The morning light fills your eyes, and you try to sit upright. You're lying on the cold, wet dock where you collapsed the night before.
rows.raw_text: The morning light fills your eyes, and you try to sit upright. You're lying on the cold, wet dock where you collapsed the night before.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Welcome to [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0]! I must say, quite the dramatic first impression - I see you've already introduced yourself to the [C2]jagged rocks[/C2] along the bay.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Welcome to [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0]! I must say, quite the dramatic first impression - I see you've already introduced yourself to the [C2]jagged rocks[/C2] along the bay.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Did you not see the lighthouse? It was shining right at you! Ah well, I'm glad to see our [C0]new fisherman[/C0] upright and breathing.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Did you not see the lighthouse? It was shining right at you! Ah well, I'm glad to see our [C0]new fisherman[/C0] upright and breathing.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: [C2]Your boat was hopelessly damaged[/C2], but I've had a few of the locals [C1]move your things to one of our old vessels[/C1]. We'll catch up later to discuss more details.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: [C2]Your boat was hopelessly damaged[/C2], but I've had a few of the locals [C1]move your things to one of our old vessels[/C1]. We'll catch up later to discuss more details.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Finally, I don't suppose I need to say this, but [C2]get back by sundown, before the fog rolls in[/C2]. Keep a close eye on the time. It can really creep up on you.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Finally, I don't suppose I need to say this, but [C2]get back by sundown, before the fog rolls in[/C2]. Keep a close eye on the time. It can really creep up on you.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: No fish? [C0]Get out there and catch something[/C0] for these hungry townsfolk.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: No fish? [C0]Get out there and catch something[/C0] for these hungry townsfolk.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You step onto the dock at Greater Marrow. The Mayor is waiting nearby.
rows.raw_text: You step onto the dock at Greater Marrow. The Mayor is waiting nearby.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Ah, I see you've returned in one piece. Very good. Before you head off to town, we should discuss the matter of [C0]your boat[/C0].
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Ah, I see you've returned in one piece. Very good. Before you head off to town, we should discuss the matter of [C0]your boat[/C0].

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: I understand you may not have the necessary funds on hand, so we'll consider it a [C2]loan[/C2]. But I want to make this easy for you.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: I understand you may not have the necessary funds on hand, so we'll consider it a [C2]loan[/C2]. But I want to make this easy for you.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: So, to recap, you'll need to sell fish to the local market, paying off your debt and, in turn, keeping the population fed and satisfied. Understand?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: So, to recap, you'll need to sell fish to the local market, paying off your debt and, in turn, keeping the population fed and satisfied. Understand?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Selling fish helps the town and pays off my debt. Got it.
rows.raw_text: Selling fish helps the town and pays off my debt. Got it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where do I sell the fish?
rows.raw_text: Where do I sell the fish?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Our local [C0]Fishmonger[/C0] will appraise and purchase what you catch. He's open all hours.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Our local [C0]Fishmonger[/C0] will appraise and purchase what you catch. He's open all hours.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Off you go then - sell those fish while they're still fresh!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Off you go then - sell those fish while they're still fresh!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Mayor is standing outside the Fishmonger's store.
rows.raw_text: The Mayor is standing outside the Fishmonger's store.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Excellent work, I have no doubt you'll be able to provide for this town.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Excellent work, I have no doubt you'll be able to provide for this town.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Oh, one last thing! Our local [C0]Shipwright[/C0] mentioned she might be able to make some [C1]modifications to your ship[/C1]. You should pay her a visit.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Oh, one last thing! Our local [C0]Shipwright[/C0] mentioned she might be able to make some [C1]modifications to your ship[/C1]. You should pay her a visit.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: As you walk into the yard, you see the [C0]Shipwright[/C0] making repairs to a damaged hull. She looks up at you briefly before turning back to her work.
rows.raw_text: As you walk into the yard, you see the [C0]Shipwright[/C0] making repairs to a damaged hull. She looks up at you briefly before turning back to her work.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: You must be the new fisherman. [C1]I can make improvements to your vessel[/C1] in the yard.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: You must be the new fisherman. [C1]I can make improvements to your vessel[/C1] in the yard.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Mind you, I'm not in the business of doing favors 'round here - payment is upfront. And [C2]everything takes some time to install[/C2].
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Mind you, I'm not in the business of doing favors 'round here - payment is upfront. And [C2]everything takes some time to install[/C2].

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Also, if you take on any [C2]damage[/C2] from the rocks or...any damage at all, [C1]I can patch it up[/C1]. Mostly.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Also, if you take on any [C2]damage[/C2] from the rocks or...any damage at all, [C1]I can patch it up[/C1]. Mostly.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She shrugs and gestures towards the hull she's currently attempting to repair. A number of wooden boards - all well above the water line - are splintered and scratched.
rows.raw_text: She shrugs and gestures towards the hull she's currently attempting to repair. A number of wooden boards - all well above the water line - are splintered and scratched.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Take a look 'round. Just remember - [C2]the bigger the equipment, the longer it takes to install[/C2]. So plan ahead.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Take a look 'round. Just remember - [C2]the bigger the equipment, the longer it takes to install[/C2]. So plan ahead.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Just the person I was hoping to see! Will you be sailing out [C0]East[/C0], towards [C0]Little Marrow[/C0]? Would you give this package to the [C0]Dockworker[/C0] there please?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Just the person I was hoping to see! Will you be sailing out [C0]East[/C0], towards [C0]Little Marrow[/C0]? Would you give this package to the [C0]Dockworker[/C0] there please?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Oh, sorry, all full up? [C0]Come back when you have more space[/C0] on board.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Oh, sorry, all full up? [C0]Come back when you have more space[/C0] on board.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Don't forget to check your [C0]Compass[/C0] and [C0]Map[/C0] if you get lost!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Don't forget to check your [C0]Compass[/C0] and [C0]Map[/C0] if you get lost!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Mayor hands you a small, damp package bound in string. It's dripping slightly.
rows.raw_text: The Mayor hands you a small, damp package bound in string. It's dripping slightly.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Hmm, what - a delivery? Let's see here...
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Hmm, what - a delivery? Let's see here...

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: I was given this old book a few weeks back, but it didn't make much sense to me. You'll surely get more use out of it.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: I was given this old book a few weeks back, but it didn't make much sense to me. You'll surely get more use out of it.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Keep it in your cabin, perhaps you can read it while you're on the water.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Keep it in your cabin, perhaps you can read it while you're on the water.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: What is it today?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: What is it today?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You hand the [C3]grotesque fish[/C3] to the Fishmonger. He grins, raising the fish up to his face before inhaling a deep, stuttering breath.
rows.raw_text: You hand the [C3]grotesque fish[/C3] to the Fishmonger. He grins, raising the fish up to his face before inhaling a deep, stuttering breath.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Ahh...now, this is the sort of specimen to liven up my day. Hmm, I wonder...
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Ahh...now, this is the sort of specimen to liven up my day. Hmm, I wonder...

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: It's not the first corrupted fish I've seen in these parts, so I'm sure you'll find more before too long. [C1]I'll pay you well if you find any more[/C1].
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: It's not the first corrupted fish I've seen in these parts, so I'm sure you'll find more before too long. [C1]I'll pay you well if you find any more[/C1].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: So, will you allow me to fit your vessel with dredging equipment? I'll need a few hours.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: So, will you allow me to fit your vessel with dredging equipment? I'll need a few hours.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: An excellent decision. I'll prepare the equipment immediately.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: An excellent decision. I'll prepare the equipment immediately.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: I would encourage you to [C0]ask around the towns about shipwrecks or other strange occurrences[/C0] - anything that might be worth investigating.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: I would encourage you to [C0]ask around the towns about shipwrecks or other strange occurrences[/C0] - anything that might be worth investigating.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Hmm. Return when you change your mind.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Hmm. Return when you change your mind.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You enter a brightly lit shop. It's packed with antiques, the shelves full of jewellery and other baubles. An old man peers at you over silver spectacles.
rows.raw_text: You enter a brightly lit shop. It's packed with antiques, the shelves full of jewellery and other baubles. An old man peers at you over silver spectacles.

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: Hello? Is that...no - ah, I don't believe we've met. Forgive me, my eyes aren't what they used to be.
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: Hello? Is that...no - ah, I don't believe we've met. Forgive me, my eyes aren't what they used to be.

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: I specialize in antiques and jewellery. I'll [C1]purchase any special trinkets[/C1] you happen to have.
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: I specialize in antiques and jewellery. I'll [C1]purchase any special trinkets[/C1] you happen to have.

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: Have you got anything nice with you today, perhaps?
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: Have you got anything nice with you today, perhaps?

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: Welcome! Found anything special lately?
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: Welcome! Found anything special lately?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You explain that you've sold an engraved belt buckle to The Trader.
rows.raw_text: You explain that you've sold an engraved belt buckle to The Trader.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: You - oh. Well, maybe that wasn't his... I'd - I'd better go and check before he melts it down!
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: You - oh. Well, maybe that wasn't his... I'd - I'd better go and check before he melts it down!

rows.speaker: Unattributed

rows.text: The man hurries away towards the Trader.
rows.raw_text: The man hurries away towards the Trader.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You give the belt buckle to the man.
rows.raw_text: You give the belt buckle to the man.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: This is...this is his! Oh, thank you, bless you. You've returned him to me...
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: This is...this is his! Oh, thank you, bless you. You've returned him to me...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You approach a woman sitting on the dockside, staring out to sea. She turns to you.
rows.raw_text: You approach a woman sitting on the dockside, staring out to sea. She turns to you.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: What's it like out there?
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: What's it like out there?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: It's peaceful.
rows.raw_text: It's peaceful.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: It's difficult.
rows.raw_text: It's difficult.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I don't want to talk about it.
rows.raw_text: I don't want to talk about it.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: It's got to be a damn sight better than this bloody town. I think I just need to get away for a while -- maybe not come back.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: It's got to be a damn sight better than this bloody town. I think I just need to get away for a while -- maybe not come back.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Going backwards is a mistake, don't you think? You should always keep moving forward. Moving along.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Going backwards is a mistake, don't you think? You should always keep moving forward. Moving along.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: It's not so bad here.
rows.raw_text: It's not so bad here.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I don't want to move along.
rows.raw_text: I don't want to move along.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I can't go back.
rows.raw_text: I can't go back.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: She's gazing out to sea again, lost in thought.
rows.raw_text: She's gazing out to sea again, lost in thought.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Say, if you find me some materials, maybe you can help me move? I mean, really move. There's an island I've heard about, [C0]Steel Point, just to the North[/C0].
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Say, if you find me some materials, maybe you can help me move? I mean, really move. There's an island I've heard about, [C0]Steel Point, just to the North[/C0].

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: [C0]Two units of Lumber[/C0] and [C0]Two units of Scrap[/C0] is all I need. I can make a new place for myself out there. You'd be welcome to visit, too.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: [C0]Two units of Lumber[/C0] and [C0]Two units of Scrap[/C0] is all I need. I can make a new place for myself out there. You'd be welcome to visit, too.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Just [C0]stack it up at Steel Point[/C0] when you have anything. I'll pay you when the job's done.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Just [C0]stack it up at Steel Point[/C0] when you have anything. I'll pay you when the job's done.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: This is the island where the [C0]Builder[/C0] wants materials delivered.
rows.raw_text: This is the island where the [C0]Builder[/C0] wants materials delivered.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You've delivered all the necessary materials. You should let the Builder know.
rows.raw_text: You've delivered all the necessary materials. You should let the Builder know.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: You've done it? Well, no sense in wasting time. Let's get moving.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: You've done it? Well, no sense in wasting time. Let's get moving.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Good riddance to you, [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0]. I'm onward bound.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Good riddance to you, [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0]. I'm onward bound.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: No room on deck? [C0]Come back when you have more space[/C0]. I'll be waiting.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: No room on deck? [C0]Come back when you have more space[/C0]. I'll be waiting.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Yes...yes, this'll do. Thank you, fella.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Yes...yes, this'll do. Thank you, fella.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Give me a short while to get things built here. You're welcome back any time.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Give me a short while to get things built here. You're welcome back any time.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Take these. Always good to have on hand.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Take these. Always good to have on hand.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A hunched woman approaches you from the steps to the lighthouse. She stops some distance away and looks at you with concern and visible apprehension.
rows.raw_text: A hunched woman approaches you from the steps to the lighthouse. She stops some distance away and looks at you with concern and visible apprehension.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Why are you here?
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Why are you here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've come to fish.
rows.raw_text: I've come to fish.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've come to see the area.
rows.raw_text: I've come to see the area.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've come to meet people.
rows.raw_text: I've come to meet people.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: There's nothing here for someone like you anymore. Do yourself a favor and move on.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: There's nothing here for someone like you anymore. Do yourself a favor and move on.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She turns and shuffles back along the path that leads to the light.
rows.raw_text: She turns and shuffles back along the path that leads to the light.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You enter the Collector's house. He's standing at the back of the room, still holding the silver and crimson book. He seems impatient.
rows.raw_text: You enter the Collector's house. He's standing at the back of the room, still holding the silver and crimson book. He seems impatient.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Well? You have something, don't you? Show me.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Well? You have something, don't you? Show me.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You hand him the key. The cold metal shimmers a [C3]strange shine[/C3] as he holds it. The shape of the key - the teeth, the head - now somehow seem changed, smaller. Has it always been this way?
rows.raw_text: You hand him the key. The cold metal shimmers a [C3]strange shine[/C3] as he holds it. The shape of the key - the teeth, the head - now somehow seem changed, smaller. Has it always been this way?

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Is this all? Where is the lock?
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Is this all? Where is the lock?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The Collector grows agitated.
rows.raw_text: The Collector grows agitated.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: It seems...the pieces we're looking for have travelled further than I anticipated. Much further, I suspect.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: It seems...the pieces we're looking for have travelled further than I anticipated. Much further, I suspect.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Now go. We have more relics to uncover.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Now go. We have more relics to uncover.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Mayor is walking quickly towards you. He seems to be in a good mood, with a spring in his step.
rows.raw_text: The Mayor is walking quickly towards you. He seems to be in a good mood, with a spring in his step.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Fantastic news - thanks partly to your efforts, [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0] is growing! Our town is sure to be swarming with visitors any day now.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Fantastic news - thanks partly to your efforts, [C0]Greater Marrow[/C0] is growing! Our town is sure to be swarming with visitors any day now.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: In fact, I've granted a consent for the [C1]Shipwright to expand her facilities[/C1]. The old [C0]Dry Dock is operational again[/C0]!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: In fact, I've granted a consent for the [C1]Shipwright to expand her facilities[/C1]. The old [C0]Dry Dock is operational again[/C0]!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Keep up the good work. We're glad you've chosen to be here with us.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Keep up the good work. We're glad you've chosen to be here with us.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Lousy weather lately - almost makes you not want to get out of bed. But you and I, we've gotta do it, eh? We're what keeps people from going hungry.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Lousy weather lately - almost makes you not want to get out of bed. But you and I, we've gotta do it, eh? We're what keeps people from going hungry.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I don't know how you do it every day. These old bones wouldn't cut it on the high seas.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I don't know how you do it every day. These old bones wouldn't cut it on the high seas.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Hope the seagulls didn't get to your catch - those blasted pests.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Hope the seagulls didn't get to your catch - those blasted pests.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Don't over-commit yourself - especially when that sun starts going down. Better to come back with a small catch than to not come back at all.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Don't over-commit yourself - especially when that sun starts going down. Better to come back with a small catch than to not come back at all.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Keep an eye out for larger fish. They'll feed more mouths, so I can pay you more for them.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Keep an eye out for larger fish. They'll feed more mouths, so I can pay you more for them.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Sorry, sorry, it's a mess in here. I've just been so busy lately, you know how it is. Exhausting.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Sorry, sorry, it's a mess in here. I've just been so busy lately, you know how it is. Exhausting.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: I've got a good feeling about these engines. They'll take you far away...reliable, too, provided you take care of 'em.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: I've got a good feeling about these engines. They'll take you far away...reliable, too, provided you take care of 'em.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: You'll want a variety of tackle to catch all the fish out there. Make sure you're prepared for whatever you come across.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: You'll want a variety of tackle to catch all the fish out there. Make sure you're prepared for whatever you come across.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Damage to your hull is bound to stop engines and such from functioning right. Be careful near rocks.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Damage to your hull is bound to stop engines and such from functioning right. Be careful near rocks.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: A single unlucky hit is enough to knock out an engine...and you wouldn't want to be without a motor when the fog rolls in.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: A single unlucky hit is enough to knock out an engine...and you wouldn't want to be without a motor when the fog rolls in.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: If any of your equipment stops working, head back here for repairs.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: If any of your equipment stops working, head back here for repairs.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Make sure you check out the specs before you buy this stuff -- once it's installed, no refunds.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Make sure you check out the specs before you buy this stuff -- once it's installed, no refunds.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: What is it?
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: What is it?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have you heard of any strange things happening?
rows.raw_text: Have you heard of any strange things happening?

rows.raw_text: She eyes you suspiciously.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about the Old Mayor of Little Marrow?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about the Old Mayor of Little Marrow?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I should go.
rows.raw_text: I should go.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: There's a spot near the [C0]back of Greater Marrow[/C0] where the current carries in wreckage from the sea.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: There's a spot near the [C0]back of Greater Marrow[/C0] where the current carries in wreckage from the sea.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: What is it?
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: What is it?

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Anything else?
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Anything else?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What did you want me to do again?
rows.raw_text: What did you want me to do again?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Why do you want to leave?
rows.raw_text: Why do you want to leave?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about the area?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about the area?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'd better get on with it.
rows.raw_text: I'd better get on with it.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Bring [C0]Two units of Lumber[/C0] and [C0]Two units of Scrap[/C0] to [C0]Steel Point[/C0], which is an island just to the [C0]North[/C0].
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Bring [C0]Two units of Lumber[/C0] and [C0]Two units of Scrap[/C0] to [C0]Steel Point[/C0], which is an island just to the [C0]North[/C0].

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: I want to build a place for myself there.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: I want to build a place for myself there.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: There are...too many painful memories here - I don't want to be living them any more. It's a bit difficult to talk about - you know how it is.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: There are...too many painful memories here - I don't want to be living them any more. It's a bit difficult to talk about - you know how it is.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: It doesn't do you any good to dwell too deeply on the past.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: It doesn't do you any good to dwell too deeply on the past.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: Greater Marrow? Well, it was once a bright and thriving little town, if you can believe it.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: Greater Marrow? Well, it was once a bright and thriving little town, if you can believe it.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: There was plenty of work for me and my crew - new houses and shops every other month. We made a fair bit of money out of it too.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: There was plenty of work for me and my crew - new houses and shops every other month. We made a fair bit of money out of it too.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: But-- I don't know, I guess the bubble burst or something. I don't know how these things work. People started leaving. My crew left. I stayed.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: But-- I don't know, I guess the bubble burst or something. I don't know how these things work. People started leaving. My crew left. I stayed.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: How's the day treating ya?
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: How's the day treating ya?

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: What else can I do for ya?
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: What else can I do for ya?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's it like working on the docks?
rows.raw_text: What's it like working on the docks?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'd better go.
rows.raw_text: I'd better go.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: I know there were a few 'round the Eastern side of the island. Mostly rotted away by now I'd expect. Or dashed apart by the waves.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: I know there were a few 'round the Eastern side of the island. Mostly rotted away by now I'd expect. Or dashed apart by the waves.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Poor souls keep hitting rocks in the fog, I guess. There's a blind spot back there where the lighthouse can't be seen. People get turned around.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Poor souls keep hitting rocks in the fog, I guess. There's a blind spot back there where the lighthouse can't be seen. People get turned around.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Supposedly, some twenty-odd years ago, a fisherman from these parts hauled up an old sealed casket from the seafloor.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Supposedly, some twenty-odd years ago, a fisherman from these parts hauled up an old sealed casket from the seafloor.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: They pried it open and took what was inside for themselves.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: They pried it open and took what was inside for themselves.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: As changeable as the weather, hah! Most days it's pretty quiet. The pay's not too great, but the work's straightforward - that suits me to a tee.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: As changeable as the weather, hah! Most days it's pretty quiet. The pay's not too great, but the work's straightforward - that suits me to a tee.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: It's good to get that fresh sea breeze without actually being on the water. No offense, but you wouldn't get me out on those seas every day.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: It's good to get that fresh sea breeze without actually being on the water. No offense, but you wouldn't get me out on those seas every day.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: What can I do for you?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: What can I do for you?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Now, what else can I do for you?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Now, what else can I do for you?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What happened to the last fisherman?
rows.raw_text: What happened to the last fisherman?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I should get back to fishing.
rows.raw_text: I should get back to fishing.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Hmm? The last fisherman? Oh, he was very unreliable. He'd go out at night, come back with no fish and proceed to sleep all day.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Hmm? The last fisherman? Oh, he was very unreliable. He'd go out at night, come back with no fish and proceed to sleep all day.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: He was also a terrible captain. I mean, really terrible. Constantly running aground on the reef - even in broad daylight! The Shipwright almost ran out of wood for repairs.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: He was also a terrible captain. I mean, really terrible. Constantly running aground on the reef - even in broad daylight! The Shipwright almost ran out of wood for repairs.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: No, he was no good. One evening he left and never came back. So long! He shan't be missed by us.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: No, he was no good. One evening he left and never came back. So long! He shan't be missed by us.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'd like to pay off some of my debt.
rows.raw_text: I'd like to pay off some of my debt.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Of course! How much would you like to repay?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Of course! How much would you like to repay?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Never mind.
rows.raw_text: Never mind.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: All of it.
rows.raw_text: All of it.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Fantastic!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Fantastic!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Excellent!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Excellent!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Excellent!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Excellent!

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Do not bother me with common clutter. I hear that the [C0]Trader[/C0] in [C0]Little Marrow[/C0] deals with such trivialities.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Do not bother me with common clutter. I hear that the [C0]Trader[/C0] in [C0]Little Marrow[/C0] deals with such trivialities.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Look here, I found this down by the docks - I'm sure someone like you could make something out of it. Why don't you take it?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Look here, I found this down by the docks - I'm sure someone like you could make something out of it. Why don't you take it?

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I found this [C1]Book[/C1] out back. Could be useful to ya.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I found this [C1]Book[/C1] out back. Could be useful to ya.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: If you're wanting to get a bit more out of your engines, take a look through this book. On the house.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: If you're wanting to get a bit more out of your engines, take a look through this book. On the house.

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: A returning customer! Please, take this as a symbol of my appreciation. I'm sure you'll find it useful.
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: A returning customer! Please, take this as a symbol of my appreciation. I'm sure you'll find it useful.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Until your debt is repaid, a [C2]tiny portion of your fish sales[/C2] will go towards paying it off. A small amount of interest will go towards [C1]improving the town[/C1].
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Until your debt is repaid, a [C2]tiny portion of your fish sales[/C2] will go towards paying it off. A small amount of interest will go towards [C1]improving the town[/C1].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Return when you have something.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Return when you have something.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Stop by for a chat any time. I know how lonely it can be.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Stop by for a chat any time. I know how lonely it can be.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Give the belt buckle to the man?
rows.raw_text: Give the belt buckle to the man?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes
rows.raw_text: Yes

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: No
rows.raw_text: No

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You hold on to the belt buckle for now.
rows.raw_text: You hold on to the belt buckle for now.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Please, take this. I've not any money to pay you, but this might hold some value to you.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Please, take this. I've not any money to pay you, but this might hold some value to you.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: This is the Dry Dock. We can make [C1]significant improvements[/C1] to your vessel here.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: This is the Dry Dock. We can make [C1]significant improvements[/C1] to your vessel here.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: We're talking [C1]extra space[/C1], [C1]more attachment points for equipment[/C1], and even [C1]superior hulls[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: We're talking [C1]extra space[/C1], [C1]more attachment points for equipment[/C1], and even [C1]superior hulls[/C1].

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: We'll need a decent stock of hard materials for these projects - [C0]Lumber[/C0], [C0]Metal Scraps[/C0], that sort of thing.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: We'll need a decent stock of hard materials for these projects - [C0]Lumber[/C0], [C0]Metal Scraps[/C0], that sort of thing.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: [C0]Materials assigned towards upgrades here will be stored[/C0]. So don't worry if you only have half of what we need.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: [C0]Materials assigned towards upgrades here will be stored[/C0]. So don't worry if you only have half of what we need.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: How do I get materials?
rows.raw_text: How do I get materials?

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: There's plenty of decent materials around the coast, from various shipwrecks and the like. I'm sure you'll find a way to get at them.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: There's plenty of decent materials around the coast, from various shipwrecks and the like. I'm sure you'll find a way to get at them.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Finding materials will allow you to upgrade my vessel, got it.
rows.raw_text: Finding materials will allow you to upgrade my vessel, got it.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Say...where's your fishing gear? Sure hope you have enough money to buy some replacement tackle.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Say...where's your fishing gear? Sure hope you have enough money to buy some replacement tackle.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Actually, I don't. Could you lend me a rod?
rows.raw_text: Actually, I don't. Could you lend me a rod?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'll be fine.
rows.raw_text: I'll be fine.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Hmm. That's a worry. I might have something out back...
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Hmm. That's a worry. I might have something out back...

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Ah, here we go. Don't worry about giving it back, it's a piece of junk really.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Ah, here we go. Don't worry about giving it back, it's a piece of junk really.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: Just don't tell the Mayor I gave you something for nothing. He'll lecture me about taxes for an hour.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: Just don't tell the Mayor I gave you something for nothing. He'll lecture me about taxes for an hour.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: If you say so.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: If you say so.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The lighthouse towers above. Waves crash endlessly against the perilous rocks below.
rows.raw_text: The lighthouse towers above. Waves crash endlessly against the perilous rocks below.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: All creatures - human or otherwise - would have their brittle bodies broken and thrown at its feet.
rows.raw_text: All creatures - human or otherwise - would have their brittle bodies broken and thrown at its feet.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You ponder the intrinsic power of this structure, a vast column of stone shouldering the responsibility of countless lives.
rows.raw_text: You ponder the intrinsic power of this structure, a vast column of stone shouldering the responsibility of countless lives.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: How long will it stand? How long until it decays into ruin, its purpose exhausted?
rows.raw_text: How long will it stand? How long until it decays into ruin, its purpose exhausted?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The lighthouse towers above.
rows.raw_text: The lighthouse towers above.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A floating buoy. It serves to mark safe passage past dangerous rocks and obscured hazards.
rows.raw_text: A floating buoy. It serves to mark safe passage past dangerous rocks and obscured hazards.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Its dim light also provides a [C1]brief respite[/C1] in the gloom of the night.
rows.raw_text: Its dim light also provides a [C1]brief respite[/C1] in the gloom of the night.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: From this position in the center of the bay, you can see a spread of islands.
rows.raw_text: From this position in the center of the bay, you can see a spread of islands.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Greater Marrow to the West, and its twinned town of Little Marrow to the East.
rows.raw_text: Greater Marrow to the West, and its twinned town of Little Marrow to the East.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The islands to the North and South are...unfamilar, but are probably marked on your map.
rows.raw_text: The islands to the North and South are...unfamilar, but are probably marked on your map.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: What is it?
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: What is it?

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Anything else?
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Anything else?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you need help with anything?
rows.raw_text: Do you need help with anything?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Here's the aged Conger Eel you asked for.
rows.raw_text: Here's the aged Conger Eel you asked for.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What can you tell me about the cliffs?
rows.raw_text: What can you tell me about the cliffs?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any odd characters around these parts?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any odd characters around these parts?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where can I sell my fish here?
rows.raw_text: Where can I sell my fish here?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing.
rows.raw_text: Nothing.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Many years ago, the cliffs used to be a haven for smugglers and pirates. Legend tells of two pirate lords who used Gale Cliffs as their hideout.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Many years ago, the cliffs used to be a haven for smugglers and pirates. Legend tells of two pirate lords who used Gale Cliffs as their hideout.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Supposedly, they got into some disagreement, and a huge battle was fought around the [C0]South[/C0] side of the cliffs. There certainly are a large number of wrecks in that area.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Supposedly, they got into some disagreement, and a huge battle was fought around the [C0]South[/C0] side of the cliffs. There certainly are a large number of wrecks in that area.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Both sides were completely destroyed - their [C1]treasure hoards[/C1] left abandoned and unclaimed to this day. I dare say they'd be worth a lot, if anyone knew where to find them...
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Both sides were completely destroyed - their [C1]treasure hoards[/C1] left abandoned and unclaimed to this day. I dare say they'd be worth a lot, if anyone knew where to find them...

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: We catch our fish ourselves here, so we don't have much need for buying any.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: We catch our fish ourselves here, so we don't have much need for buying any.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: But there's a merchant that travels around, she's usually anchored [C0]across the bay[/C0]. She [C0]buys and sells[/C0] almost anything - and she does [C0]repairs[/C0] too.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: But there's a merchant that travels around, she's usually anchored [C0]across the bay[/C0]. She [C0]buys and sells[/C0] almost anything - and she does [C0]repairs[/C0] too.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: I've been trying to prepare a special meal for my partner, but I've been having some issues.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: I've been trying to prepare a special meal for my partner, but I've been having some issues.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Around here we consider [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eels[/C0] to be a particular delicacy. You may say they're '[C2]rotting[/C2]', but they're delicious if prepared correctly.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Around here we consider [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eels[/C0] to be a particular delicacy. You may say they're '[C2]rotting[/C2]', but they're delicious if prepared correctly.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Normally, we bury them in the ground and allow them to mature. But our dog keeps digging them up and eating them.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Normally, we bury them in the ground and allow them to mature. But our dog keeps digging them up and eating them.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: I can't raise the subject without spoiling the surprise. Can you bring me an [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eel[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: I can't raise the subject without spoiling the surprise. Can you bring me an [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eel[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Yes, I can bring you an 'aged' Conger Eel.
rows.raw_text: Yes, I can bring you an 'aged' Conger Eel.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Thank you. You'll be decently compensated.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Thank you. You'll be decently compensated.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm busy, maybe later.
rows.raw_text: I'm busy, maybe later.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Oh, ok.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Oh, ok.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: I still need that [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eel[/C0], if you would be so kind.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: I still need that [C2]aged[/C2] [C0]Conger Eel[/C0], if you would be so kind.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Perfect! This will do wonderfully. I can offer you a small sum, in thanks.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Perfect! This will do wonderfully. I can offer you a small sum, in thanks.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Safe travels.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Safe travels.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: I'm saved! Saved! Oh, you are a sight for these sore eyes.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: I'm saved! Saved! Oh, you are a sight for these sore eyes.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What happened?
rows.raw_text: What happened?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You look terrible. Are you ok?
rows.raw_text: You look terrible. Are you ok?

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: I bet I do! I've certainly felt better. I've been chewing on seaweed and starfish for longer than I'd like.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: I bet I do! I've certainly felt better. I've been chewing on seaweed and starfish for longer than I'd like.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: I washed up here...oh, it must be some two weeks ago now. We were in rough seas, and when a wave hit us broadside I was jostled overboard and swept away.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: I washed up here...oh, it must be some two weeks ago now. We were in rough seas, and when a wave hit us broadside I was jostled overboard and swept away.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: I thought my crew would've come to find me by now, but yours is the first ship I've seen pass by here.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: I thought my crew would've come to find me by now, but yours is the first ship I've seen pass by here.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: Did the boys send you looking for me?
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: Did the boys send you looking for me?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: No.
rows.raw_text: No.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: Oh, well, I'm sure they're out there lookin' anyways.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: Oh, well, I'm sure they're out there lookin' anyways.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: That's a relief to hear, I'd thought for sure those sorry sacks would be halfway across the sea with my boat by now.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: That's a relief to hear, I'd thought for sure those sorry sacks would be halfway across the sea with my boat by now.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: Can you get me to [C0]Little Marrow[/C0], stranger? I should be able to catch them there when they next stop by.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: Can you get me to [C0]Little Marrow[/C0], stranger? I should be able to catch them there when they next stop by.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Yes, I'll take you to Little Marrow.
rows.raw_text: Yes, I'll take you to Little Marrow.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: What, you're just going to leave me here to starve to death?! Curse you!
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: What, you're just going to leave me here to starve to death?! Curse you!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The [C0]Castaway[/C0] climbs aboard.
rows.raw_text: The [C0]Castaway[/C0] climbs aboard.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: Have you come back for me?
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: Have you come back for me?

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: The sweet, rank smell of civilization. I thought I could never miss it.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: The sweet, rank smell of civilization. I thought I could never miss it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He turns to you. For someone who has just been saved, he seems gloomy.
rows.raw_text: He turns to you. For someone who has just been saved, he seems gloomy.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: I've not got much on me, as you can imagine. And I've a feeling this isn't worth much anymore -- for me, at least. But perhaps it'll be worth something for you.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: I've not got much on me, as you can imagine. And I've a feeling this isn't worth much anymore -- for me, at least. But perhaps it'll be worth something for you.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He removes a [C1]Signet Ring[/C1] from his left hand and presses it into yours. It's emblazoned with a symbol of a captain's wheel.
rows.raw_text: He removes a [C1]Signet Ring[/C1] from his left hand and presses it into yours. It's emblazoned with a symbol of a captain's wheel.

rows.speaker: Castaway
rows.text: On to better horizons, friend. Farewell.
rows.raw_text: CASTAWAY_NAME_KEY: On to better horizons, friend. Farewell.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: On the shoreline, partially submerged in a rockpool, is the body of a man. The sun and sea have corrupted his features - it's hard to make out much more than that.
rows.raw_text: On the shoreline, partially submerged in a rockpool, is the body of a man. The sun and sea have corrupted his features - it's hard to make out much more than that.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With a grim reverence, you turn the wheel and continue on your way.
rows.raw_text: With a grim reverence, you turn the wheel and continue on your way.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You approach a hooded figure. Swathed in dark blue robes, their face is barely visible.
rows.raw_text: You approach a hooded figure. Swathed in dark blue robes, their face is barely visible.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 1
rows.text: Fisherman...please. Help.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_1_NAME_KEY: Fisherman...please. Help.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Something seems off. The hooded figure is slumped, long robes billowing violently.
rows.raw_text: Something seems off. The hooded figure is slumped, long robes billowing violently.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Ahoy there! You're a new face - a fisherman I take it? Perfect! Well, we should get along like a house on fire, ha ha!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Ahoy there! You're a new face - a fisherman I take it? Perfect! Well, we should get along like a house on fire, ha ha!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one! If you have any fish to sell, I'll take 'em on board and sell 'em at the next town I come across.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one! If you have any fish to sell, I'll take 'em on board and sell 'em at the next town I come across.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Likewise, I haul a small cargo of equipment between places. You're welcome to peruse the stock and see if there's anything that takes your fancy.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Likewise, I haul a small cargo of equipment between places. You're welcome to peruse the stock and see if there's anything that takes your fancy.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Now, what'll it be?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Now, what'll it be?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Hey there! What are we doing today? Making repairs? Selling fresh fish? Buying new engines? We can do it all here!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Hey there! What are we doing today? Making repairs? Selling fresh fish? Buying new engines? We can do it all here!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Let's trade.
rows.raw_text: Let's trade.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'd like to talk about some things.
rows.raw_text: I'd like to talk about some things.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Ok!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Ok!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: What do you want to talk about?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: What do you want to talk about?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: What else do you want to talk about?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: What else do you want to talk about?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Can you tell me about the area?
rows.raw_text: Can you tell me about the area?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are you always out on the water?
rows.raw_text: Are you always out on the water?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you ever see ... strange things out at sea?
rows.raw_text: Do you ever see ... strange things out at sea?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing, let's trade.
rows.raw_text: Nothing, let's trade.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Oh, these cliffs are always fun to come back to. You never know how much more will have fallen down!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Oh, these cliffs are always fun to come back to. You never know how much more will have fallen down!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'm not sure what's doing it, but they're falling apart strangely quickly, if you ask me.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'm not sure what's doing it, but they're falling apart strangely quickly, if you ask me.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: There's one old guy still living there though. He must be nuts! Or he must really love his house. Either way: weird!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: There's one old guy still living there though. He must be nuts! Or he must really love his house. Either way: weird!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Yeah, always! I like to keep moving along. The merchanting is secondary to the travelling, really. I'm more of a merchanting traveller!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Yeah, always! I like to keep moving along. The merchanting is secondary to the travelling, really. I'm more of a merchanting traveller!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I get to see a lot of places, which is nice. I also get to meet a lot of people, which is only sometimes nice.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I get to see a lot of places, which is nice. I also get to meet a lot of people, which is only sometimes nice.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Strange things? Plenty! But I try not to dwell on them. You could go crazy, you know? Hah!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Strange things? Plenty! But I try not to dwell on them. You could go crazy, you know? Hah!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: But, hey, if you're seeing strange things ... maybe you're not seeing them the right way? Maybe they're not so strange after all.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: But, hey, if you're seeing strange things ... maybe you're not seeing them the right way? Maybe they're not so strange after all.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Or perhaps they are, and they're incredibly dangerous. Better not risk it!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Or perhaps they are, and they're incredibly dangerous. Better not risk it!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.text: [X] I'll be going now.
rows.raw_text: [X] I'll be going now.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A short man is shouting orders at a handful of workers disembarking from a boat nearby. The man notices you.
rows.raw_text: A short man is shouting orders at a handful of workers disembarking from a boat nearby. The man notices you.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: I'll let you get out there to [C0]catch some fish[/C0]. See if you can fill your cargo while you get your bearings in the light.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: I'll let you get out there to [C0]catch some fish[/C0]. See if you can fill your cargo while you get your bearings in the light.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: As I mentioned earlier, your [C2]old boat was too badly damaged to be repaired[/C2]. However, I'm more than happy to sell you that replacement vessel - [C1]yours to own[/C1].
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: As I mentioned earlier, your [C2]old boat was too badly damaged to be repaired[/C2]. However, I'm more than happy to sell you that replacement vessel - [C1]yours to own[/C1].

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Ahoy there! You're a new face - a fisherman I take it? Perfect! Well, we should get along like a house on fire, ha ha!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Ahoy there! You're a new face - a fisherman I take it? Perfect! Well, we should get along like a house on fire, ha ha!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one! If you have any [C0]fish to sell[/C0], I'll take 'em on board and sell 'em at the next town I come across.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one! If you have any [C0]fish to sell[/C0], I'll take 'em on board and sell 'em at the next town I come across.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Likewise, I haul a small cargo of [C0]equipment[/C0] between places. You're welcome to peruse the stock and see if there's anything that takes your fancy.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Likewise, I haul a small cargo of [C0]equipment[/C0] between places. You're welcome to peruse the stock and see if there's anything that takes your fancy.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Come and see me when you're ready to trade!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Come and see me when you're ready to trade!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Are you able to make that delivery for me now?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Are you able to make that delivery for me now?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: The [C0]Dockworker[/C0] will pay you upon delivery. Please be quick about it, [C2]I don't want it to spoil[/C2].
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: The [C0]Dockworker[/C0] will pay you upon delivery. Please be quick about it, [C2]I don't want it to spoil[/C2].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He tears a small hole in the paper and peeks inside. You can't say for sure, but it feels as though he's shielding it from your view.
rows.raw_text: He tears a small hole in the paper and peeks inside. You can't say for sure, but it feels as though he's shielding it from your view.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Yeah, nice and fresh. This'll do nicely. I'm to pay you, I suppose?
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Yeah, nice and fresh. This'll do nicely. I'm to pay you, I suppose?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He hands you some money.
rows.raw_text: He hands you some money.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Ugh, this smells foul. You obviously took your sweet time getting here with this.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Ugh, this smells foul. You obviously took your sweet time getting here with this.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: He won't let me pay for a delivery in this state. But, hmm. Maybe I can give you this...
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: He won't let me pay for a delivery in this state. But, hmm. Maybe I can give you this...

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Shipwrecks? Unfortunately, there have been quite a few in recent years. The lighthouse helps, but even it struggles to cut through the fog some nights.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Shipwrecks? Unfortunately, there have been quite a few in recent years. The lighthouse helps, but even it struggles to cut through the fog some nights.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: We do our best to salvage and clear any shipwrecks that occur around this side of the island. That should make fishing a bit easier for you!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: We do our best to salvage and clear any shipwrecks that occur around this side of the island. That should make fishing a bit easier for you!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Well, I heard that my counterpart in Little Marrow met the most unfortunate end.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Well, I heard that my counterpart in Little Marrow met the most unfortunate end.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: They say he went mad quite suddenly! One day he was normal, the next, he was pacing the shoreline hurling people's belongings into the sea!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: They say he went mad quite suddenly! One day he was normal, the next, he was pacing the shoreline hurling people's belongings into the sea!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: After some days like this, he disappeared, never to be seen again! Nowadays, "The Tale of the Old Mayor" is used to scare children.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: After some days like this, he disappeared, never to be seen again! Nowadays, "The Tale of the Old Mayor" is used to scare children.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Not many remember him, myself included. And those that do remember don't seem to like talking about it. A most unpleasant subject!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Not many remember him, myself included. And those that do remember don't seem to like talking about it. A most unpleasant subject!

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: So if you're looking for what I think you're looking for, it's best you just move on.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: So if you're looking for what I think you're looking for, it's best you just move on.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: I see plenty of strange things from atop the lighthouse. Sometimes I don't know whether or not I can trust my own eyes.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: I see plenty of strange things from atop the lighthouse. Sometimes I don't know whether or not I can trust my own eyes.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Are you really standing here in front of me? Or is this just another of the fog's tricks?
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Are you really standing here in front of me? Or is this just another of the fog's tricks?

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: That's...he's...I try not to think about him. It's a painful memory for us all.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: That's...he's...I try not to think about him. It's a painful memory for us all.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: But I know he's gone - and I don't want to talk about it any more.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: But I know he's gone - and I don't want to talk about it any more.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: In that case, allow me to aid your travels.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: In that case, allow me to aid your travels.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He turns a few pages in his book and mutters something low under his breath.
rows.raw_text: He turns a few pages in his book and mutters something low under his breath.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He runs his fingers firmly along the length of the fish, as though feeling for something. He pushes from one side of its stomach and a small shape can be seen against the bulging scales.
rows.raw_text: He runs his fingers firmly along the length of the fish, as though feeling for something. He pushes from one side of its stomach and a small shape can be seen against the bulging scales.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He slices the fish open. From its stomach he pulls a small piece of fabric and spreads it on the counter. It's a [C3]delicately patterned Handkerchief[/C3].
rows.raw_text: He slices the fish open. From its stomach he pulls a small piece of fabric and spreads it on the counter. It's a [C3]delicately patterned Handkerchief[/C3].

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Well, I've never seen that before in all my days. I'll give you this thing, and I'll pay you for the fish too, of course.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Well, I've never seen that before in all my days. I'll give you this thing, and I'll pay you for the fish too, of course.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A man is looking at you through your cabin window. His face is mostly in shadow.
rows.raw_text: A man is looking at you through your cabin window. His face is mostly in shadow.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: I know what you took to the Fishmonger.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_DOCK_NAME_KEY: I know what you took to the Fishmonger.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: And I'll be clear - I know he extracted an artifact from it. I need to inspect it. But not here.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_DOCK_NAME_KEY: And I'll be clear - I know he extracted an artifact from it. I need to inspect it. But not here.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: Meet me on [C3]Blackstone Isle[/C3]. Head out of this bay and cut [C1]South[/C1]. I have a business proposition that you'll want to hear.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_DOCK_NAME_KEY: Meet me on [C3]Blackstone Isle[/C3]. Head out of this bay and cut [C1]South[/C1]. I have a business proposition that you'll want to hear.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: I'll be waiting.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_DOCK_NAME_KEY: I'll be waiting.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The man is standing in a doorway, watching you approach. He's holding an old book in one hand. It's bound in crimson, with silver ribbons.
rows.raw_text: The man is standing in a doorway, watching you approach. He's holding an old book in one hand. It's bound in crimson, with silver ribbons.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: You came. Good. Allow me to introduce myself.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_HOUSE_NAME_KEY: You came. Good. Allow me to introduce myself.

rows.speaker: Collector (unidentified in scene)
rows.text: I am a collector - of many things; art and artifacts, treasures and truths...and curios that occupy the periphery of desire.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_UNKNOWN_HOUSE_NAME_KEY: I am a collector - of many things; art and artifacts, treasures and truths...and curios that occupy the periphery of desire.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: And you have something for me.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: And you have something for me.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You give the [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] to the Collector. He holds it up to the flickering light and studies it.
rows.raw_text: You give the [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] to the Collector. He holds it up to the flickering light and studies it.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: These patterns are...unmistakeable...even after all this time. This [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] comes from an old ship I've been searching for. It sank many years ago.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: These patterns are...unmistakeable...even after all this time. This [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] comes from an old ship I've been searching for. It sank many years ago.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: It carried items of great importance. As you can imagine, retrieving them is proving to be challenging. That's where you come in.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: It carried items of great importance. As you can imagine, retrieving them is proving to be challenging. That's where you come in.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: My proposition is this: I will outfit your vessel with equipment that will let you [C3]dredge the wrecks and dark depths[/C3].
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: My proposition is this: I will outfit your vessel with equipment that will let you [C3]dredge the wrecks and dark depths[/C3].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Find me these [C3]lost relics[/C3] and I will [C1]reward you in ways beyond all imagining[/C1].
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Find me these [C3]lost relics[/C3] and I will [C1]reward you in ways beyond all imagining[/C1].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: You need not give up your fishing career. I'll merely need a few hours with your vessel to make the necessary alterations. What do you say?
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: You need not give up your fishing career. I'll merely need a few hours with your vessel to make the necessary alterations. What do you say?

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: That very night, the fog rolled in for the first time - and it has cloaked the seas every night since.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: That very night, the fog rolled in for the first time - and it has cloaked the seas every night since.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: What was in that accursed casket nobody knows. All of the crew that laid eyes on its contents went mad - or worse.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: What was in that accursed casket nobody knows. All of the crew that laid eyes on its contents went mad - or worse.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: The casket and crew have since disappeared without a trace. But the fog remains. Crazy stuff, huh?
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: The casket and crew have since disappeared without a trace. But the fog remains. Crazy stuff, huh?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You don't have the [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] with you. The man seemed interested in it, so you should probably bring it to the meeting.
rows.raw_text: You don't have the [C3]Handkerchief[/C3] with you. The man seemed interested in it, so you should probably bring it to the meeting.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: I overheard a tale in the tavern some years ago. Sounded pretty strange to me.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: I overheard a tale in the tavern some years ago. Sounded pretty strange to me.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Hello. Is everything ok?
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Hello. Is everything ok?

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Anything else I can help you with?
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Anything else I can help you with?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
