rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: About that belt buckle...
rows.raw_text: About that belt buckle...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about any strange occurrences?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'd better go.
rows.raw_text: I'd better go.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: I've told you all I know.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: I've told you all I know.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Well, yes, you see...my only son was lost at sea some years ago.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Well, yes, you see...my only son was lost at sea some years ago.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: He's...still out there, somewhere. In one of those wrecks. All alone in the cold dark water.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: He's...still out there, somewhere. In one of those wrecks. All alone in the cold dark water.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The man is clearly trying his hardest to remain composed, but tremors of grief rack his body.
rows.raw_text: The man is clearly trying his hardest to remain composed, but tremors of grief rack his body.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: I was wondering...I notice you have some dredging equipment installed on your vessel...
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: I was wondering...I notice you have some dredging equipment installed on your vessel...

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: If you're able to retrieve any of his belongings from the wreck...I think he'd feel more at peace if his mementos were with me.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: If you're able to retrieve any of his belongings from the wreck...I think he'd feel more at peace if his mementos were with me.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: He wore a [C0]Bronze Belt Buckle[/C0], specially engraved. I'd recognize it anywhere. If there's a chance you could find it, I'd be in your debt.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: He wore a [C0]Bronze Belt Buckle[/C0], specially engraved. I'd recognize it anywhere. If there's a chance you could find it, I'd be in your debt.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: I don't get out a lot anymore, so I don't see much of what goes on.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: I don't get out a lot anymore, so I don't see much of what goes on.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: But I do remember the Old Mayor in his final days. What an awful sight it was.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: But I do remember the Old Mayor in his final days. What an awful sight it was.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Screaming and throwing things into the sea. "[C3]Throw it back,[/C3]" he would cry, over and over.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Screaming and throwing things into the sea. "[C3]Throw it back,[/C3]" he would cry, over and over.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Begging anyone who would listen. Howling it to the wind. These days, I almost feel like I understand.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Begging anyone who would listen. Howling it to the wind. These days, I almost feel like I understand.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You explain that you found the belt buckle, but lost it again.
rows.raw_text: You explain that you found the belt buckle, but lost it again.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: You - oh. Well...perhaps that's his way of saying he wishes to remain at sea.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: You - oh. Well...perhaps that's his way of saying he wishes to remain at sea.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Thank you for your efforts. Truly.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Thank you for your efforts. Truly.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You explain that you found a belt buckle, but it's currently in your storage.
rows.raw_text: You explain that you found a belt buckle, but it's currently in your storage.

rows.speaker: Grieving Father
rows.text: Please, bring it to me. I need to know if it's his.
rows.raw_text: GRIEVING_FATHER_NAME_KEY: Please, bring it to me. I need to know if it's his.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'll still buy fish that aren't totally fresh, but if it's completely turned to [C2]Rot[/C2] I can't pay you anything for it.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'll still buy fish that aren't totally fresh, but if it's completely turned to [C2]Rot[/C2] I can't pay you anything for it.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Hey again - come by for a chat?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Hey again - come by for a chat?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Is there anything else you want to talk about?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Is there anything else you want to talk about?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are you always out on the water?
rows.raw_text: Are you always out on the water?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you ever see strange things out at sea?
rows.raw_text: Do you ever see strange things out at sea?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'll be going now.
rows.raw_text: I'll be going now.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Yeah, always! I like to keep moving along. The merchanting is secondary to the travelling, really. I'm more of a merchanting traveller!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Yeah, always! I like to keep moving along. The merchanting is secondary to the travelling, really. I'm more of a merchanting traveller!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I get to see a lot of places, which is nice. I also get to meet a lot of people, which is only sometimes nice.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I get to see a lot of places, which is nice. I also get to meet a lot of people, which is only sometimes nice.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Strange things? Plenty! But I try not to dwell on them. You could go crazy, you know? Hah!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Strange things? Plenty! But I try not to dwell on them. You could go crazy, you know? Hah!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: But, hey, if you're seeing strange things...maybe you're not seeing them the right way? Maybe they're not so strange after all.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: But, hey, if you're seeing strange things...maybe you're not seeing them the right way? Maybe they're not so strange after all.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Or perhaps they are, and they're incredibly dangerous. Better not risk it!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Or perhaps they are, and they're incredibly dangerous. Better not risk it!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She holds the lantern up so that it shines brightly onto your face.
rows.raw_text: She holds the lantern up so that it shines brightly onto your face.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Some nights I still think I can hear the hum of his engines sailing past the bay...
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Some nights I still think I can hear the hum of his engines sailing past the bay...

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I've had a special order come through from a customer. If you can fulfil it, I'll pay you above normal prices.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I've had a special order come through from a customer. If you can fulfil it, I'll pay you above normal prices.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about the order.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about the order.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Maybe later - I'm just here on regular business.
rows.raw_text: Maybe later - I'm just here on regular business.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: They asked for [C0]one Gulf Flounder[/C0] and [C0]one Grey Eel[/C0]. Just bring 'em in when you have them.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: They asked for [C0]one Gulf Flounder[/C0] and [C0]one Grey Eel[/C0]. Just bring 'em in when you have them.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: You'll need to have a rod that can handle [C0]Shallow[/C0] water fish in order to catch those. The shipwright should be able to sort that for you.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: You'll need to have a rod that can handle [C0]Shallow[/C0] water fish in order to catch those. The shipwright should be able to sort that for you.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Have you got any fish for that order?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Have you got any fish for that order?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger wraps up the fish and hands you some money.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger wraps up the fish and hands you some money.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Good, good. They should be pleased with these.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Good, good. They should be pleased with these.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I've got another order here. This one's a little more curious. They want [C0]a couple of Squid[/C0] and [C0]a whole Black Grouper[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I've got another order here. This one's a little more curious. They want [C0]a couple of Squid[/C0] and [C0]a whole Black Grouper[/C0].

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Don't see many people fishing squid these days - [C0]they only feed at night[/C0], and well, you know what nights are like 'round here. Good luck.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Don't see many people fishing squid these days - [C0]they only feed at night[/C0], and well, you know what nights are like 'round here. Good luck.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Have you got any fish for that order?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Have you got any fish for that order?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger wraps up the fish and hands you some money.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger wraps up the fish and hands you some money.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I didn't think you had it in you; night fishing is a tall order.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I didn't think you had it in you; night fishing is a tall order.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Been meaning to talk to you about a new business venture I've been considering - [C0]Crab Pots[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Been meaning to talk to you about a new business venture I've been considering - [C0]Crab Pots[/C0].

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Should be pretty straightforward. Just [C0]drop it out at sea anywhere[/C0], then come back after a day or two to check on it.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Should be pretty straightforward. Just [C0]drop it out at sea anywhere[/C0], then come back after a day or two to check on it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger wraps up the crabs and hands you some money.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger wraps up the crabs and hands you some money.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: These'll do. Glad you got some use out of that old pot. You can always [C0]buy more here[/C0], or [C1]repair damaged ones at the Shipyard[/C1].
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: These'll do. Glad you got some use out of that old pot. You can always [C0]buy more here[/C0], or [C1]repair damaged ones at the Shipyard[/C1].

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: I have one final request for you. As you've seen, some fish around here can develop odd...[C3]deformities[/C3].
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: I have one final request for you. As you've seen, some fish around here can develop odd...[C3]deformities[/C3].

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: What do you think happens to a person that eats the flesh of one of these mutants?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: What do you think happens to a person that eats the flesh of one of these mutants?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing.
rows.raw_text: Nothing.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: They go mad.
rows.raw_text: They go mad.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: They get sick.
rows.raw_text: They get sick.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Well...perhaps. But I want to know for sure. Bring me a mutant fish - any will do. Just...keep this between the two of us.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Well...perhaps. But I want to know for sure. Bring me a mutant fish - any will do. Just...keep this between the two of us.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Have you got any of those mutants with you now?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Have you got any of those mutants with you now?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger takes the aberrated fish from you. He clutches it close to his chest, wringing his hands around its slimy body.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger takes the aberrated fish from you. He clutches it close to his chest, wringing his hands around its slimy body.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Yes...this should do nicely. Here's what the fish is worth. And why don't you take these too - they're of no use to me.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Yes...this should do nicely. Here's what the fish is worth. And why don't you take these too - they're of no use to me.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Hmm? Do you hear that? It sounds like...the [C3]faintest whispering[/C3]...
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Hmm? Do you hear that? It sounds like...the [C3]faintest whispering[/C3]...

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You listen.
rows.raw_text: You listen.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Silence.
rows.raw_text: Silence.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: In the stillness of the room, the Fishmonger's hands begin to tremble.
rows.raw_text: In the stillness of the room, the Fishmonger's hands begin to tremble.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: His face grows anguished.
rows.raw_text: His face grows anguished.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Please. Sell what you need, then leave. I must deal with this creature. Quickly now!
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Please. Sell what you need, then leave. I must deal with this creature. Quickly now!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger's door slams behind you. You hear the heavy scraping of a metal bar sliding across it.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger's door slams behind you. You hear the heavy scraping of a metal bar sliding across it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Fishmonger's door is barred from the inside.
rows.raw_text: The Fishmonger's door is barred from the inside.

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Ugh...blinding headache today. Did you come by yesterday? I don't recall... Anyway, what can I do for you?
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Ugh...blinding headache today. Did you come by yesterday? I don't recall... Anyway, what can I do for you?

rows.speaker: Fishmonger
rows.text: Alright.
rows.raw_text: FISHMONGER_NAME_KEY: Alright.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You hold on to the fish for now.
rows.raw_text: You hold on to the fish for now.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You hold on to the fish for now.
rows.raw_text: You hold on to the fish for now.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You hold onto the aberration for now.
rows.raw_text: You hold onto the aberration for now.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Have you heard the tale of Magran? He was an old whaler from these parts.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Have you heard the tale of Magran? He was an old whaler from these parts.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: As the whales got more scarce, the crews spent longer and longer at sea trying to find them. Magran, it seems, wasn't cut out for this.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: As the whales got more scarce, the crews spent longer and longer at sea trying to find them. Magran, it seems, wasn't cut out for this.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: He formed an...unnatural attachment to a scroll he found on one of these trips.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: He formed an...unnatural attachment to a scroll he found on one of these trips.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: He says the scroll told him how to become immortal by eating mutated fish. People started calling him "[C0]Magran The Fishman[/C0]".
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: He says the scroll told him how to become immortal by eating mutated fish. People started calling him "[C0]Magran The Fishman[/C0]".

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: One day, the town awoke to find all the boats' nets and lines had been slashed in the night. And old Magran was nowhere to be found - nor has he been seen since.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: One day, the town awoke to find all the boats' nets and lines had been slashed in the night. And old Magran was nowhere to be found - nor has he been seen since.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Hello again...what can I do for you?
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Hello again...what can I do for you?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: What else do you want to know?
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: What else do you want to know?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: This place doesn't seem safe. Why do you live here?
rows.raw_text: This place doesn't seem safe. Why do you live here?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: Your brother forgives you. He's found you a place to stay.
rows.raw_text: Your brother forgives you. He's found you a place to stay.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Do you know of any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's happening to these cliffs?
rows.raw_text: What's happening to these cliffs?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Someone that used to live here kept their ship moored at the base of the cliff...until it was struck by some falling rocks and sunk to the bottom.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Someone that used to live here kept their ship moored at the base of the cliff...until it was struck by some falling rocks and sunk to the bottom.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: They were devastated at the loss - we all were - it was a beautiful boat, decorated with all manner of memorabilia from their travels.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: They were devastated at the loss - we all were - it was a beautiful boat, decorated with all manner of memorabilia from their travels.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: At low tide, I can still see what's left of the masthead, poking through the waves.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: At low tide, I can still see what's left of the masthead, poking through the waves.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: They're being consumed from the core by that [C3]hateful serpent[/C3] - have you seen it?
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: They're being consumed from the core by that [C3]hateful serpent[/C3] - have you seen it?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Nobody believed me. Not until it started devouring our foundations, opening up chasms beneath our homes.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Nobody believed me. Not until it started devouring our foundations, opening up chasms beneath our homes.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: It was nightmarish - waking in the night to the sound of a creature slithering somewhere underneath.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: It was nightmarish - waking in the night to the sound of a creature slithering somewhere underneath.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: It seems to have turned its attention elsewhere...but not before it took everything from me.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: It seems to have turned its attention elsewhere...but not before it took everything from me.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Aye...I've been stubbornly holding out here for quite some time. Truth be told, I've been reconsidering my position lately.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Aye...I've been stubbornly holding out here for quite some time. Truth be told, I've been reconsidering my position lately.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: I have been happy here for so long. My wife and I had such a beautiful life. Until the collapse.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: I have been happy here for so long. My wife and I had such a beautiful life. Until the collapse.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Now I'm alone, and cut off by land and sea - left only with these trembling rocks on all sides.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Now I'm alone, and cut off by land and sea - left only with these trembling rocks on all sides.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I could help you move to Ingfell.
rows.raw_text: I could help you move to Ingfell.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
rows.raw_text: I'm sorry to hear that.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Hmmph.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Hmmph.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Right. Well. I'm packed, and ready to go.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Right. Well. I'm packed, and ready to go.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Hermit climbs aboard with all of his belongings.
rows.raw_text: The Hermit climbs aboard with all of his belongings.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Not enough space for me and my things? I can wait for you to make some room.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Not enough space for me and my things? I can wait for you to make some room.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: What is it?
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: What is it?

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Anything else?
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Anything else?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where did you say the explosives were?
rows.raw_text: Where did you say the explosives were?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are there any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Are there any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have you heard about any strange things in the area?
rows.raw_text: Have you heard about any strange things in the area?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What can you tell me about Ingfell?
rows.raw_text: What can you tell me about Ingfell?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing. See you.
rows.raw_text: Nothing. See you.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: The real wreck around here is the settlement at Gale Cliffs.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: The real wreck around here is the settlement at Gale Cliffs.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Some time ago, just after the last whale was brought in, there was a sudden exodus from Gale Cliffs.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Some time ago, just after the last whale was brought in, there was a sudden exodus from Gale Cliffs.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Dozens of ships sailed past, packed up and hurrying away north as fast they could.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Dozens of ships sailed past, packed up and hurrying away north as fast they could.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: They were waving and shouting something at us from their boats - but we couldn't make it out.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: They were waving and shouting something at us from their boats - but we couldn't make it out.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Never did see or hear of them since.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Never did see or hear of them since.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Ingfell used to be a whaling town - emphasis on the "used to be". We would go out, bring in a carcass and then the rest of the town would get to work.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Ingfell used to be a whaling town - emphasis on the "used to be". We would go out, bring in a carcass and then the rest of the town would get to work.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: But the whales got scarce some twenty years ago - and now look at us. Barely scraping by for a new candle.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: But the whales got scarce some twenty years ago - and now look at us. Barely scraping by for a new candle.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: See, I've been trying to [C0]clear some debris[/C0] in the pathways through the cliffs [C1]to make a shortcut[/C1]. With explosives.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: See, I've been trying to [C0]clear some debris[/C0] in the pathways through the cliffs [C1]to make a shortcut[/C1]. With explosives.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: I was able to set a charge, but the cliffs seemed particularly unsteady that day, so I didn't risk detonating it.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: I was able to set a charge, but the cliffs seemed particularly unsteady that day, so I didn't risk detonating it.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: You just need to get in there and set it off. It's not far in - I left some yellow flags nearby, you can't miss it.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: You just need to get in there and set it off. It's not far in - I left some yellow flags nearby, you can't miss it.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Head through the rock arch to the [C0]South-East[/C0]. Follow the channel, and you'll see the yellow flags on the right.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Head through the rock arch to the [C0]South-East[/C0]. Follow the channel, and you'll see the yellow flags on the right.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: You've done it - we heard the blast from here! Gods, the echo. I'm surprised the cliffs didn't come down on your head.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: You've done it - we heard the blast from here! Gods, the echo. I'm surprised the cliffs didn't come down on your head.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: I've got things ready here. [C0]Go and tell my brother[/C0]...that he can come home.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: I've got things ready here. [C0]Go and tell my brother[/C0]...that he can come home.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing, I'll be off now.
rows.raw_text: Nothing, I'll be off now.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Come for some more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Come for some more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Come by the old [C0]Whaling Yards[/C0] anytime.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Come by the old [C0]Whaling Yards[/C0] anytime.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you need help with anything?
rows.raw_text: Do you need help with anything?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: About those rare fish you wanted me to find...
rows.raw_text: About those rare fish you wanted me to find...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Assistance from an angler? Absolutely! I've been trying to collect records of where each species of fish is located.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Assistance from an angler? Absolutely! I've been trying to collect records of where each species of fish is located.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I've figured out most of them on my travels so far, but there are a few I haven't been able to track down. Reckon you could share your info with me?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I've figured out most of them on my travels so far, but there are a few I haven't been able to track down. Reckon you could share your info with me?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Sure, I can help with that.
rows.raw_text: Sure, I can help with that.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I know a little about each species already, so maybe I can point you in the right direction.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I know a little about each species already, so maybe I can point you in the right direction.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: What did you want to know?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: What did you want to know?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: What about the other fish?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: What about the other fish?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about Oarfish.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about Oarfish.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Given that the [C0]Oarfish[/C0] has a long and fragile body, I suspect they'll live in reasonably deep, but calm water. Maybe the shelter of [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0] would suit them?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Given that the [C0]Oarfish[/C0] has a long and fragile body, I suspect they'll live in reasonably deep, but calm water. Maybe the shelter of [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0] would suit them?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I found an Oarfish.
rows.raw_text: I found an Oarfish.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about Gulper Eels.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about Gulper Eels.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I know that [C0]Gulper Eels[/C0] live at the [C0]deepest depths imaginable[/C0]. You'll have to get some specialist gear to catch one of those.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I know that [C0]Gulper Eels[/C0] live at the [C0]deepest depths imaginable[/C0]. You'll have to get some specialist gear to catch one of those.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I found a Gulper Eel.
rows.raw_text: I found a Gulper Eel.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about Goliath Tigerfish.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about Goliath Tigerfish.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: These guys are legitimately scary! They hunt in [C0]murky, swampy waters[/C0], using the shade of trees as cover.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: These guys are legitimately scary! They hunt in [C0]murky, swampy waters[/C0], using the shade of trees as cover.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I found a Goliath Tigerfish.
rows.raw_text: I found a Goliath Tigerfish.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about Coelacanths.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about Coelacanths.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Actually, I have no idea where [C0]Coelacanths[/C0] might be. But they have a [C0]primordial feel[/C0] to them, don't you think?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Actually, I have no idea where [C0]Coelacanths[/C0] might be. But they have a [C0]primordial feel[/C0] to them, don't you think?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I found a Coelacanth.
rows.raw_text: I found a Coelacanth.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's great news! I'll add it to my records. Here, take this - I'm sure you'll find some use for it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've got all the information I need.
rows.raw_text: I've got all the information I need.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's...that's all of them, wow! I never thought I'd complete these records.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's...that's all of them, wow! I never thought I'd complete these records.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Great! The fish I have left to track down are: [C0]Oarfish[/C0], [C0]Gulper Eel[/C0], [C0]Goliath Tigerfish[/C0] and [C0]Coelacanth[/C0].
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Great! The fish I have left to track down are: [C0]Oarfish[/C0], [C0]Gulper Eel[/C0], [C0]Goliath Tigerfish[/C0] and [C0]Coelacanth[/C0].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: So you've returned. I wasn't sure you were coming back.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: So you've returned. I wasn't sure you were coming back.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You drag the massive music box into the room, gouging the wooden floorboards beneath it. The Collector doesn't seem to mind. He's focused on the box.
rows.raw_text: You drag the massive music box into the room, gouging the wooden floorboards beneath it. The Collector doesn't seem to mind. He's focused on the box.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: You found this at the cliffs, didn't you?
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: You found this at the cliffs, didn't you?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Ah, excellent.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Ah, excellent.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I don't remember.
rows.raw_text: I don't remember.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Curious.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Curious.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: It doesn't matter.
rows.raw_text: It doesn't matter.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Now, there are yet more relics to find. Keep looking.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Now, there are yet more relics to find. Keep looking.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: This should make future return journeys a little more swift. Allow me.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: This should make future return journeys a little more swift. Allow me.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He selects one of the silver ribbons trailing from the crimson-bound book, opening it to some unseen page.
rows.raw_text: He selects one of the silver ribbons trailing from the crimson-bound book, opening it to some unseen page.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Turning to catch the dim light, he whispers the words on the page.
rows.raw_text: Turning to catch the dim light, he whispers the words on the page.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: After a few seconds, you feel your stomach drop suddenly, as though thrown high by a wave. He closes the book and turns his attention back to you.
rows.raw_text: After a few seconds, you feel your stomach drop suddenly, as though thrown high by a wave. He closes the book and turns his attention back to you.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: And with that, our collection is complete...I must admit, I am surprised. I did not think you had the determination for such a job.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: And with that, our collection is complete...I must admit, I am surprised. I did not think you had the determination for such a job.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: What is it?
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: What is it?

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: Anything else?
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: Anything else?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where should I look for relics?
rows.raw_text: Where should I look for relics?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Take a look at these trinkets.
rows.raw_text: Take a look at these trinkets.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing, I'll be going.
rows.raw_text: Nothing, I'll be going.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: [C0]You should ask around the towns in The Marrows[/C0]. Somebody is sure to know something.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: [C0]You should ask around the towns in The Marrows[/C0]. Somebody is sure to know something.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: My...intuition tells me that the current may have carried some debris to the [C0]South-East[/C0], towards [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]. Make that your priority.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: My...intuition tells me that the current may have carried some debris to the [C0]South-East[/C0], towards [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]. Make that your priority.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: The reef at [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0] may have caught and accumulated some wreckage. Search around that area.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: The reef at [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0] may have caught and accumulated some wreckage. Search around that area.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: I can imagine all manner of detritus swallowed by the silty muck of [C0]Twisted Strand's[/C0] channels. It's worth investigating.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: I can imagine all manner of detritus swallowed by the silty muck of [C0]Twisted Strand's[/C0] channels. It's worth investigating.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: I loathe to suggest it, but the abyssal plain on the approach to [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0] is a likely candidate. See what you can find.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: I loathe to suggest it, but the abyssal plain on the approach to [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0] is a likely candidate. See what you can find.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A burst of light fills your vision, and you stagger back briefly.
rows.raw_text: A burst of light fills your vision, and you stagger back briefly.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: He approaches! Drawing closer with...an incessant ticking. You have the pocket watch.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: He approaches! Drawing closer with...an incessant ticking. You have the pocket watch.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: The relics we're looking for are: a [C3]ring[/C3], a [C3]necklace[/C3], a [C3]watch[/C3], and a [C3]music box[/C3] and [C3]key[/C3].
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: The relics we're looking for are: a [C3]ring[/C3], a [C3]necklace[/C3], a [C3]watch[/C3], and a [C3]music box[/C3] and [C3]key[/C3].

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: I'll mark a location on your [C0]Map[/C0] where you can begin your search.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: I'll mark a location on your [C0]Map[/C0] where you can begin your search.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: I've already marked a location on your [C0]Map[/C0] where you can begin your search.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: I've already marked a location on your [C0]Map[/C0] where you can begin your search.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where can I catch a Conger Eel?
rows.raw_text: Where can I catch a Conger Eel?

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Ah yes, they can be tricky to find. I'm told they [C0]inhabit the holes and burrows within the cliffs[/C0] themselves.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Ah yes, they can be tricky to find. I'm told they [C0]inhabit the holes and burrows within the cliffs[/C0] themselves.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: I imagine they've been fished out around the edges, so [C0]you may have to venture into the passageways of the cliffs to find them[/C0].
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: I imagine they've been fished out around the edges, so [C0]you may have to venture into the passageways of the cliffs to find them[/C0].

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Oh, and did I mention that [C0]they only come out at night[/C0]? Yes, I believe they hide during the day.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Oh, and did I mention that [C0]they only come out at night[/C0]? Yes, I believe they hide during the day.

rows.speaker: Ingfell Resident
rows.text: Good luck.
rows.raw_text: INGFELL_RESIDENT_NAME_KEY: Good luck.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Is this your family crest?
rows.raw_text: Is this your family crest?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What am I supposed to be doing?
rows.raw_text: What am I supposed to be doing?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What am I supposed to be doing?
rows.raw_text: What am I supposed to be doing?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: It's not that simple. My brother would never...you see, I used to live in Ingfell with my brother. He was a Whaler, back in the day.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: It's not that simple. My brother would never...you see, I used to live in Ingfell with my brother. He was a Whaler, back in the day.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Things were bad. We fought a lot. Mostly about how our parents' inheritance should be divided. We were in the prime foolishness of our youth.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Things were bad. We fought a lot. Mostly about how our parents' inheritance should be divided. We were in the prime foolishness of our youth.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: When my wife and I decided to move here, I took the [C0]Family Crest[/C0]. I stole it from him. Now, after all this time...I can't return without it.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: When my wife and I decided to move here, I took the [C0]Family Crest[/C0]. I stole it from him. Now, after all this time...I can't return without it.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where is it?
rows.raw_text: Where is it?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: That's where the problem lies.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: That's where the problem lies.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Why don't you give it back to him then?
rows.raw_text: Why don't you give it back to him then?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Again. It's not as simple as that.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Again. It's not as simple as that.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: After the collapse...that creature...it dragged debris from the houses down into its wretched burrows. [C2]The crest went down with it[/C2].
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: After the collapse...that creature...it dragged debris from the houses down into its wretched burrows. [C2]The crest went down with it[/C2].

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: It's a lost cause, I know. But if you were to find it...it's a large, whale-bone crest. It would mean the world to me.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: It's a lost cause, I know. But if you were to find it...it's a large, whale-bone crest. It would mean the world to me.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'll look for it.
rows.raw_text: I'll look for it.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Thank you. But please - be careful.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Thank you. But please - be careful.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Don't get your hopes up.
rows.raw_text: Don't get your hopes up.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Oh, I won't.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Oh, I won't.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: You've found it! I never thought I'd see this beauty again.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: You've found it! I never thought I'd see this beauty again.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: But now...I have a further favor to ask. Would you take this to my brother at Ingfell?
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: But now...I have a further favor to ask. Would you take this to my brother at Ingfell?

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Tell him...tell him his brother is sorry, and would like to come home.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Tell him...tell him his brother is sorry, and would like to come home.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: You were going to keep an eye out for my [C0]Family Crest[/C0]. It was dragged into the tunnels by that creature.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: You were going to keep an eye out for my [C0]Family Crest[/C0]. It was dragged into the tunnels by that creature.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: You were going to take the [C0]Family Crest[/C0] to my brother at Ingfell and ask if he'll forgive me.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: You were going to take the [C0]Family Crest[/C0] to my brother at Ingfell and ask if he'll forgive me.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: He does? That's...a huge weight off my chest. One so old I hardly remembered it was there.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: He does? That's...a huge weight off my chest. One so old I hardly remembered it was there.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Well, here we are-
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Well, here we are-

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Hermit notices the old Whaler standing on the dock, waiting for him.
rows.raw_text: The Hermit notices the old Whaler standing on the dock, waiting for him.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Little brother. You're home.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Little brother. You're home.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: I - I'm so sorry. I was so foolish.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: I - I'm so sorry. I was so foolish.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: We both were. Come on inside. Let me get your bags.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: We both were. Come on inside. Let me get your bags.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The two brothers walk away down the dock. One of them pauses for a moment and turns back to you.
rows.raw_text: The two brothers walk away down the dock. One of them pauses for a moment and turns back to you.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: My brother ditched us and moved on over to those cliffs, years ago. I suspect he's regretting his decision now, the devil.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: My brother ditched us and moved on over to those cliffs, years ago. I suspect he's regretting his decision now, the devil.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Gods...I haven't seen this since...hmmph. So he did take it. I knew it.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Gods...I haven't seen this since...hmmph. So he did take it. I knew it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: Your brother's sorry. Will you let him come home?
rows.raw_text: Your brother's sorry. Will you let him come home?

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Hmm. I don't know if...I was in a right state when he left.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Hmm. I don't know if...I was in a right state when he left.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He's in real trouble over there. Your brother needs to move back here.
rows.raw_text: He's in real trouble over there. Your brother needs to move back here.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: I bet he is. Maybe I can clear the...hmm.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: I bet he is. Maybe I can clear the...hmm.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Ok. Fine. He can stay in my old workshop, at least for the time being. But I'll need some time to clear it out.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Ok. Fine. He can stay in my old workshop, at least for the time being. But I'll need some time to clear it out.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: While I'm doing that, perhaps you can do something for me.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: While I'm doing that, perhaps you can do something for me.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Oh, stranger. If you find any more debris that needs clearing...I'm working on making some more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0].
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Oh, stranger. If you find any more debris that needs clearing...I'm working on making some more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0].

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I believe this crest is yours.
rows.raw_text: I believe this crest is yours.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The old Whaler is waiting for you by the docks.
rows.raw_text: The old Whaler is waiting for you by the docks.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: There's something I forgot to mention last time we spoke.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: There's something I forgot to mention last time we spoke.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: If you find any more debris that needs clearing...I've got more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0] out the back.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: If you find any more debris that needs clearing...I've got more [C0]Packed Explosives[/C0] out the back.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Come by the old [C0]Whaling Yards[/C0] if you need it.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Come by the old [C0]Whaling Yards[/C0] if you need it.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Oh, and any news from my brother? Don't tell me he's hiding below deck. I'm not still mad at him - I promise!
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Oh, and any news from my brother? Don't tell me he's hiding below deck. I'm not still mad at him - I promise!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm so sorry. He was lost overboard.
rows.raw_text: I'm so sorry. He was lost overboard.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Wh- what? No...how could...
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Wh- what? No...how could...

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He stands in silence for quite some time.
rows.raw_text: He stands in silence for quite some time.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: At least...at least the crest is home. He always loved that thing.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: At least...at least the crest is home. He always loved that thing.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: When he was a kid, he'd take it off the wall and just look at it. Dad gave him a belting every time.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: When he was a kid, he'd take it off the wall and just look at it. Dad gave him a belting every time.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: I was never mad that he took it. I was just upset that he left. And I...I should've made more of an effort to fix things.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: I was never mad that he took it. I was just upset that he left. And I...I should've made more of an effort to fix things.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He decided to stay on the cliffs.
rows.raw_text: He decided to stay on the cliffs.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Oh. Well...let him know that he's always welcome to change his mind. I'll keep the room made up for him.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Oh. Well...let him know that he's always welcome to change his mind. I'll keep the room made up for him.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He wanted to move elsewhere.
rows.raw_text: He wanted to move elsewhere.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Oh. Well...I'm glad he moved on, at least. I understand him not wanting to come back here. Too many memories, and all that.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Oh. Well...I'm glad he moved on, at least. I understand him not wanting to come back here. Too many memories, and all that.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Thanks for what you've done, all the same. It was...some form of help, in the end.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Thanks for what you've done, all the same. It was...some form of help, in the end.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He walks away down the dock, crestfallen.
rows.raw_text: He walks away down the dock, crestfallen.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A pile of loose debris. It could be cleared to make a shortcut.
rows.raw_text: A pile of loose debris. It could be cleared to make a shortcut.

rows.raw_text: \[Use explosives.\]

rows.text: A pile of loose debris. Clearing this would take some strong explosives.
rows.raw_text: A pile of loose debris. Clearing this would take some strong explosives.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You set the charge and light the fuse...

rows.speaker: Unattributed

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The debris crumbles away. You should let the Whaler know.
rows.raw_text: The debris crumbles away. You should let the Whaler know.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You stand in the center of a campsite. The fire's embers are cool, but ash is still steadily blowing out with the wind.
rows.raw_text: You stand in the center of a campsite. The fire's embers are cool, but ash is still steadily blowing out with the wind.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you want to do?
rows.raw_text: What do you want to do?

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Take a closer look at the campfire.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Take a closer look at the campfire.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Look for footprints.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Look for footprints.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Check the makeshift tent.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Check the makeshift tent.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A large flat rock sits atop the charred wood of the campfire. A handful of tiny fish bones can be seen poking out of the ashes.
rows.raw_text: A large flat rock sits atop the charred wood of the campfire. A handful of tiny fish bones can be seen poking out of the ashes.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You find no footprints, but unfamiliar symbols have been sketched in the dust nearby. Some have been erased with the hasty sweep of a foot.
rows.raw_text: You find no footprints, but unfamiliar symbols have been sketched in the dust nearby. Some have been erased with the hasty sweep of a foot.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The tent is a sheet of cloth suspended over some sticks. There is nothing inside, save for a smoothed hollow in the dirt where someone slept.
rows.raw_text: The tent is a sheet of cloth suspended over some sticks. There is nothing inside, save for a smoothed hollow in the dirt where someone slept.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Is this it?
rows.raw_text: Is this it?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've come to pick you up.
rows.raw_text: I've come to pick you up.

rows.speaker: Shipwright
rows.text: You sure you don't need it? Well, come back if you change your mind.
rows.raw_text: SHIPWRIGHT_NAME_KEY: You sure you don't need it? Well, come back if you change your mind.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I accept.
rows.raw_text: I accept.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Let me think about it.
rows.raw_text: Let me think about it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A slab of rock juts from the water, bearing crude symbols of [C0]curved fish[/C0]. At its base, a rough shape has been chiselled away.
rows.raw_text: A slab of rock juts from the water, bearing crude symbols of [C0]curved fish[/C0]. At its base, a rough shape has been chiselled away.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A wave washes over the fish, sweeping them away. When the water recedes, you notice something has lodged against the rock.
rows.raw_text: A wave washes over the fish, sweeping them away. When the water recedes, you notice something has lodged against the rock.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, hello again. What do you need?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, hello again. What do you need?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: About those specimens you're after...
rows.raw_text: About those specimens you're after...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: About those specimens you're after...
rows.raw_text: About those specimens you're after...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I have those Prototype Parts you asked for.
rows.raw_text: I have those Prototype Parts you asked for.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I need a Sampling Device.
rows.raw_text: I need a Sampling Device.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I can take that Repulsion Machine now.
rows.raw_text: I can take that Repulsion Machine now.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about yourself.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about yourself.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What sort of creature attacked you?
rows.raw_text: What sort of creature attacked you?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have you noticed anything else unusual since you arrived?
rows.raw_text: Have you noticed anything else unusual since you arrived?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing, I'll be going now.
rows.raw_text: Nothing, I'll be going now.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Is there anything else?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Is there anything else?

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, um, hello - I wasn't expecting visitors. Who are you?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, um, hello - I wasn't expecting visitors. Who are you?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm a fisherman.
rows.raw_text: I'm a fisherman.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Ah yes, I thought you had the look. But a fisherman all the way out here? Strange.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Ah yes, I thought you had the look. But a fisherman all the way out here? Strange.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm a sightseer.
rows.raw_text: I'm a sightseer.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: A sightseer - and a fisherman, I presume? I noted the fishing vessel as you docked.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: A sightseer - and a fisherman, I presume? I noted the fishing vessel as you docked.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm nobody.
rows.raw_text: I'm nobody.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I struggle to believe that! Your ship looks like a fisherman's, and you - you look as though...
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I struggle to believe that! Your ship looks like a fisherman's, and you - you look as though...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She looks you up and down, and her voice cracks. She trails off.
rows.raw_text: She looks you up and down, and her voice cracks. She trails off.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you, all the same. I've not seen another soul in months. In fact, I could do with your help, if you had the time...
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you, all the same. I've not seen another soul in months. In fact, I could do with your help, if you had the time...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you need help with?
rows.raw_text: What do you need help with?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I need to get going.
rows.raw_text: I need to get going.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I need help collecting samples to study. I was originally posted at the [C0]Research Outpost[/C0] on the interior of the basin. But it was [C2]attacked[/C2].
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I need help collecting samples to study. I was originally posted at the [C0]Research Outpost[/C0] on the interior of the basin. But it was [C2]attacked[/C2].

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: A [C0]large creature[/C0] emerged from the depths and destroyed the outpost. Now it rests in the center of the basin.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: A [C0]large creature[/C0] emerged from the depths and destroyed the outpost. Now it rests in the center of the basin.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I fled here and have been making do as best I can. But I had to leave most of my equipment behind, so now my research has come to a halt.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I fled here and have been making do as best I can. But I had to leave most of my equipment behind, so now my research has come to a halt.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Take a look at the list of specimens I need - please drop them off here. You might need to [C0]experiment with different fishing strategies[/C0] to collect all of them.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Take a look at the list of specimens I need - please drop them off here. You might need to [C0]experiment with different fishing strategies[/C0] to collect all of them.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Very well then...
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Very well then...

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Ah, you're back. Did you have time to discuss that matter?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Ah, you're back. Did you have time to discuss that matter?

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Thank you, looks like you've caught all of the surface specimens I need.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Thank you, looks like you've caught all of the surface specimens I need.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: But ah, yes, I do also need some from...deeper down. But that's going to be a problem.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: But ah, yes, I do also need some from...deeper down. But that's going to be a problem.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Why is that a problem?
rows.raw_text: Why is that a problem?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I don't have the equipment to catch anything deeper anyway.
rows.raw_text: I don't have the equipment to catch anything deeper anyway.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I developed a device to retrieve samples from the [C0]Abyssal[/C0] zone. This was over in the other [C0]Research Outpost[C0]. Before the attack.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I developed a device to retrieve samples from the [C0]Abyssal[/C0] zone. This was over in the other [C0]Research Outpost[C0]. Before the attack.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I have an idea of how to keep the creature at bay long enough to collect these samples. But while I work on that, I need you to retrieve some [C0]Prototype Parts[/C0].
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I have an idea of how to keep the creature at bay long enough to collect these samples. But while I work on that, I need you to retrieve some [C0]Prototype Parts[/C0].

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Carefully. I suggest you go during the day. I wouldn't want to be out on the reef at night.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Carefully. I suggest you go during the day. I wouldn't want to be out on the reef at night.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Excellent. Let me assemble a device for you...
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Excellent. Let me assemble a device for you...

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: [C1]This should allow you to catch specimens from much greater depths[C1]. It's a little slow, but [C0]you may be able to make some improvements[/C0].
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: [C1]This should allow you to catch specimens from much greater depths[C1]. It's a little slow, but [C0]you may be able to make some improvements[/C0].

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, no room on board? You can come by for it later.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, no room on board? You can come by for it later.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Now, I've developed a [C0]Repulsion Machine[/C0] that produces a bright light and emits a high pitched noise -- [C0]it should deter the creature from attacking[/C0]. Or enrage it, I'm not sure.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Now, I've developed a [C0]Repulsion Machine[/C0] that produces a bright light and emits a high pitched noise -- [C0]it should deter the creature from attacking[/C0]. Or enrage it, I'm not sure.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Connect it to the [C0]Research Outpost's Generator[/C0]. You'll have to return and re-engage it every few hours, but other than that, it's completely automated.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Connect it to the [C0]Research Outpost's Generator[/C0]. You'll have to return and re-engage it every few hours, but other than that, it's completely automated.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Great. Now, take a look at the list of specimens.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Great. Now, take a look at the list of specimens.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, no room on board? You can come by for it later.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, no room on board? You can come by for it later.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Remember, you'll want to [C0]install and activate the Machine[/C0] before attempting to collect these. You might also need to [C0]improve that equipment I gave you to catch some of these[/C0].
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Remember, you'll want to [C0]install and activate the Machine[/C0] before attempting to collect these. You might also need to [C0]improve that equipment I gave you to catch some of these[/C0].

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I have good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I have good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The good news.
rows.raw_text: The good news.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The bad news.
rows.raw_text: The bad news.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: The good news is that I've honed in on what's causing the abnormalities in the ecosystem.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: The good news is that I've honed in on what's causing the abnormalities in the ecosystem.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: The bad news is that the samples you retrieved from the basin have dangerously high counts of cellular mutations.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: The bad news is that the samples you retrieved from the basin have dangerously high counts of cellular mutations.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: This all points to one thing: that thing in the basin is [C2]harmful to life at a cellular level[/C2]. It damages everything around it, whether passively or...with intent.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: This all points to one thing: that thing in the basin is [C2]harmful to life at a cellular level[/C2]. It damages everything around it, whether passively or...with intent.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I need to write up a report on my findings - sorry, our findings - immediately. Maybe now they'll take me seriously.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I need to write up a report on my findings - sorry, our findings - immediately. Maybe now they'll take me seriously.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Thanks again for your help. I'd recommend that you avoid the area. It doesn't seem safe to be near the basin.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Thanks again for your help. I'd recommend that you avoid the area. It doesn't seem safe to be near the basin.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Uh, ok - I don't think there's much to say...I studied Biological Sciences at Ironhaven college. It was a struggle.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Uh, ok - I don't think there's much to say...I studied Biological Sciences at Ironhaven college. It was a struggle.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: There were no other female students in the department that year. Or the year before, or the year before that.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: There were no other female students in the department that year. Or the year before, or the year before that.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: It's hard not to feel like an outsider in an environment like that, you know? You probably don't.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: It's hard not to feel like an outsider in an environment like that, you know? You probably don't.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: When I graduated, I managed to land a job at the Northern Biological Research Society. And then, well, I was posted here. By myself.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: When I graduated, I managed to land a job at the Northern Biological Research Society. And then, well, I was posted here. By myself.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The [C0]Repulsion Machine[/C0] you installed is still connected to the Generator.
