rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A large man is watching you through the billowing smoke of a campfire, idly carving away at a wooden stake. He stands as you pull ashore.
rows.raw_text: A large man is watching you through the billowing smoke of a campfire, idly carving away at a wooden stake. He stands as you pull ashore.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Stranger. From that look on your face I'd say you've encountered the local [C3]wretches[/C3]. Take a seat.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Stranger. From that look on your face I'd say you've encountered the local [C3]wretches[/C3]. Take a seat.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You join him by the fire.
rows.raw_text: You join him by the fire.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I've been trying to rid them from this accursed jungle ever since we wrecked here.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I've been trying to rid them from this accursed jungle ever since we wrecked here.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I'd ask you for safe passage away from here, but not until after I've [C0]avenged my squadron[/C0].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I'd ask you for safe passage away from here, but not until after I've [C0]avenged my squadron[/C0].

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What happened to them?
rows.raw_text: What happened to them?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: A number of us went down in the fog, crashing into trees or ditching into the water. Those that survived rallied here, under the boughs of this giant tree.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: A number of us went down in the fog, crashing into trees or ditching into the water. Those that survived rallied here, under the boughs of this giant tree.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: But it offered us scant protection. Before help could arrive, our numbers quickly dwindled. Picked off by the fiends and the forest.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: But it offered us scant protection. Before help could arrive, our numbers quickly dwindled. Picked off by the fiends and the forest.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I'm listening.
rows.raw_text: I'm listening.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I've met a few would-be rescuers over the years. But none would help me in my fight. Are you any different to the rest?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I've met a few would-be rescuers over the years. But none would help me in my fight. Are you any different to the rest?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I can help.
rows.raw_text: I can help.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I expected as such. Stay safe, if you can.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I expected as such. Stay safe, if you can.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Fisherman. Have you found your courage?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Fisherman. Have you found your courage?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Yes, I can help you.
rows.raw_text: Yes, I can help you.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Not right now.
rows.raw_text: Not right now.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Hmmph. Be off with you, then.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Hmmph. Be off with you, then.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I figured you'd be up for it. You...you have the look. Listen up.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I figured you'd be up for it. You...you have the look. Listen up.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: First, we need to [C0]find the lost pieces of my squadron's mortar[/C0]. We'll then use that to bombard the beasts.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: First, we need to [C0]find the lost pieces of my squadron's mortar[/C0]. We'll then use that to bombard the beasts.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Other planes went down to the [C0]North[/C0] and [C0]East[/C0] of where we are now. I'll mark the possible crash sites on your map, you go and see what you can salvage.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Other planes went down to the [C0]North[/C0] and [C0]East[/C0] of where we are now. I'll mark the possible crash sites on your map, you go and see what you can salvage.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Hmm?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Hmm?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Can you make up some Bait for me?
rows.raw_text: Can you make up some Bait for me?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What will you do now?
rows.raw_text: What will you do now?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I have a creature corpse to show you.
rows.raw_text: I have a creature corpse to show you.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Let's talk about baiting the traps.
rows.raw_text: Let's talk about baiting the traps.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've found parts of the mortar.
rows.raw_text: I've found parts of the mortar.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What am I supposed to be doing?
rows.raw_text: What am I supposed to be doing?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are there any shipwrecks around here?
rows.raw_text: Are there any shipwrecks around here?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about the 'Mind Suckers'.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about the 'Mind Suckers'.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: That's everything.
rows.raw_text: That's everything.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Shipwrecks? No. Anything that meets its end here is quickly swallowed by the silt.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Shipwrecks? No. Anything that meets its end here is quickly swallowed by the silt.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Devilish creatures, through and through. They'll stalk you along the waterways and emerge suddenly, [C3]screeching their terrible song[/C3].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Devilish creatures, through and through. They'll stalk you along the waterways and emerge suddenly, [C3]screeching their terrible song[/C3].

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: You need to [C0]find the lost pieces of my squadron's mortar[/C0]. I've marked some locations to search on your map. Let me know how you get on.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: You need to [C0]find the lost pieces of my squadron's mortar[/C0]. I've marked some locations to search on your map. Let me know how you get on.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: You've found one component, but it's still missing a piece. Nearly there; keep looking.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: You've found one component, but it's still missing a piece. Nearly there; keep looking.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: That's the lot. Now, while I work on assembling the mortar, you can get started on the next phase of the plan.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: That's the lot. Now, while I work on assembling the mortar, you can get started on the next phase of the plan.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: You may have noticed some [C0]contraptions[/C0] in the lagoons around here. I've assembled those traps for the [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3]. We just need to [C0]lure them in[/C0] there.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: You may have noticed some [C0]contraptions[/C0] in the lagoons around here. I've assembled those traps for the [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3]. We just need to [C0]lure them in[/C0] there.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Once they're in, you see, I can [C1]fire on them with our new mortar[/C1]. And that'll be the end of them. No more nightmares.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Once they're in, you see, I can [C1]fire on them with our new mortar[/C1]. And that'll be the end of them. No more nightmares.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I'll mark the locations of the traps on your map. Got it?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I'll mark the locations of the traps on your map. Got it?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Have you got everything?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Have you got everything?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: How do we get the Mind Suckers into the traps?
rows.raw_text: How do we get the Mind Suckers into the traps?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: They're attracted to some very specific types of [C1]Bait[/C1]. Your skills will come in handy here yet again.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: They're attracted to some very specific types of [C1]Bait[/C1]. Your skills will come in handy here yet again.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Is it safe?
rows.raw_text: Is it safe?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Of course not.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Of course not.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: How did you make those traps?
rows.raw_text: How did you make those traps?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: With patience. The [C0]creatures only seem to sense movement[/C0]. So whenever one was close, I froze.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: With patience. The [C0]creatures only seem to sense movement[/C0]. So whenever one was close, I froze.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I understand. So what's next?
rows.raw_text: I understand. So what's next?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: We need to [C0]make three special Baits[/C0] from different combinations of fish.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: We need to [C0]make three special Baits[/C0] from different combinations of fish.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Did you want to know anything else about the [C0]Bait[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Did you want to know anything else about the [C0]Bait[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Let's discuss the Bait for the first one.
rows.raw_text: Let's discuss the Bait for the first one.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Let's discuss the Bait for the second one.
rows.raw_text: Let's discuss the Bait for the second one.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Let's discuss the Bait for the last one.
rows.raw_text: Let's discuss the Bait for the last one.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Where do I put the Bait?
rows.raw_text: Where do I put the Bait?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: In one of the [C0]traps[/C0] I've constructed in the lagoons. They're marked on your [C0]Map[/C0].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: In one of the [C0]traps[/C0] I've constructed in the lagoons. They're marked on your [C0]Map[/C0].

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: That's all for now.
rows.raw_text: That's all for now.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: This one takes [C0]three fish[/C0] from the area to make.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: This one takes [C0]three fish[/C0] from the area to make.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: This one needs [C0]two fish[/C0] from the area to make.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: This one needs [C0]two fish[/C0] from the area to make.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: This one requires [C0]two fish[/C0] from the area to make.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: This one requires [C0]two fish[/C0] from the area to make.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: That should do it. I'll just mix these in...here. [C0]Load this into a trap[/C0], then get well clear from it.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: [C2]I don't have all the fish for that bait yet[/C2]. Come back when you've got the rest.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: [C2]I don't have all the fish for that bait yet[/C2]. Come back when you've got the rest.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A large cage is suspended over the water. A small receptacle is floating underneath.
rows.raw_text: A large cage is suspended over the water. A small receptacle is floating underneath.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Load the trap with Bait.
rows.raw_text: Load the trap with Bait.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Leave it alone.
rows.raw_text: Leave it alone.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You load the [C0]Bait[/C0] into the trap. You should probably move away.
rows.raw_text: You load the [C0]Bait[/C0] into the trap. You should probably move away.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: This trap has been baited. Better get to a safe distance and wait.
rows.raw_text: This trap has been baited. Better get to a safe distance and wait.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: Inside is the obliterated corpse of a [C3]Mind Sucker[/C3]. The Airman will be expecting proof of your success.
rows.raw_text: Inside is the obliterated corpse of a [C3]Mind Sucker[/C3]. The Airman will be expecting proof of your success.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The rest of the carcass sinks out of sight.
rows.raw_text: The rest of the carcass sinks out of sight.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You leave it in there for now.
rows.raw_text: You leave it in there for now.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A mangled mess of wood and wire. The trap itself was re-usable, but not after being hit by a mortar.
rows.raw_text: A mangled mess of wood and wire. The trap itself was re-usable, but not after being hit by a mortar.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Let's see it then.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Let's see it then.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You hand the tattered lump of flesh to the Airman. It's almost unrecognizable, but you both know it couldn't have belonged to anything else.
rows.raw_text: You hand the tattered lump of flesh to the Airman. It's almost unrecognizable, but you both know it couldn't have belonged to anything else.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He pokes at it with his knife, testing the rubbery meat. He seems satisfied.
rows.raw_text: He pokes at it with his knife, testing the rubbery meat. He seems satisfied.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Yes...this is one of the beasts. Progress at last. More to go, though.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Yes...this is one of the beasts. Progress at last. More to go, though.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You drop the flesh onto the ground and he gives it a few slashes with the knife. It wobbles a little.
rows.raw_text: You drop the flesh onto the ground and he gives it a few slashes with the knife. It wobbles a little.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Another one taken care of. One remains, by my count. Let's finish this.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Another one taken care of. One remains, by my count. Let's finish this.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You drop the large, bloodied carcass in front of the Airman. His eyes fill with sadistic delight.
rows.raw_text: You drop the large, bloodied carcass in front of the Airman. His eyes fill with sadistic delight.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He bends down and plunges his knife into the soft flesh. It falls away before the blade, revealing a [C3]glint of metal[/C3].
rows.raw_text: He bends down and plunges his knife into the soft flesh. It falls away before the blade, revealing a [C3]glint of metal[/C3].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With a sickening tear, he wrests it from where it was embedded in the flesh of the creature. He holds it aloft. You recognize it as a [C3]necklace[/C3], glistening in gore.
rows.raw_text: With a sickening tear, he wrests it from where it was embedded in the flesh of the creature. He holds it aloft. You recognize it as a [C3]necklace[/C3], glistening in gore.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Well fisherman, some fortune at last. This ought to fetch a decent price from the right collector. Here, why don't you take it.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Well fisherman, some fortune at last. This ought to fetch a decent price from the right collector. Here, why don't you take it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He stands back from the corpse. A melancholic look comes over his face.
rows.raw_text: He stands back from the corpse. A melancholic look comes over his face.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: And now...well, that's that, I suppose.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: And now...well, that's that, I suppose.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Oh, you have more?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Oh, you have more?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I can't say for sure. I thought I'd be asking you for an escort away from this place, but...this has become somewhat of a home to me.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I can't say for sure. I thought I'd be asking you for an escort away from this place, but...this has become somewhat of a home to me.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: It doesn't feel right to leave my brothers here. I think I shall stay a while longer.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: It doesn't feel right to leave my brothers here. I think I shall stay a while longer.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: In the meantime, I can make up some special [C0]Bait[/C0] for you. [C1]It ought to help with your fishing[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: In the meantime, I can make up some special [C0]Bait[/C0] for you. [C1]It ought to help with your fishing[/C1].

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I'll need some fish from you first. Any type will do - but [C1]the more you give me, the more Bait I can make[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I'll need some fish from you first. Any type will do - but [C1]the more you give me, the more Bait I can make[/C1].

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Let me just grind these up...won't be a moment...
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Let me just grind these up...won't be a moment...

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: This is what I could make. Take it all; it won't keep here.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: This is what I could make. Take it all; it won't keep here.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: [C2]You didn't give me enough fish[/C2], so I can't make up any [C0]Bait[/C0] for you.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: [C2]You didn't give me enough fish[/C2], so I can't make up any [C0]Bait[/C0] for you.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: The boys called them [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3], on account of them, well...affecting the mind. They made us see things...do things...
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: The boys called them [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3], on account of them, well...affecting the mind. They made us see things...do things...

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: The first time it happened to me I saw...shadows of my squadmates. Reaching out to me in a feverish dream.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: The first time it happened to me I saw...shadows of my squadmates. Reaching out to me in a feverish dream.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: When I finally snapped out of it, I was covered in bloodied scratches - they must've sent me running through the foliage.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: When I finally snapped out of it, I was covered in bloodied scratches - they must've sent me running through the foliage.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Since then I've done my best to avoid the fiends. [C0]Their senses seem to be based on movement[/C0], so move carefully.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Since then I've done my best to avoid the fiends. [C0]Their senses seem to be based on movement[/C0], so move carefully.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: They go crazy for that stuff - day, night, it doesn't seem to matter. All sorts of fish usually show up.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: They go crazy for that stuff - day, night, it doesn't seem to matter. All sorts of fish usually show up.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A crooked boulder with a small, simple platform at its base. The [C0]twisted shape of a deformed fish[/C0] is barely recognizable, carved into the rockface.
rows.raw_text: A crooked boulder with a small, simple platform at its base. The [C0]twisted shape of a deformed fish[/C0] is barely recognizable, carved into the rockface.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The waves lap up to the platform where you laid the aberration. As the water makes contact with it, a buzzing sound fills the air.
rows.raw_text: The waves lap up to the platform where you laid the aberration. As the water makes contact with it, a buzzing sound fills the air.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: How will you honor your squadmates?
rows.raw_text: How will you honor your squadmates?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I found some dog tags.
rows.raw_text: I found some dog tags.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Why were you wanting dog tags again?
rows.raw_text: Why were you wanting dog tags again?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I've hung a few of their [C0]Dog Tags[/C0] up on the tree behind me. It seemed fitting enough.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I've hung a few of their [C0]Dog Tags[/C0] up on the tree behind me. It seemed fitting enough.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: But I've only got tags from the ones I...you must understand...I never found all of their bodies.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: But I've only got tags from the ones I...you must understand...I never found all of their bodies.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: If you happened to [C0]find any of their Dog Tags[/C0], I could add them to the tree with their brothers.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: If you happened to [C0]find any of their Dog Tags[/C0], I could add them to the tree with their brothers.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I have a number of mechanical doodads that you might find useful. Here, take this one - in good faith. [C1]I'll give you more for each tag you bring me[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I have a number of mechanical doodads that you might find useful. Here, take this one - in good faith. [C1]I'll give you more for each tag you bring me[/C1].

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Let me see.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Let me see.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I...thank you. I'll hang them on the tree. Here, as promised.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I...thank you. I'll hang them on the tree. Here, as promised.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Come back when you've actually got something to show me.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Come back when you've actually got something to show me.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: I want to hang the Dog Tags of my fallen squadmates on the tree behind me. [C1]I'll give you some componentry for each tag you bring me[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: I want to hang the Dog Tags of my fallen squadmates on the tree behind me. [C1]I'll give you some componentry for each tag you bring me[/C1].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You see a campsite. Some old fish are suspended on a spit over a fire that was never lit. A pile of fabric is gathered at the base of a large tree nearby.

rows.raw_text: OLD_MAYOR_NAME_KEY: It cloaks that calamitous thing...it's evil, haven't you felt it?

rows.speaker: Old Mayor
rows.text: She saw it all. That ruinous day.
rows.raw_text: OLD_MAYOR_NAME_KEY: She saw it all. That ruinous day.

rows.speaker: Old Mayor
rows.text: Ask her. Beg her. Tell her I...
rows.raw_text: OLD_MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Ask her. Beg her. Tell her I...

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: He trails off, his face collapsing in sorrow.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You enter the house, carrying the ornate necklace. The Collector recognizes it almost immediately.
rows.raw_text: You enter the house, carrying the ornate necklace. The Collector recognizes it almost immediately.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: An excellent find. It demands pride of place in my collection.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: An excellent find. It demands pride of place in my collection.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text

rows.raw_text: He sweeps aside some scraps on a dusty table, candle wax pooling in its corners. He places the necklace carefully in the clearing.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: And I suppose you'll be demanding recompense as well...
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: And I suppose you'll be demanding recompense as well...

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Once more he opens the book, dust pouring from the pages as he reads aloud. You begin to feel weak, but you're rooted to the spot - knees on the verge of buckling.
rows.raw_text: Once more he opens the book, dust pouring from the pages as he reads aloud. You begin to feel weak, but you're rooted to the spot - knees on the verge of buckling.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: As he finishes speaking you feel blood rushing back to your legs. A strange feeling of power grows in your chest.
rows.raw_text: As he finishes speaking you feel blood rushing back to your legs. A strange feeling of power grows in your chest.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: We're...so close. One more remains.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: We're...so close. One more remains.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label

rows.speaker: Player (choice)

rows.speaker: Player (choice)

rows.raw_text: How do you know where these relics are?

rows.text: Are you...human?
rows.raw_text: Are you...human?

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: The ocean no longer wishes to...cooperate. As the waves are unsafe for me, you will be my surrogate.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: The ocean no longer wishes to...cooperate. As the waves are unsafe for me, you will be my surrogate.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He ponders for a moment.
rows.raw_text: He ponders for a moment.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: It's surprising, isn't it? The attachments we hold towards simple objects. But they are anything but simple. Seemingly mute articles can speak in different ways.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: It's surprising, isn't it? The attachments we hold towards simple objects. But they are anything but simple. Seemingly mute articles can speak in different ways.

rows.speaker: Collector

rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: If I showed you a childhood toy, you would be awash with forgotten memories.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: They hold the power to recall what was once lost.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: They hold the power to recall what was once lost.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: That stuttering old fool...yes, I knew him. He'd join us on the water sometimes, but was more hindrance than help.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: That stuttering old fool...yes, I knew him. He'd join us on the water sometimes, but was more hindrance than help.

rows.speaker: Collector
rows.text: He never seemed entirely with it. I can't imagine he has fared too well since I last saw him.
rows.raw_text: COLLECTOR_NAME_KEY: He never seemed entirely with it. I can't imagine he has fared too well since I last saw him.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: Your inquiry is met with a piercing gaze.

rows.speaker: Collector

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Anything else?

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: O rapturous day, a fresh disciple carried to me atop the waves! Come ashore, weak thing, and rest your weary soul.

rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Uh, alright.
rows.raw_text: Uh, alright.

rows.text: Your arrival is providence from the deep itself! I have been calling...and now, you are the answer.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Your arrival is providence from the deep itself! I have been calling...and now, you are the answer.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: The rite of purification is almost at hand, and you are to be my replacement.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: The rite of purification is almost at hand, and you are to be my replacement.

rows.speaker: Fanatic

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: The rite of purification is...overdue. Are you ready to begin?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label

rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label

rows.raw_text: I should get going.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: The sea will return you to me in time.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: The sea will return you to me in time.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: Your trial begins immediately. Tell me, what does your spirit seek?
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Your trial begins immediately. Tell me, what does your spirit seek?

rows.raw_text: Happiness.

rows.speaker: Fanatic

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Hah! Merely an excuse to halt the search for something greater. Happiness is, by definition, a compromise.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: Sadness.

rows.speaker: Unattributed

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Yes. A pure vessel. Only those devoid of mortality can ascend past it.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: The sting of the salt.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Pain is a trick of the flesh. Do not surrender to it.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: The chill of the water.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: I sense it in you...a glimmer of what waits below.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer

rows.raw_text: Everything.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: In a way. It deserves all that is washed ashore - freely given from the deep. But no more than that.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Nothing.
rows.raw_text: Nothing.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: Exactly. And yet it takes, endlessly. Harvesting, draining. But soon it will know that it has taken too much. It is already too late.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Exactly. And yet it takes, endlessly. Harvesting, draining. But soon it will know that it has taken too much. It is already too late.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: The trial is concluded. You still have much to learn. But that knowledge will be delivered to you in time.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: The trial is concluded. You still have much to learn. But that knowledge will be delivered to you in time.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: Now. Your role, as my initiate, is to act as [C0]Herald of the Purge[/C0]. Just as I was, for the one before me.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Now. Your role, as my initiate, is to act as [C0]Herald of the Purge[/C0]. Just as I was, for the one before me.

rows.speaker: Fanatic
rows.text: The nearby spires blaze with eternal fire, yet the stone hearths of these three idols lie barren and void.
rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: The nearby spires blaze with eternal fire, yet the stone hearths of these three idols lie barren and void.

rows.speaker: Fanatic

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Retrieve [C3]three Fathomless Flames[/C3] from the crags behind us and ignite the crucibles.

rows.speaker: Fanatic

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Visit the [C0]Shrines of the Deep[/C0]. I will mark them. They will offer further guidance - and I must provide no more.

rows.speaker: Fanatic

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: I can see that. But we cannot proceed in darkness - all three must be lit.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: Ahh. I can feel it. The chill of the deep touches us now. It is time. Come.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: You are drawn to it too, I see. It found me during my rite of proving as I scavenged for creatures of power.

rows.raw_text: FANATIC_NAME_KEY: It sapped at my spirit when I first recovered it. But I came to appreciate its strange nourishment, with time.

rows.speaker: Trader
rows.text: It opened a door in that ruined lighthouse? Yes, that makes sense... Well, I hope you found some interesting items for me to take a look at!
rows.raw_text: TRADER_NAME_KEY: It opened a door in that ruined lighthouse? Yes, that makes sense... Well, I hope you found some interesting items for me to take a look at!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Next to the dock is a derelict campsite. Strange symbols are scratched into the sand. What do you want to do?
rows.raw_text: Next to the dock is a derelict campsite. Strange symbols are scratched into the sand. What do you want to do?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you want to do?
rows.raw_text: What do you want to do?

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Search the campsite.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Search the campsite.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Inspect the symbols in the sand.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Inspect the symbols in the sand.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: An extremely rough and worn sheet of fabric is collapsed at the base of some wooden supports. There's nothing remarkable about it.
rows.raw_text: An extremely rough and worn sheet of fabric is collapsed at the base of some wooden supports. There's nothing remarkable about it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The symbols span the breadth of the camp, twisting this way and that. Some are grouped together into what must be words.
rows.raw_text: The symbols span the breadth of the camp, twisting this way and that. Some are grouped together into what must be words.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Fresh footprints tread carefully around each symbol. The last symbol trails off hurriedly and looks unfinished.
rows.raw_text: Fresh footprints tread carefully around each symbol. The last symbol trails off hurriedly and looks unfinished.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Inspect the last symbol more closely.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Inspect the last symbol more closely.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Inspect the footprints.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Inspect the footprints.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Go back.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Go back.\]

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: There's nothing else here.
rows.raw_text: There's nothing else here.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: A glint of metal shines up through the sand.
rows.raw_text: A glint of metal shines up through the sand.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You leave it alone for now.
rows.raw_text: You leave it alone for now.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You take it for yourself.
rows.raw_text: You take it for yourself.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Whoever left the footprints was barefoot. The prints are large and wide, perhaps indicating they were left by a man - but you don't know much about footprints.
rows.raw_text: Whoever left the footprints was barefoot. The prints are large and wide, perhaps indicating they were left by a man - but you don't know much about footprints.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: In the dim light of the cave you can make out some paintings on both walls.
rows.raw_text: In the dim light of the cave you can make out some paintings on both walls.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Check the left wall.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Check the left wall.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Check the right wall.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Check the right wall.\]

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: These paintings depict the birth of a civilization. A great beacon of light is shown repelling a tentacled figure emerging from the sea.
rows.raw_text: These paintings depict the birth of a civilization. A great beacon of light is shown repelling a tentacled figure emerging from the sea.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: These paintings depict the fall of a civilization. A volcanic eruption tears through a tall lighthouse. Monstrous shapes devour people as buildings turn to ruin.
rows.raw_text: These paintings depict the fall of a civilization. A volcanic eruption tears through a tall lighthouse. Monstrous shapes devour people as buildings turn to ruin.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I want to ask about the wider region.
rows.raw_text: I want to ask about the wider region.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Certainly. Is there somewhere in particular you wish to know more about?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Certainly. Is there somewhere in particular you wish to know more about?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Is there another area you'd like to discuss?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Is there another area you'd like to discuss?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Blackstone Isle.
rows.raw_text: Blackstone Isle.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Gale Cliffs.
rows.raw_text: Gale Cliffs.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Stellar Basin.
rows.raw_text: Stellar Basin.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Twisted Strand.
rows.raw_text: Twisted Strand.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Devil's Spine.
rows.raw_text: Devil's Spine.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: That's all for now.
rows.raw_text: That's all for now.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Hmm, I don't know a great deal. It technically falls under the jurisdiction of Little Marrow. I believe it was sold to a private owner some twenty years ago.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Hmm, I don't know a great deal. It technically falls under the jurisdiction of Little Marrow. I believe it was sold to a private owner some twenty years ago.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: They must've had a special arrangement - such a sale is quite uncommon. Very complicated paperwork involved, you see.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: They must've had a special arrangement - such a sale is quite uncommon. Very complicated paperwork involved, you see.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: I've not met the owner; I suspect they don't live around here. The island seems quite uninhabited.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: I've not met the owner; I suspect they don't live around here. The island seems quite uninhabited.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Well, the main port over there is a place called [C0]Ingfell[/C0]. It's right on the approach to the cliffs, you can't miss it.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Well, the main port over there is a place called [C0]Ingfell[/C0]. It's right on the approach to the cliffs, you can't miss it.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: It's a whaling town, but I haven't heard much talk of it these days. I think quite a few people have left, one way or another.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: It's a whaling town, but I haven't heard much talk of it these days. I think quite a few people have left, one way or another.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Quite a popular tourist destination. There's a resort on the atoll, built on top of a [C0]beautiful coral reef[C0].
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Quite a popular tourist destination. There's a resort on the atoll, built on top of a [C0]beautiful coral reef[C0].

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: I'm sure there's a wide variety of fish there. Maybe you fancy getting your hooks into some of those?
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: I'm sure there's a wide variety of fish there. Maybe you fancy getting your hooks into some of those?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Hmm, I don't think there's much to tell. It's just a tangled mass of trees.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Hmm, I don't think there's much to tell. It's just a tangled mass of trees.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: It's often blanketed in a thick fog, even during the day. You'd want some [C0]good lights[/C0] and a [C0]good sense of direction[/C0] if you're to go exploring there.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: It's often blanketed in a thick fog, even during the day. You'd want some [C0]good lights[/C0] and a [C0]good sense of direction[/C0] if you're to go exploring there.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Ah yes, it's quite exciting really. An active volcano amongst a city of ancient ruins!
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Ah yes, it's quite exciting really. An active volcano amongst a city of ancient ruins!

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: [C2]I must caution against sailing there, however[/C2]. The ruins lie low in the water and would surely tear through your hull.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: [C2]I must caution against sailing there, however[/C2]. The ruins lie low in the water and would surely tear through your hull.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Not to mention the aforementioned volcano could erupt at any moment! You can occasionally hear it rumbling from here.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Not to mention the aforementioned volcano could erupt at any moment! You can occasionally hear it rumbling from here.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Who lives on Blackstone Isle?
rows.raw_text: Who lives on Blackstone Isle?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's with the fog around here?
rows.raw_text: What's with the fog around here?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have you seen anything significant from the lighthouse recently?
rows.raw_text: Have you seen anything significant from the lighthouse recently?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've been finding relics for the Collector.
rows.raw_text: I've been finding relics for the Collector.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: I see a lot from up here, you know. I saw that ill-fated boat return. I chose to look the other way.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: I see a lot from up here, you know. I saw that ill-fated boat return. I chose to look the other way.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: I watched an unnatural glow flicker through those windows. Whatever you've got planned, I hope you know what you're doing out there.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: I watched an unnatural glow flicker through those windows. Whatever you've got planned, I hope you know what you're doing out there.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you ever process shipments for Blackstone Isle?
rows.raw_text: Do you ever process shipments for Blackstone Isle?

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: That old ruin? Doubt it. Uh, let's see.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: That old ruin? Doubt it. Uh, let's see.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He flicks through a large log book. It appears to be a record of shipping manifests.
rows.raw_text: He flicks through a large log book. It appears to be a record of shipping manifests.

rows.speaker: Dockworker
rows.text: Thought so. It doesn't even have a shipping address. As far as I know, nobody lives there.
rows.raw_text: DOCKWORKER_NAME_KEY: Thought so. It doesn't even have a shipping address. As far as I know, nobody lives there.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you know about Gale Cliffs?
rows.raw_text: What do you know about Gale Cliffs?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you think of Stellar Basin?
rows.raw_text: What do you think of Stellar Basin?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What can you tell me about Twisted Strand?
rows.raw_text: What can you tell me about Twisted Strand?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What was this place?
rows.raw_text: What was this place?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Well there's [C0]Ingfell[/C0] just across the bay, which is a dreary little whaling town. The folks there are always in need of something, which keeps me in business.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Well there's [C0]Ingfell[/C0] just across the bay, which is a dreary little whaling town. The folks there are always in need of something, which keeps me in business.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: The residents are always talking about the cliffs. Most seem afraid. Frankly, I'm not sure why they stay.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: The residents are always talking about the cliffs. Most seem afraid. Frankly, I'm not sure why they stay.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Occasionally I hear deep rumblings from within the rocks. I don't hang around here for long.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Occasionally I hear deep rumblings from within the rocks. I don't hang around here for long.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: What beautiful, crystalline water! It's a shame I can't take my boat too much further in - I've run aground on the coral a few times.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: What beautiful, crystalline water! It's a shame I can't take my boat too much further in - I've run aground on the coral a few times.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Have you checked out the abandoned resort to the [C0]East[/C0]? It's pretty impressive. There's probably some decent salvage to be had there.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Have you checked out the abandoned resort to the [C0]East[/C0]? It's pretty impressive. There's probably some decent salvage to be had there.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: It's kind of amazing how quickly it all falls to ruin without people around to maintain it. In a few years, these pontoons will probably go the same way.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: It's kind of amazing how quickly it all falls to ruin without people around to maintain it. In a few years, these pontoons will probably go the same way.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's just the way of things, I guess.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's just the way of things, I guess.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Not much, to be honest. I've gone inside just the once. I sailed into that lagoon behind us and saw I could go left, right, or straight ahead.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Not much, to be honest. I've gone inside just the once. I sailed into that lagoon behind us and saw I could go left, right, or straight ahead.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Something about the place seemed off. Through the fog, it looked like the trees were...[C3]moving[/C3]. I can't explain it. I turned around and sailed right back out.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Something about the place seemed off. Through the fog, it looked like the trees were...[C3]moving[/C3]. I can't explain it. I turned around and sailed right back out.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I sometimes use this spot to rest up for a few days - the sunrises are particularly striking through the haze. Never do any regular business here of course.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I sometimes use this spot to rest up for a few days - the sunrises are particularly striking through the haze. Never do any regular business here of course.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Some kind of ancient civilization must've lived here. Judging by the state of the buildings, things didn't go so well for them.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Some kind of ancient civilization must've lived here. Judging by the state of the buildings, things didn't go so well for them.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I can't imagine they built all this around an active volcano. So the volcano must've become active some time after they founded their city.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I can't imagine they built all this around an active volcano. So the volcano must've become active some time after they founded their city.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'd guess that the volcano caused them to leave - or wiped them out, one way or another.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'd guess that the volcano caused them to leave - or wiped them out, one way or another.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: All in all, it's a pretty inhospitable place. I'm not really sure why I come here.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: All in all, it's a pretty inhospitable place. I'm not really sure why I come here.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Nobody knows. It's changed recently. It lingers in the mornings now, where before...it didn't seem to have the strength.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Nobody knows. It's changed recently. It lingers in the mornings now, where before...it didn't seem to have the strength.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Even in the midday sun I feel it. A malice concealed in shadows, waiting for night to sweep the island.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Even in the midday sun I feel it. A malice concealed in shadows, waiting for night to sweep the island.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: She glances up at the lighthouse.
rows.raw_text: She glances up at the lighthouse.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: If this light should ever falter...then gods help us.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: If this light should ever falter...then gods help us.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: The fog...it's behaving...it's as though it's reacting to the lights that cut through it. It swirls and crashes against the edges.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: The fog...it's behaving...it's as though it's reacting to the lights that cut through it. It swirls and crashes against the edges.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: From the top of the lighthouse I can see [C3]dark figures seething in the thickest tracts[/C3], out beyond [C0]Little Marrow[/C0] where the lights dwindle.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: From the top of the lighthouse I can see [C3]dark figures seething in the thickest tracts[/C3], out beyond [C0]Little Marrow[/C0] where the lights dwindle.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Of all that I've seen, your lights seem to anger them the most.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Of all that I've seen, your lights seem to anger them the most.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: [C3]Relics[/C3]? [C3]Collector[/C3]? I'm not sure what you're hoping to achieve with this...character.
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: [C3]Relics[/C3]? [C3]Collector[/C3]? I'm not sure what you're hoping to achieve with this...character.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Do you even know? Have you stopped to consider it?
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Do you even know? Have you stopped to consider it?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: :On the other side of the table you find a hastily scrawled note. It reads: "[C0]Not safe. Expect retaliation imminently. Evacuating to fort.[/C0]"
rows.raw_text: :On the other side of the table you find a hastily scrawled note. It reads: "[C0]Not safe. Expect retaliation imminently. Evacuating to fort.[/C0]"

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Something extremely large and powerful created these holes. You slowly reach your arm into one...
rows.raw_text: Something extremely large and powerful created these holes. You slowly reach your arm into one...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You can barely hear their rasping whisper above the wind and waves.
rows.raw_text: You can barely hear their rasping whisper above the wind and waves.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 1
rows.text: Fulfill...the hunger.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_1_NAME_KEY: Fulfill...the hunger.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The hooded figure unfurls an old paper scroll. They point to a shape shown at the top. It appears to be a [C0]Blue Mackerel[/C0].
rows.raw_text: The hooded figure unfurls an old paper scroll. They point to a shape shown at the top. It appears to be a [C0]Blue Mackerel[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With expert precision they plunge their hands through the gullet of the fish and tear out the heart. They stuff it into their mouth unceremoniously.
rows.raw_text: With expert precision they plunge their hands through the gullet of the fish and tear out the heart. They stuff it into their mouth unceremoniously.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 1
rows.text: More. Still...empty.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_1_NAME_KEY: More. Still...empty.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They point to another shape on a second scroll. This one looks like a [C0]Tiger Mackerel[/C0].
rows.raw_text: They point to another shape on a second scroll. This one looks like a [C0]Tiger Mackerel[/C0].

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Again they rip into the flesh of the fish, drawing out its heart. It's consumed as quickly as the first.
rows.raw_text: Again they rip into the flesh of the fish, drawing out its heart. It's consumed as quickly as the first.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 1
rows.text: Almost. Fulfilled.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_1_NAME_KEY: Almost. Fulfilled.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They point to a fish on the final scroll. This one is a [C0]Snake Mackerel[/C0].
rows.raw_text: They point to a fish on the final scroll. This one is a [C0]Snake Mackerel[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The fish has barely left your hands before splintered nails begin peeling at its scales. The heart is extracted and devoured.
rows.raw_text: The fish has barely left your hands before splintered nails begin peeling at its scales. The heart is extracted and devoured.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Their head tilts upward to look at you. They take a [C1]Book[/C1] from inside their robe and hand it over.
rows.raw_text: Their head tilts upward to look at you. They take a [C1]Book[/C1] from inside their robe and hand it over.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 1
rows.text: Hunger...sated. Now...I wait.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_1_NAME_KEY: Hunger...sated. Now...I wait.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They cross their arms and appear to fall into a deep sleep.
rows.raw_text: They cross their arms and appear to fall into a deep sleep.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You watch from a distance for some time but see no movement. You turn around and leave quietly.
rows.raw_text: You watch from a distance for some time but see no movement. You turn around and leave quietly.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You approach a hooded figure. Dirty gold robes obscure all features except for a pair of withered and blackened hands.
rows.raw_text: You approach a hooded figure. Dirty gold robes obscure all features except for a pair of withered and blackened hands.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 2
rows.text: Fisherman...deep. Calls. Respond.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_2_NAME_KEY: Fisherman...deep. Calls. Respond.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Their voice gurgles with the sound of fluid in their lungs.
rows.raw_text: Their voice gurgles with the sound of fluid in their lungs.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 2
rows.text: An answer...
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_2_NAME_KEY: An answer...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The hooded figure holds out a scroll. They tap at a shape depicted. It looks like a [C0]Red Snapper[/C0].
rows.raw_text: The hooded figure holds out a scroll. They tap at a shape depicted. It looks like a [C0]Red Snapper[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They rip through the throat of the fish and tear out its heart. It's in their mouth before you have time to process what you just saw.
rows.raw_text: They rip through the throat of the fish and tear out its heart. It's in their mouth before you have time to process what you just saw.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 2
rows.text: Another. A sacrifice.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_2_NAME_KEY: Another. A sacrifice.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They point at another shape on a scroll. This one looks like a [C0]Fangtooth[/C0].
rows.raw_text: They point at another shape on a scroll. This one looks like a [C0]Fangtooth[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They bring this small fish up to their mouth and bite at where the heart is. Their cracked lips part to reveal a row of sharpened teeth.
rows.raw_text: They bring this small fish up to their mouth and bite at where the heart is. Their cracked lips part to reveal a row of sharpened teeth.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 2
rows.text: Sense...an opening.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_2_NAME_KEY: Sense...an opening.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They unfurl the final scroll. This one shows a [C0]Blue Crab[/C0].
rows.raw_text: They unfurl the final scroll. This one shows a [C0]Blue Crab[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: They crack and bend the crab's legs apart and feast on the flesh inside.
rows.raw_text: They crack and bend the crab's legs apart and feast on the flesh inside.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Lips still covered in crab flesh, they take a [C1]Book[/C1] from inside their robe and hand it to you.
rows.raw_text: Lips still covered in crab flesh, they take a [C1]Book[/C1] from inside their robe and hand it to you.
