rows.raw_text: She recoils from your flagrant lie.

rows.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
rows.text: Why do you mistrust me so? What have I done to warrant such suspicion?
rows.raw_text: LIGHTHOUSE_KEEPER_NAME_KEY: Why do you mistrust me so? What have I done to warrant such suspicion?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She turns from you, shaking her head and muttering. She heads back towards the lighthouse.
rows.raw_text: She turns from you, shaking her head and muttering. She heads back towards the lighthouse.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's wrong?
rows.raw_text: What's wrong?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He stares ahead in silence.
rows.raw_text: He stares ahead in silence.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are you alright?
rows.raw_text: Are you alright?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He seems unable to respond.
rows.raw_text: He seems unable to respond.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What happened?
rows.raw_text: What happened?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You notice his neck and overalls are covered in a dark fluid - the same dark fluid that was leaking from the package you delivered earlier.
rows.raw_text: You notice his neck and overalls are covered in a dark fluid - the same dark fluid that was leaking from the package you delivered earlier.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What was that?
rows.raw_text: What was that?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A trembling head turns ever so slightly towards you. His breathing grows heavy in anger until you step backwards, leaving him standing there on the dock.
rows.raw_text: A trembling head turns ever so slightly towards you. His breathing grows heavy in anger until you step backwards, leaving him standing there on the dock.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Woah, you don't look so great, friend. When's the last time you got a good night's [C0]sleep[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Woah, you don't look so great, friend. When's the last time you got a good night's [C0]sleep[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Are you alright there? You're looking a little...jittery. You're free to [C0]rest[/C0] here anytime.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Are you alright there? You're looking a little...jittery. You're free to [C0]rest[/C0] here anytime.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Your hull's got a few holes that need patching. We can [C0]repair[/C0] those here, remember.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Your hull's got a few holes that need patching. We can [C0]repair[/C0] those here, remember.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Did you run aground on rocks or something? We should make some [C0]repairs[/C0] - I can see right through your hull!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Did you run aground on rocks or something? We should make some [C0]repairs[/C0] - I can see right through your hull!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Your boat's sprung a leak! We should [C0]fix[/C0] that.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Your boat's sprung a leak! We should [C0]fix[/C0] that.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You should really be more careful! I don't have a limitless supply of [C0]repair[/C0] materials, you know.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You should really be more careful! I don't have a limitless supply of [C0]repair[/C0] materials, you know.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I suppose you're going to say you "couldn't avoid" the rock that "appeared out of nowhere"? Yeah yeah, I've heard it all before. Let's get you [C0]fixed[/C0] up.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I suppose you're going to say you "couldn't avoid" the rock that "appeared out of nowhere"? Yeah yeah, I've heard it all before. Let's get you [C0]fixed[/C0] up.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'm going to have to start carrying more materials soon aren't I? I've got enough to make [C0]repairs[/C0] for now, at least.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'm going to have to start carrying more materials soon aren't I? I've got enough to make [C0]repairs[/C0] for now, at least.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: If you have some worn out [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] or [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0], we can fix them here.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: If you have some worn out [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] or [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0], we can fix them here.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: [C0]Trawl Net[/C0] fraying? Crabs cutting themselves out of your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0]? Why don't we [C0]fix[/C0] them up here?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: [C0]Trawl Net[/C0] fraying? Crabs cutting themselves out of your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0]? Why don't we [C0]fix[/C0] them up here?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Don't forget - [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] and [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0] both need repairing every now and then.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Don't forget - [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] and [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0] both need repairing every now and then.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] and [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0] won't work if they're completely worn out, so best to [C0]repair[/C0] them regularly.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] and [C0]Trawl Nets[/C0] won't work if they're completely worn out, so best to [C0]repair[/C0] them regularly.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'll buy all sorts of fish here - and I can pay the most for [C1]fresh[/C1] ones.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'll buy all sorts of fish here - and I can pay the most for [C1]fresh[/C1] ones.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Not all fish are traded equally! Smaller species can sometimes be more delicious - and more valuable - than the larger ones.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Not all fish are traded equally! Smaller species can sometimes be more delicious - and more valuable - than the larger ones.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: The most successful captains know how to push their vessels to the limit. Is yours running at peak efficiency?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: The most successful captains know how to push their vessels to the limit. Is yours running at peak efficiency?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: There's nothing wrong with combining different engine types - do anything you can to get more speed out of the space you have.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: There's nothing wrong with combining different engine types - do anything you can to get more speed out of the space you have.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Having a variety of fishing tackle on board means you'll be prepared to catch whatever you come across.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Having a variety of fishing tackle on board means you'll be prepared to catch whatever you come across.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Installing a [C0]Trawl Net[/C0] is a great way to earn some passive income while exploring the islands.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Installing a [C0]Trawl Net[/C0] is a great way to earn some passive income while exploring the islands.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: When [C0]Trawling[/C0], pay attention to how [C0]deep[/C0] the water is. Not every type of fish likes deep water! Check your [C0]Encyclopedia[/C0] if you're not sure.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: When [C0]Trawling[/C0], pay attention to how [C0]deep[/C0] the water is. Not every type of fish likes deep water! Check your [C0]Encyclopedia[/C0] if you're not sure.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] can be quite profitable if you can find a good place to drop them. Just don't forget where you put them!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] can be quite profitable if you can find a good place to drop them. Just don't forget where you put them!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You'll need to pick up your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] every now and then and bring them in for repairs.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You'll need to pick up your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0] every now and then and bring them in for repairs.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Not every crab can be found at every [C0]depth[/C0]. When finding a spot to drop your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0], maybe check your [C0]Encyclopedia[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Not every crab can be found at every [C0]depth[/C0]. When finding a spot to drop your [C0]Crab Pots[/C0], maybe check your [C0]Encyclopedia[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I hope you're being careful out there. Seeing your boat sail over puts a smile on my face every time.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I hope you're being careful out there. Seeing your boat sail over puts a smile on my face every time.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You and I, we've got to avoid risks as much as we can. There's no crew to bail us out if things go south.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You and I, we've got to avoid risks as much as we can. There's no crew to bail us out if things go south.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You don't have to try to grab everything you see out there. That wreck salvage isn't going anywhere fast.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You don't have to try to grab everything you see out there. That wreck salvage isn't going anywhere fast.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I love the sound of rain against the roof of my cabin. Is there anything better?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I love the sound of rain against the roof of my cabin. Is there anything better?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You'll need to put a few more engines on that thing if you want it to be as fast as mine, hah!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You'll need to put a few more engines on that thing if you want it to be as fast as mine, hah!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me more about the creature that lives in the cliffs.
rows.raw_text: Tell me more about the creature that lives in the cliffs.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: It's been burrowing tunnels through the base of the cliffs. You can see the [C0]gigantic holes[/C0] it leaves just below the surface.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: It's been burrowing tunnels through the base of the cliffs. You can see the [C0]gigantic holes[/C0] it leaves just below the surface.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: As it forces its way out, it often causes [C0]rock falls[/C0]. So if you plan on going in there...keep an ear out.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: As it forces its way out, it often causes [C0]rock falls[/C0]. So if you plan on going in there...keep an ear out.

rows.speaker: Hermit
rows.text: Should it catch sight of you, well, you should be able to outrun it - it's [C0]quite slow[/C0] - provided you can navigate the passageways.
rows.raw_text: HERMIT_NAME_KEY: Should it catch sight of you, well, you should be able to outrun it - it's [C0]quite slow[/C0] - provided you can navigate the passageways.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What am I supposed to be doing now?
rows.raw_text: What am I supposed to be doing now?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: We're making [C0]special bait[/C0] to lure the [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3] into the [C0]traps[/C0] I've built in the lagoons.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: We're making [C0]special bait[/C0] to lure the [C3]Mind Suckers[/C3] into the [C0]traps[/C0] I've built in the lagoons.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Once we've trapped them, I'll fire on them with the mortar. Then you'll [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that they're dead.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Once we've trapped them, I'll fire on them with the mortar. Then you'll [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that they're dead.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: When the trap springs, I'll fire upon it with the mortar. Make sure you [C0]bring back proof[/C0] that the thing's really dead, you hear?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Here, this was left over from the other bait we made.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Here, this was left over from the other bait we made.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Did you want that leftover bait now?
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Did you want that leftover bait now?

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Right, now, we can make some fresh stuff if you like.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Right, now, we can make some fresh stuff if you like.

rows.speaker: Soldier
rows.text: Don't want it right now? Well, come back if you change your mind.
rows.raw_text: SOLDIER_NAME_KEY: Don't want it right now? Well, come back if you change your mind.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Don't want them right now? Well, come back if you change your mind.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Don't want them right now? Well, come back if you change your mind.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: I hope you can put them to good use...wherever you find cause for it.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: I hope you can put them to good use...wherever you find cause for it.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Did you want those explosives now? I held onto them for you.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Did you want those explosives now? I held onto them for you.

rows.speaker: Retired Whaler
rows.text: Here, this is on the house - for all your help.
rows.raw_text: RETIRED_WHALER_NAME_KEY: Here, this is on the house - for all your help.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You look tired. If you don't get some sleep, you'll start seeing things! Why don't you [C0]rest[/C0] up before heading back out?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You look tired. If you don't get some sleep, you'll start seeing things! Why don't you [C0]rest[/C0] up before heading back out?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Everything ok? You've just been standing there for a while...need to have a [C0]rest[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Everything ok? You've just been standing there for a while...need to have a [C0]rest[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I know that look on your face. Too long on the open water, eh? Yeah, you start to feel a little mad after a while. Nothing a good [C0]sleep[/C0] won't fix.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I know that look on your face. Too long on the open water, eh? Yeah, you start to feel a little mad after a while. Nothing a good [C0]sleep[/C0] won't fix.

rows.speaker: Builder
rows.text: I found this while I was unpacking. You should take it.
rows.raw_text: BUILDER_NAME_KEY: I found this while I was unpacking. You should take it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She hands you a [C1]Book[/C1]. The cover is dusty, but in otherwise good condition.
rows.raw_text: She hands you a [C1]Book[/C1]. The cover is dusty, but in otherwise good condition.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I've got a surprise for you! A gift, for my most loyal customer. Here, I want you to have this.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I've got a surprise for you! A gift, for my most loyal customer. Here, I want you to have this.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She takes a [C1]Book[/C1] from a nearby shelf and hands it to you. Flicking through it, you see page corners turned in and handwritten notes in the margins.
rows.raw_text: She takes a [C1]Book[/C1] from a nearby shelf and hands it to you. Flicking through it, you see page corners turned in and handwritten notes in the margins.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, how rude of me. You've done all of this for me and...I've not got much to say thank you with. Um, you should have this.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, how rude of me. You've done all of this for me and...I've not got much to say thank you with. Um, you should have this.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She opens a drawer and pulls out a [C1]Book[/C1]. Sheepishly, she hands it to you.
rows.raw_text: She opens a drawer and pulls out a [C1]Book[/C1]. Sheepishly, she hands it to you.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: This is something I wrote during my studies. I think it'll be useful to you.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: This is something I wrote during my studies. I think it'll be useful to you.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The stone trembles before you. Unknown symbols glow from within.
rows.raw_text: The stone trembles before you. Unknown symbols glow from within.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Place your hand on the stone.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Place your hand on the stone.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A sudden chill rushes through the marrow of your bones, surging up your arm, your neck. A [C3]deep vision[/C3] enters your mind.
rows.raw_text: A sudden chill rushes through the marrow of your bones, surging up your arm, your neck. A [C3]deep vision[/C3] enters your mind.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The stone hums quietly, sending ripples through the air around it. Faint shapes dance upon its surface, vanishing before your eyes can focus on them.
rows.raw_text: The stone hums quietly, sending ripples through the air around it. Faint shapes dance upon its surface, vanishing before your eyes can focus on them.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Place your hand on the stone.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Place your hand on the stone.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The cold stone does not respond to your touch.
rows.raw_text: The cold stone does not respond to your touch.

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The town of Greater Marrow burns. The lighthouse lies collapsed, its light extinguished.
rows.raw_text: The town of Greater Marrow burns. The lighthouse lies collapsed, its light extinguished.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A red glow fills the sky behind a cyclone that drains the world.
rows.raw_text: A red glow fills the sky behind a cyclone that drains the world.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A ship, tossed by waves in the night. Fog unfolds like a blanket from the deck, spilling across the ocean and crashing against the land.
rows.raw_text: A ship, tossed by waves in the night. Fog unfolds like a blanket from the deck, spilling across the ocean and crashing against the land.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: A distant lighthouse flickers a signal.
rows.raw_text: A distant lighthouse flickers a signal.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Dark rocks erupt from the earth, piercing through buildings and trees. Through sand and crashing waves. Through the basalt pillars of this island.
rows.raw_text: Dark rocks erupt from the earth, piercing through buildings and trees. Through sand and crashing waves. Through the basalt pillars of this island.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The newborn structures crackle with an unknown energy, crimson lightning arcing between them.
rows.raw_text: The newborn structures crackle with an unknown energy, crimson lightning arcing between them.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A blustery wind screams through the cliffs, diving and turning. It passes over a large wooden ship at anchor, all flags filling suddenly.
rows.raw_text: A blustery wind screams through the cliffs, diving and turning. It passes over a large wooden ship at anchor, all flags filling suddenly.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A skinless face appears on the fluttering fabric. A wail of terror rises from the crew.
rows.raw_text: A skinless face appears on the fluttering fabric. A wail of terror rises from the crew.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A heart of stone wrapped in a twisting tail. A serpentine body uncoils, teeth rasping at its earthen shell.
rows.raw_text: A heart of stone wrapped in a twisting tail. A serpentine body uncoils, teeth rasping at its earthen shell.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Larger now. Bursting through the cliffs, sending rocks tumbling into the water. An eye opens to this new world.
rows.raw_text: Larger now. Bursting through the cliffs, sending rocks tumbling into the water. An eye opens to this new world.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A spore floats in the water, adrift in the current. Fish feast in a frenzy above, devouring its kin. The spore lands in the thick silt of the sea floor.
rows.raw_text: A spore floats in the water, adrift in the current. Fish feast in a frenzy above, devouring its kin. The spore lands in the thick silt of the sea floor.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Its roots stretch down into the seabed, growing - extending towards what lies beneath.
rows.raw_text: Its roots stretch down into the seabed, growing - extending towards what lies beneath.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The green glimmer of an aurora blooms in the night sky above the resort. A distant boom shakes the thatched rooves and rouses dreamers from their sleep.
rows.raw_text: The green glimmer of an aurora blooms in the night sky above the resort. A distant boom shakes the thatched rooves and rouses dreamers from their sleep.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The waters withdraw, exposing the coral to the warm air. Confused creatures chitter and seek out their hiding places.
rows.raw_text: The waters withdraw, exposing the coral to the warm air. Confused creatures chitter and seek out their hiding places.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A man flees through the trees, bloodshot eyes wide with terror. He runs into a dead end; cornered by the murky waters and his pursuer, he turns.
rows.raw_text: A man flees through the trees, bloodshot eyes wide with terror. He runs into a dead end; cornered by the murky waters and his pursuer, he turns.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: A wooden spear flies and finds its mark.
rows.raw_text: A wooden spear flies and finds its mark.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A parasite burrows into a large snakelike carcass. It feeds, growing fat and multiplying. Tendrils sprout from the head of the body and sense the water around it.
rows.raw_text: A parasite burrows into a large snakelike carcass. It feeds, growing fat and multiplying. Tendrils sprout from the head of the body and sense the water around it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The host corpse shudders reluctantly. With a cry that resounds through the forest, it rises once again.
rows.raw_text: The host corpse shudders reluctantly. With a cry that resounds through the forest, it rises once again.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A leviathan raises its vast grey head, stretching up, up until it sits level with a bright flame cradled at the top of the ancient lighthouse.
rows.raw_text: A leviathan raises its vast grey head, stretching up, up until it sits level with a bright flame cradled at the top of the ancient lighthouse.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: It watches the fire for a while, tilting its head and calling softly to it with a guttural song.
rows.raw_text: It watches the fire for a while, tilting its head and calling softly to it with a guttural song.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Appearing satisfied, the beast slinks down into the water, gliding back to the depths.
rows.raw_text: Appearing satisfied, the beast slinks down into the water, gliding back to the depths.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Blackness.
rows.raw_text: Blackness.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: A crimson rift opens in the void.
rows.raw_text: A crimson rift opens in the void.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Dreadful silhouettes drift through in a procession of teeth and tentacles.
rows.raw_text: Dreadful silhouettes drift through in a procession of teeth and tentacles.

rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: There's sure to be a few larger species - [C0]Gulls[/C0] and [C0]Ravens[/C0] - loitering around the more active docks looking for morsels of food.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: The ruins in [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0] host a few breeding pairs of [C0]Sea Hawks[/C0]. You're bound to hear them calling to each other, though they're quite elusive.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: The ruins in [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0] host a few breeding pairs of [C0]Sea Hawks[/C0]. You're bound to hear them calling to each other, though they're quite elusive.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: I'm glad you asked! Not many consider reptiles when they think of the ocean.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: I'm glad you asked! Not many consider reptiles when they think of the ocean.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: [C0]Loggerhead Turtles[/C0] are a common sight in the temperate waters around [C0]The Marrows[/C0] and [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0], though they can be hard to spot in the water.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: [C0]Loggerhead Turtles[/C0] are a common sight in the temperate waters around [C0]The Marrows[/C0] and [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0], though they can be hard to spot in the water.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: When it comes to larger reptiles, they don't get any bigger than [C0]Salt Water Crocodiles[/C0]. The mangroves of [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0] are the perfect environment for them.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: When it comes to larger reptiles, they don't get any bigger than [C0]Salt Water Crocodiles[/C0]. The mangroves of [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0] are the perfect environment for them.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: You were going to try to [C0]find my case of extra lenses[/C0]. It must've fallen overboard when I hit some coral to the [C0]West[/C0], towards [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: You were going to try to [C0]find my case of extra lenses[/C0]. It must've fallen overboard when I hit some coral to the [C0]West[/C0], towards [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: I'll mark on your map where I think I lost them.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: I'll mark on your map where I think I lost them.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: Good day, fisherman. How can I help you?
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: Good day, fisherman. How can I help you?

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: Fisherman! Have you run into a [C0]Photographer[/C0] on your travels? She docked here a few days ago for supplies.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: Fisherman! Have you run into a [C0]Photographer[/C0] on your travels? She docked here a few days ago for supplies.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: I suggested that she take some pictures of the town - for promotional purposes - but she didn't seem too interested.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: I suggested that she take some pictures of the town - for promotional purposes - but she didn't seem too interested.

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.text: She mentioned she was heading [C0]South[/C0] - perhaps you should introduce yourself.
rows.raw_text: MAYOR_NAME_KEY: She mentioned she was heading [C0]South[/C0] - perhaps you should introduce yourself.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Say, have you met the [C0]Photographer[/C0]? She stopped by my pontoon a little while back.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Say, have you met the [C0]Photographer[/C0]? She stopped by my pontoon a little while back.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: She's loaded up with fancy camera equipment to take pictures of all the wildlife.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: She's loaded up with fancy camera equipment to take pictures of all the wildlife.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: She sighs wistfully.
rows.raw_text: She sighs wistfully.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I wish I had my own [C1]camera[/C1]. Wouldn't it be nice to be able to document everything you do? You'd never forget anything...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I wish I had my own [C1]camera[/C1]. Wouldn't it be nice to be able to document everything you do? You'd never forget anything...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Anyway, she said she was setting up on a small island to the [C0]South[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]. If you're in the area, maybe you could check on her.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Anyway, she said she was setting up on a small island to the [C0]South[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]. If you're in the area, maybe you could check on her.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: What can I help you with today?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: What can I help you with today?

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Back.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Back.\]

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: What color do you want to paint the [C0]roof[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: What color do you want to paint the [C0]roof[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Alright, now let me prepare my brushes...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Alright, now let me prepare my brushes...

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Mmm, much better. That color looks good.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Mmm, much better. That color looks good.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: I don't have the right pigment to make that color. You'll need to bring me these [C3]crabs[/C3]:
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: I don't have the right pigment to make that color. You'll need to bring me these [C3]crabs[/C3]:

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: A different color, perhaps?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: A different color, perhaps?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Deliver Flag.
rows.raw_text: Deliver Flag.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Deliver Flag.
rows.raw_text: Deliver Flag.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: As you wish...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: As you wish...

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: So, you've found a scrap of fabric eh? Let me see...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: So, you've found a scrap of fabric eh? Let me see...

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: A unique design. Do you want to attach it now?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: A unique design. Do you want to attach it now?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Yes.
rows.raw_text: Yes.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: No.
rows.raw_text: No.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: You don't seem to have any new flags with you. Come back when you find some.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: You don't seem to have any new flags with you. Come back when you find some.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Sharp Mint.
rows.raw_text: Sharp Mint.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Maple Orange.
rows.raw_text: Maple Orange.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Royal Purple.
rows.raw_text: Royal Purple.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Golden Treasure.
rows.raw_text: Golden Treasure.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Black Abyss.
rows.raw_text: Black Abyss.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Ah, the fisherman...I had thought you might stop by. Welcome to my humble studio.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Ah, the fisherman...I had thought you might stop by. Welcome to my humble studio.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: If you're wanting to...experiment with some decorations...yes, I'm the person to talk to.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: If you're wanting to...experiment with some decorations...yes, I'm the person to talk to.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What sort of decorations?
rows.raw_text: What sort of decorations?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: I can attach [C0]flags[/C0] and [C0]bunting[/C0] to add some style to your boat. I have a design here already that you might like.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: I can attach [C0]flags[/C0] and [C0]bunting[/C0] to add some style to your boat. I have a design here already that you might like.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: If you [C0]find any others[/C0] on your travels, [C0]bring them back to me[/C0] and I can rig them up for you.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: If you [C0]find any others[/C0] on your travels, [C0]bring them back to me[/C0] and I can rig them up for you.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Of course, I can also add a splash of [C0]colour[/C0] to your hull. I'm sorry to say that [C2]my selection of pigments limited at the moment[/C2], though...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Of course, I can also add a splash of [C0]colour[/C0] to your hull. I'm sorry to say that [C2]my selection of pigments limited at the moment[/C2], though...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Could I help find more pigments?
rows.raw_text: Could I help find more pigments?

rows.speaker: Player (action choice)
rows.text: \[Back.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Back.\]

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Hmm...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Hmm...

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He thinks for a short while.
rows.raw_text: He thinks for a short while.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: The other day, down by the shoreline, I saw a [C3]strange crab[/C3] with the most strikingly vibrant coloration.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: The other day, down by the shoreline, I saw a [C3]strange crab[/C3] with the most strikingly vibrant coloration.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: My knees aren't suited to clambering over rocks and chasing crustaceans, you see, but if you caught such a creature...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: My knees aren't suited to clambering over rocks and chasing crustaceans, you see, but if you caught such a creature...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He clears scraps of cloth and paper from his workbench, revealing a large pestle & mortar.
rows.raw_text: He clears scraps of cloth and paper from his workbench, revealing a large pestle & mortar.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: With the right binding agent...we can grind them together for a new mixture...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: With the right binding agent...we can grind them together for a new mixture...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He turns back to you, a cunning plan formed in his mind.
rows.raw_text: He turns back to you, a cunning plan formed in his mind.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Fisherman. Bring me some of those [C3]strange crabs[/C3]. We'll turn your vessel into a work of art!
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Fisherman. Bring me some of those [C3]strange crabs[/C3]. We'll turn your vessel into a work of art!

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Yes, of course. As I mentioned previously, if you're able to [C3]bring me crabs of the most unusual colors[/C3], we can grind them up for their pigment.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Yes, of course. As I mentioned previously, if you're able to [C3]bring me crabs of the most unusual colors[/C3], we can grind them up for their pigment.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you do here?
rows.raw_text: What do you do here?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: That should be all we need...let me grind them together...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: That should be all we need...let me grind them together...

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: That flag's been taken down for you now.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: That flag's been taken down for you now.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Okay, I've removed the bunting for now.
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Okay, I've removed the bunting for now.

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: But, ah, for now...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: But, ah, for now...

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching to the [C0]North[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching to the [C0]North[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching to the [C0]South[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching to the [C0]South[/C0] of [C0]The Marrows[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching around [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching around [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching around [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching around [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching around [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching around [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Have you tried searching around [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Have you tried searching around [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Painter
rows.text: Although...you already have so many - I'm not sure there are any more out there...
rows.raw_text: PAINTER_NAME_KEY: Although...you already have so many - I'm not sure there are any more out there...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Down here to investigate the ice field too? It seems to have appeared out of nowhere - my best guess is that it drifted up from the south.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Down here to investigate the ice field too? It seems to have appeared out of nowhere - my best guess is that it drifted up from the south.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Either way, I thought I should set up a pontoon here - but when I went to stake my claim, I noticed some old equipment on the ice...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Either way, I thought I should set up a pontoon here - but when I went to stake my claim, I noticed some old equipment on the ice...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Come and check it out when you get a second.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Come and check it out when you get a second.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Travelling Merchant has crossed over to the nearby iceberg and is inspecting some old pieces of metal. You approach.
rows.raw_text: The Travelling Merchant has crossed over to the nearby iceberg and is inspecting some old pieces of metal. You approach.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: It's so weird, this stuff seems old. Like, really old.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: It's so weird, this stuff seems old. Like, really old.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She kicks a large sheet of metal, half-embedded in the ice. A thin layer of snow dislodges, revealing lines of rivet holes.
rows.raw_text: She kicks a large sheet of metal, half-embedded in the ice. A thin layer of snow dislodges, revealing lines of rivet holes.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: And come in here - look!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: And come in here - look!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You follow her into a small makeshift shelter, ruined by years of harsh weather. Inside are some schematics nailed to a table, still barely legible.
rows.raw_text: You follow her into a small makeshift shelter, ruined by years of harsh weather. Inside are some schematics nailed to a table, still barely legible.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: See how they angled these sheets...and the lining of the metal around the bow...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: See how they angled these sheets...and the lining of the metal around the bow...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Whoever was here, I think they were constructing an [C0]Icebreaker[/C0]!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Whoever was here, I think they were constructing an [C0]Icebreaker[/C0]!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Could you make another one using these plans?
rows.raw_text: Could you make another one using these plans?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Probably! But...ah, let me see...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Probably! But...ah, let me see...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's an Icebreaker?
rows.raw_text: What's an Icebreaker?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: It's a reinforced structure attached to the front of ships to help them [C1]safely cut a path through ice[/C1].
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: It's a reinforced structure attached to the front of ships to help them [C1]safely cut a path through ice[/C1].

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: With these plans, I could probably make another...hmm...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: With these plans, I could probably make another...hmm...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She trudges outside again and paces out the length of the metal scraps on the ice.
rows.raw_text: She trudges outside again and paces out the length of the metal scraps on the ice.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: We've got most of the basic materials here already, but of course, we're [C2]missing the most crucial pieces[/C2].
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: We've got most of the basic materials here already, but of course, we're [C2]missing the most crucial pieces[/C2].

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: An [C0]Icebreaker[/C0] needs [C0]specially tempered, angled metal[/C0], as well as [C0]components designed to minimize the impact[/C0] to your hull.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: An [C0]Icebreaker[/C0] needs [C0]specially tempered, angled metal[/C0], as well as [C0]components designed to minimize the impact[/C0] to your hull.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I can't see any of those here, but...whoever left all this stuff here, maybe they left other pieces elsewhere?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I can't see any of those here, but...whoever left all this stuff here, maybe they left other pieces elsewhere?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Or maybe you'll be able to find their old ship and salvage the [C0]Icebreaker[/C0] they already built? That would be convenient! Anyway...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Or maybe you'll be able to find their old ship and salvage the [C0]Icebreaker[/C0] they already built? That would be convenient! Anyway...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: To build a new [C0]Icebreaker[/C0], these are the parts we'll need.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: To build a new [C0]Icebreaker[/C0], these are the parts we'll need.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That's everything! Let me just warm my hands up a little, then I'll get started...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That's everything! Let me just warm my hands up a little, then I'll get started...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Alright, I think that should do it. [C0]The front of your ship can now break through chunks of ice[/C0]!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Alright, I think that should do it. [C0]The front of your ship can now break through chunks of ice[/C0]!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Go ahead and test it out! I'll be watching from here.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Go ahead and test it out! I'll be watching from here.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Oh, I forgot to mention - just let me know if you want to [C0]temporarily remove that Icebreaker[/C0]. I can swap it out at any of my pontoons.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Oh, I forgot to mention - just let me know if you want to [C0]temporarily remove that Icebreaker[/C0]. I can swap it out at any of my pontoons.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The worksite is empty.
rows.raw_text: The worksite is empty.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I've been looking through the schematics we found before, and there are plans here for another device too!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I've been looking through the schematics we found before, and there are plans here for another device too!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: They're for an [C0]Ice Shaper[/C0] - that's different to your [C0]Icebreaker[/C0], by the way - it's for cutting chunks of ice.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: They're for an [C0]Ice Shaper[/C0] - that's different to your [C0]Icebreaker[/C0], by the way - it's for cutting chunks of ice.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: If you find the [C2]missing device[/C2], I'll be able to use the machine to harvest [C0]ice blocks[/C0] for refrigeration!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: If you find the [C2]missing device[/C2], I'll be able to use the machine to harvest [C0]ice blocks[/C0] for refrigeration!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: The [C0]blocks of ice[/C0] can be packed into your cargo to [C1]slow fish spoilage[/C1]. Pretty handy, right?
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: The [C0]blocks of ice[/C0] can be packed into your cargo to [C1]slow fish spoilage[/C1]. Pretty handy, right?

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: This is what the [C2]missing[/C2] [C0]Ice Shaper[/C0] looks like.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: This is what the [C2]missing[/C2] [C0]Ice Shaper[/C0] looks like.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: You really found it! How on earth do you actually locate that stuff down there in the deep? Anyway...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: You really found it! How on earth do you actually locate that stuff down there in the deep? Anyway...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Let me slot this blade in here and...yeah, that seems right...I think it's ready to start cutting!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Let me slot this blade in here and...yeah, that seems right...I think it's ready to start cutting!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Blocks of ice, coming right up!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Blocks of ice, coming right up!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: That works pretty well! Here, these are on the house.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: That works pretty well! Here, these are on the house.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: From now on I'll be able to stock some of these ice blocks at my pontoons. Thanks, partner!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: From now on I'll be able to stock some of these ice blocks at my pontoons. Thanks, partner!

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: Fisherman! I didn't expect to see you this far south. Well, this is a fortunate turn of events.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: Fisherman! I didn't expect to see you this far south. Well, this is a fortunate turn of events.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: Hmm, hello, I don't think we've met. A fisherman, I presume? Please, try to keep your engine noise to a minimum. It tends to frighten the wildlife.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: Hmm, hello, I don't think we've met. A fisherman, I presume? Please, try to keep your engine noise to a minimum. It tends to frighten the wildlife.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: There's a [C0]Narwhal[/C0] somewhere in this ice field. I couldn't get any further in, so I've been trying to take a picture from here with no luck.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: There's a [C0]Narwhal[/C0] somewhere in this ice field. I couldn't get any further in, so I've been trying to take a picture from here with no luck.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: I tried placing some scraps of fish on that ice sheet over there to entice it, but I didn't have enough to hold its attention for long enough. I only caught a glimpse.
rows.raw_text: PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME_KEY: I tried placing some scraps of fish on that ice sheet over there to entice it, but I didn't have enough to hold its attention for long enough. I only caught a glimpse.

rows.speaker: Photographer
rows.text: I don't suppose you have any fish you'd be prepared to donate to the pursuit of wildlife photography?

rows.raw_text: I'd like to remove the Icebreaker.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: In the meantime, I've got some [C0]new rods for sale[/C0]! They'll be perfect for [C0]fishing in the ice[/C0] around here.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: In the meantime, I've got some [C0]new rods for sale[/C0]! They'll be perfect for [C0]fishing in the ice[/C0] around here.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: I'm not exactly sure yet, but I have a theory...have you heard the legend of [C0]The Pale Reach[/C0]? It's an old sailor's tale.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: I'm not exactly sure yet, but I have a theory...have you heard the legend of [C0]The Pale Reach[/C0]? It's an old sailor's tale.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: The story goes that when the fog grows thick enough, the ice appears, seemingly out of nowhere. Hours later, or sometimes days, it vanishes again without a trace.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: The story goes that when the fog grows thick enough, the ice appears, seemingly out of nowhere. Hours later, or sometimes days, it vanishes again without a trace.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Back in the olden days, they sent a survey expedition in to investigate. Apparently, it returned with half the crew - either from mutiny or madness.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Back in the olden days, they sent a survey expedition in to investigate. Apparently, it returned with half the crew - either from mutiny or madness.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Travel on the high seas in those days will do that to you, I guess! Anyway, I'm not sure about this place. It could just be regular old ice.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Travel on the high seas in those days will do that to you, I guess! Anyway, I'm not sure about this place. It could just be regular old ice.

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Sure, give me a moment. I've got it stored back here somewhere...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Sure, give me a moment. I've got it stored back here somewhere...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: All done - you're ready to smash some ice!
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: All done - you're ready to smash some ice!

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Sure, give me a moment. I'll need to find some space for it onboard...
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Sure, give me a moment. I'll need to find some space for it onboard...

rows.speaker: Travelling Merchant
rows.text: Alright, that's sorted! I'll keep it with me for when you need it reattached.
rows.raw_text: TRAVELLING_MERCHANT_NAME_KEY: Alright, that's sorted! I'll keep it with me for when you need it reattached.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A crudely drawn map of the area has been charted onto a scrap of paper. [C1]You attach it to your own map[/C1].
rows.raw_text: A crudely drawn map of the area has been charted onto a scrap of paper. [C1]You attach it to your own map[/C1].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A large book sits on the table. It's well-worn from the passage of time, but you can still read the words "Captain's Log" etched into the cover.
rows.raw_text: A large book sits on the table. It's well-worn from the passage of time, but you can still read the words "Captain's Log" etched into the cover.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: Arrived at the floating sea-ice amidst a particularly thick fog. A few channels could be seen leading into the ice, though sizeable chunks float in our way, posing a hazard.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: Arrived at the floating sea-ice amidst a particularly thick fog. A few channels could be seen leading into the ice, though sizeable chunks float in our way, posing a hazard.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: I have ordered us to moor against the outer ice wall while the engineers make adjustments to better prepare the vessel.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: I have ordered us to moor against the outer ice wall while the engineers make adjustments to better prepare the vessel.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: Adjustments were completed and we began maneuvering through the closest channel.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: Adjustments were completed and we began maneuvering through the closest channel.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: After a time, the narrow channel opened up into a large lagoon. During the night, some of the men reported seeing lights coming from under the ice.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: After a time, the narrow channel opened up into a large lagoon. During the night, some of the men reported seeing lights coming from under the ice.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: We shall establish a temporary encampment on an island in the center of the lagoon to see if we can excavate the source.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: We shall establish a temporary encampment on an island in the center of the lagoon to see if we can excavate the source.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: Setup of the encampment is complete, and some surface samples were gathered. No trace of the glowing light could be found.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: Setup of the encampment is complete, and some surface samples were gathered. No trace of the glowing light could be found.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: Perhaps we will dig deeper tomorrow, though I hesitate to spend any more time on this endeavour. Our purview is geographical charting.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: Perhaps we will dig deeper tomorrow, though I hesitate to spend any more time on this endeavour. Our purview is geographical charting.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: As I lay falling asleep, the most almighty voice spoke unto me. It resounded from the thick ice below, at once both powerful and ethereal.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: As I lay falling asleep, the most almighty voice spoke unto me. It resounded from the thick ice below, at once both powerful and ethereal.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: There was no mistaking this as a trick of the wind, nor a jest by the crew. It did not pause for response or acknowledgement, but whispered a [C3]cryptic prophesy[/C3].
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: There was no mistaking this as a trick of the wind, nor a jest by the crew. It did not pause for response or acknowledgement, but whispered a [C3]cryptic prophesy[/C3].

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: At first, I could not make sense of it - "[C3]Three listeners shall hear the heart[/C3]", and that I should indulge these "[C3]listeners[/C3]".
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: At first, I could not make sense of it - "[C3]Three listeners shall hear the heart[/C3]", and that I should indulge these "[C3]listeners[/C3]".

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: It spoke of "[C1]boundless wealth from the stars[/C1]" and of "[C0]eyes opening unto the world[/C0]".
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: It spoke of "[C1]boundless wealth from the stars[/C1]" and of "[C0]eyes opening unto the world[/C0]".

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: The rest of my sleep was feverish, as my mind was plagued with the sound of the voice. It spun in my head, echoing ever louder.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: The rest of my sleep was feverish, as my mind was plagued with the sound of the voice. It spun in my head, echoing ever louder.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: In the morning, the [C0]Boatswain[/C0] and the [C0]Navigator[/C0] came to me separately, claiming to have heard a [C3]sound like a heartbeat[/C3] as the men were digging yesterday.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: In the morning, the [C0]Boatswain[/C0] and the [C0]Navigator[/C0] came to me separately, claiming to have heard a [C3]sound like a heartbeat[/C3] as the men were digging yesterday.

rows.speaker: Captain's Log
rows.text: They indicated a desire to explore the [C0]Eastern[/C0] and [C0]Western[/C0] reaches of the ice field. I shall indulge them.
rows.raw_text: CAPTAINS_LOG_NAME_KEY: They indicated a desire to explore the [C0]Eastern[/C0] and [C0]Western[/C0] reaches of the ice field. I shall indulge them.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You rummage through the small pile of equipment in the snow. Most items are stuck fast in the ice, but inside a small backpack you find an [C0]old journal[/C0].
rows.raw_text: You rummage through the small pile of equipment in the snow. Most items are stuck fast in the ice, but inside a small backpack you find an [C0]old journal[/C0].

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: Captain ordered us to make camp on the ice in the center of the lagoon. After we saw those lights in the ice, everyone's got [C1]treasure[/C1] on their minds.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: Captain ordered us to make camp on the ice in the center of the lagoon. After we saw those lights in the ice, everyone's got [C1]treasure[/C1] on their minds.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: Treasure hunting isn't exactly what the expedition was commissioned for, but given the Captain gets the lion's share of whatever we find...
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: Treasure hunting isn't exactly what the expedition was commissioned for, but given the Captain gets the lion's share of whatever we find...

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: It doesn't surprise me that he's willing to bend the rules a bit. We'll start digging after the camp's done.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: It doesn't surprise me that he's willing to bend the rules a bit. We'll start digging after the camp's done.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: Spent the day digging down in the ice. Shovels and ice picks. Can't remember the last time I was this tired.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: Spent the day digging down in the ice. Shovels and ice picks. Can't remember the last time I was this tired.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: We were only allowed two short breaks all day. Down in the pit, as I rested with my back against the ice, I started hearing something.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: We were only allowed two short breaks all day. Down in the pit, as I rested with my back against the ice, I started hearing something.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: It was different to the sounds of the picks. They were short and sharp. This was low, a rumble from deeper down.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: It was different to the sounds of the picks. They were short and sharp. This was low, a rumble from deeper down.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: On my first break, it was occasional. Only a few each minute. By my second break, it had quickened, like a heartbeat.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: On my first break, it was occasional. Only a few each minute. By my second break, it had quickened, like a heartbeat.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: The Captain overheard me telling some others about the sound I heard in the pit. Before I knew it, I was in front of his desk, sure I was about to have my pay docked.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: The Captain overheard me telling some others about the sound I heard in the pit. Before I knew it, I was in front of his desk, sure I was about to have my pay docked.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: To my great surprise, he seemed to know something of it already. He was keen on hearing it described, over and over.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: To my great surprise, he seemed to know something of it already. He was keen on hearing it described, over and over.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: He wants me to help locate the source of it. When he pressed me on it further, I said that it did seem to be coming from the East.
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: He wants me to help locate the source of it. When he pressed me on it further, I said that it did seem to be coming from the East.

rows.speaker: Tattered Diary
rows.text: Tomorrow, we are setting off to see if we can find it. Perhaps I shall get a bonus after this is done!
rows.raw_text: TATTERED_DIARY_NAME_KEY: Tomorrow, we are setting off to see if we can find it. Perhaps I shall get a bonus after this is done!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: There are very few pieces that still remain - whoever made camp here was poorly prepared. Inside a small bag, you find a [C0]leather bound journal[/C0].
rows.raw_text: There are very few pieces that still remain - whoever made camp here was poorly prepared. Inside a small bag, you find a [C0]leather bound journal[/C0].
