rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: The men spent the whole day digging. They passed up chunks of ice, some as brilliant as crystal, others of a deepest blue more beautiful than sapphires.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: The men spent the whole day digging. They passed up chunks of ice, some as brilliant as crystal, others of a deepest blue more beautiful than sapphires.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: But none held the glow we had seen in the night. However, I did note a disturbance in the ice to the West.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: But none held the glow we had seen in the night. However, I did note a disturbance in the ice to the West.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: It began as a periodic, distant rumble. As the men dug deeper, the pulsing quickened, strengthening until I could see the ice shifting on the surface.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: It began as a periodic, distant rumble. As the men dug deeper, the pulsing quickened, strengthening until I could see the ice shifting on the surface.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: I shall have to inform the Captain. It may well be that Narwhal creature we saw earlier, though this did seem much larger.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: I shall have to inform the Captain. It may well be that Narwhal creature we saw earlier, though this did seem much larger.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: As I write this, I can already feel my eyes closing. It will have to wait until the morning.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: As I write this, I can already feel my eyes closing. It will have to wait until the morning.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: This morning, the Captain appeared out of the fog, rowing alone. Apparently, the Boatswain remains at a camp in the East, waiting for nightfall.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: This morning, the Captain appeared out of the fog, rowing alone. Apparently, the Boatswain remains at a camp in the East, waiting for nightfall.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: They were unsuccessful in their search, but it does make sense that the lights would be more visible at night.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: They were unsuccessful in their search, but it does make sense that the lights would be more visible at night.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: Tomorrow, we're to journey together to the West, towards the shifting ice that I reported.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: Tomorrow, we're to journey together to the West, towards the shifting ice that I reported.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: He is on edge, his head turning this way and that, listening for the slightest sound. He is convinced something will happen after dark.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: He is on edge, his head turning this way and that, listening for the slightest sound. He is convinced something will happen after dark.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: As the last light from the cold sun fades, I have the sense that it will be a long night.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: As the last light from the cold sun fades, I have the sense that it will be a long night.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: It looks like someone built a feeding station for that [C3]monstrous Narwhal[/C3]. Perhaps its appetite would be [C1]satisfied[/C1] by an [C0]offering of fish[/C0].
rows.raw_text: It looks like someone built a feeding station for that [C3]monstrous Narwhal[/C3]. Perhaps its appetite would be [C1]satisfied[/C1] by an [C0]offering of fish[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You approach a hooded figure. They seem to be frozen to the spot, pale robes frosted over with a heavy rime.
rows.raw_text: You approach a hooded figure. They seem to be frozen to the spot, pale robes frosted over with a heavy rime.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 5
rows.text: Fisherman...the ice.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_5_NAME_KEY: Fisherman...the ice.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You hear their jaw snap shut again from the cold.
rows.raw_text: You hear their jaw snap shut again from the cold.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 5
rows.text: The ice...takes form.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_5_NAME_KEY: The ice...takes form.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The hooded figure withdraws a scroll from their robes and unfurls it to reveal a drawing of a corrupted fish - an [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Icefish[/C0].
rows.raw_text: The hooded figure withdraws a scroll from their robes and unfurls it to reveal a drawing of a corrupted fish - an [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Icefish[/C0].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The hooded figure places the fish on the ice at their feet, kicking loose snow over to cover it.
rows.raw_text: The hooded figure places the fish on the ice at their feet, kicking loose snow over to cover it.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 5
rows.text: The stars...leave the sky.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_5_NAME_KEY: The stars...leave the sky.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Another scroll, another twisted shape. Images of [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Sea Stars[/C0] cover the paper.
rows.raw_text: Another scroll, another twisted shape. Images of [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Sea Stars[/C0] cover the paper.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The [C0]Sea Stars[/C0] are arranged in a circle on the ground. Moments later, a sinewy heel stomps down through each of them.
rows.raw_text: The [C0]Sea Stars[/C0] are arranged in a circle on the ground. Moments later, a sinewy heel stomps down through each of them.

rows.speaker: Hooded Figure 5
rows.text: Fall...to the deep.
rows.raw_text: HOODED_FIGURE_5_NAME_KEY: Fall...to the deep.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A final scroll, this one stained in patches by some dark liquid. In the center, the shape of an [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Stargazer[/C0] peers from the page.
rows.raw_text: A final scroll, this one stained in patches by some dark liquid. In the center, the shape of an [C3]Aberrated[/C3] [C0]Stargazer[/C0] peers from the page.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The figure places the body of the [C0]Stargazer[/C0] in the center of the crushed [C0]Sea Stars[/C0]. They angle its cratered eye to the sky.
rows.raw_text: The figure places the body of the [C0]Stargazer[/C0] in the center of the crushed [C0]Sea Stars[/C0]. They angle its cratered eye to the sky.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Attention still fixed on the gruesome pile of fish in front of it, the hooded figure gestures to a [C1]Book[/C1] on a nearby rock. Your payment.
rows.raw_text: Attention still fixed on the gruesome pile of fish in front of it, the hooded figure gestures to a [C1]Book[/C1] on a nearby rock. Your payment.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: As you leave, the figure is still focused on the grim fish - adjusting its position, waiting, adjusting, over and over.
rows.raw_text: As you leave, the figure is still focused on the grim fish - adjusting its position, waiting, adjusting, over and over.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Darkness. The deep. Then, sparks of light as tooth and spine meet horn and nail. Two primeval forces clashing at the bottom of the world.
rows.raw_text: Darkness. The deep. Then, sparks of light as tooth and spine meet horn and nail. Two primeval forces clashing at the bottom of the world.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: After an age, a victor triumphs, sundering the other into impossibly large remnants that ascend to the surface, slowly, to be claimed by the sky.
rows.raw_text: After an age, a victor triumphs, sundering the other into impossibly large remnants that ascend to the surface, slowly, to be claimed by the sky.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: But the broken body holds power still. Threads of crimson essence reach out through the water, stretching to unite the creature once more.
rows.raw_text: But the broken body holds power still. Threads of crimson essence reach out through the water, stretching to unite the creature once more.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: As the remains break the surface, ice begins to form.
rows.raw_text: As the remains break the surface, ice begins to form.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Intruders. They invade on tiny wooden vessels, shouting and smashing. They cut and slice with angled metal, raking across a skin of ice.
rows.raw_text: Intruders. They invade on tiny wooden vessels, shouting and smashing. They cut and slice with angled metal, raking across a skin of ice.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Their meagre hearts beat with avarice and pride, desires trivially twisted into new shapes. Shapes that might mend and restore.
rows.raw_text: Their meagre hearts beat with avarice and pride, desires trivially twisted into new shapes. Shapes that might mend and restore.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Shapes to replace what was lost, down in the dark.
rows.raw_text: Shapes to replace what was lost, down in the dark.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: We are alone on a small island of ice.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: We are alone on a small island of ice.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: After hours of rowing through narrow channels, it rose through the fog. A gargantuan, monstrous claw, reaching from the deep.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: After hours of rowing through narrow channels, it rose through the fog. A gargantuan, monstrous claw, reaching from the deep.

rows.speaker: Leather Journal
rows.text: Whatever creature it once belonged to must be long dead, as the claw is frozen solid. I wanted to turn back immediately, but the Captain insisted we investigate.
rows.raw_text: LEATHER_JOURNAL_NAME_KEY: Whatever creature it once belonged to must be long dead, as the claw is frozen solid. I wanted to turn back immediately, but the Captain insisted we investigate.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: What do you want?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: What do you want?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: If you're able to [C1]find any of those crates[C1], I'm sure the corp would let you [C1]use our facilities[/C1]. Once we get the [C0]Generator[/C0] wired up, that is.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: If you're able to [C1]find any of those crates[C1], I'm sure the corp would let you [C1]use our facilities[/C1]. Once we get the [C0]Generator[/C0] wired up, that is.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: That oughta be enough to get the [C0]Generator[/C0] going! I'll get these materials sent up to the main platform.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: That oughta be enough to get the [C0]Generator[/C0] going! I'll get these materials sent up to the main platform.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: So, that should be in working order, but, I just checked the storeroom, and it looks like we [C2]never got any fuel deliveries[/C2].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: So, that should be in working order, but, I just checked the storeroom, and it looks like we [C2]never got any fuel deliveries[/C2].

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Hey there. Welcome to the Factory. I'm the lead engineer here.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Hey there. Welcome to the Factory. I'm the lead engineer here.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Because of your help getting things running here, I'm permitted to [C1]improve your equipment with our tech[/C1].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Because of your help getting things running here, I'm permitted to [C1]improve your equipment with our tech[/C1].

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: These are some designs I've been tinkering with for passive harvesting methods.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: These are some designs I've been tinkering with for passive harvesting methods.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We've got various off-cuts and scraps here, I can usually turn them into something.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We've got various off-cuts and scraps here, I can usually turn them into something.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We've got what we need.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We've got what we need.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Let's get to work.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Let's get to work.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We're making good progress on getting the Factory fully operational.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We're making good progress on getting the Factory fully operational.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Alright, here's what we'll need to put that together.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Alright, here's what we'll need to put that together.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: That should do it.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: That should do it.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Hey, you forgot to take this with you earlier.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Hey, you forgot to take this with you earlier.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: So, this is where we're going to build some sort of machine to repel those tentacles, right? That's what the Scientist said.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: So, this is where we're going to build some sort of machine to repel those tentacles, right? That's what the Scientist said.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: YOU HAVE RETURNED.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: YOU HAVE RETURNED.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We'll get started.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We'll get started.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Defenses are primed. Turning them on now. This had better work.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Defenses are primed. Turning them on now. This had better work.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: I reckon we can repurpose some of that slag from the Science Lab. Toss it into the water, see what turns up to investigate.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: I reckon we can repurpose some of that slag from the Science Lab. Toss it into the water, see what turns up to investigate.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: The Factory's core facilities should be up and running.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: The Factory's core facilities should be up and running.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: The Factory's core facilities have been improved. We can make some more items now.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: The Factory's core facilities have been improved. We can make some more items now.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Fisherman, I think you're going to like what we can make here now.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Fisherman, I think you're going to like what we can make here now.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: That'll do it for the Factory!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: That'll do it for the Factory!

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: This Factory's running at peak efficiency. We've got all we need.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: This Factory's running at peak efficiency. We've got all we need.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Fleet Services root. Is this unbuilt?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Fleet Services root. Is this unbuilt?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Fleet Services description. This is built, right?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Fleet Services description. This is built, right?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Alright, we'll get to work on Fleet Services.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Alright, we'll get to work on Fleet Services.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Everything should be operational here, sir.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Everything should be operational here, sir.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Place isn't built yet.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Place isn't built yet.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Basic materials can be worked here.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Basic materials can be worked here.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: You find any excess crates, I'm sure we can come to some sort of arrangement.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: You find any excess crates, I'm sure we can come to some sort of arrangement.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: That's all we need; we can get the Foundry built now.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: That's all we need; we can get the Foundry built now.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Good to go.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Good to go.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Alright, we'll start upgrading the Foundry.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Alright, we'll start upgrading the Foundry.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Should be able to make some better stuff now.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Should be able to make some better stuff now.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: You want that made, I'll be needing some things from you.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: You want that made, I'll be needing some things from you.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Mmh. That's done.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Mmh. That's done.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Take your stuff with you next time.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Take your stuff with you next time.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: When the [C0]Tech Lab[/C0] is operational, we'll be able to work on projects of a more technical nature.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: When the [C0]Tech Lab[/C0] is operational, we'll be able to work on projects of a more technical nature.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We're not quite ready for construction yet. Missing materials - can you help?
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We're not quite ready for construction yet. Missing materials - can you help?

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: This wing is for the [C1]enhancement[/C1] of boat functions; [C0]lights[/C0], [C0]horn[/C0] and [C0]spyglass[/C0].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: This wing is for the [C1]enhancement[/C1] of boat functions; [C0]lights[/C0], [C0]horn[/C0] and [C0]spyglass[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Everything appears to be in order. I'll get the team onto it.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Everything appears to be in order. I'll get the team onto it.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: At last. I'm excited for you to try some of these out.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: At last. I'm excited for you to try some of these out.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: That's everything. We'll get to work.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: That's everything. We'll get to work.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: The Tech Lab is fully built now!
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: The Tech Lab is fully built now!

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: These are a little complex; here's the list of items I'll need.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: These are a little complex; here's the list of items I'll need.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: That one's done.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: That one's done.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Oh, you left this here before. I held onto it for you.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Oh, you left this here before. I held onto it for you.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Hmm? Who are you? Ah; the angler turned courier, isn't that right? The workers were talking about you.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Hmm? Who are you? Ah; the angler turned courier, isn't that right? The workers were talking about you.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: THE SCIENCE LAB REMAINS UNBUILT. IS THIS LINE EVER EVEN SHOWN?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: THE SCIENCE LAB REMAINS UNBUILT. IS THIS LINE EVER EVEN SHOWN?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Oh, we've got enough material for the [C0]Science Lab[/C0] now too? We'll get to work.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Oh, we've got enough material for the [C0]Science Lab[/C0] now too? We'll get to work.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Yes, more than sufficient for my needs. Thank you, both of you.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Yes, more than sufficient for my needs. Thank you, both of you.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: How can I help you?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: How can I help you?

rows.text: \[Leave.\]
rows.raw_text: \[Leave.\]

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: So, it turns out the fuel never got dispatched from Ironhaven at all.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: So, it turns out the fuel never got dispatched from Ironhaven at all.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: You can add fish or...most other biological material, I suppose, to the hopper here. Once it's filled we ought to be able to start the drill.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: You can add fish or...most other biological material, I suppose, to the hopper here. Once it's filled we ought to be able to start the drill.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: It won't hold any more - I'll fire it up!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: It won't hold any more - I'll fire it up!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: While I go and figure out the [C2]fuel situation[/C2], why don't you introduce yourself to the head [C0]Scientist[/C0]? He's always interested to hear about the local fish species.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: While I go and figure out the [C2]fuel situation[/C2], why don't you introduce yourself to the head [C0]Scientist[/C0]? He's always interested to hear about the local fish species.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: I was planning on conducting [C0]research into fish species[/C0] in the area. But I can't do that without somewhere to study.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: I was planning on conducting [C0]research into fish species[/C0] in the area. But I can't do that without somewhere to study.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I think we have a solution for our [C2]fuel problem[/C2] - come see me at the [C0]Generator[/C0] and I'll give you the rundown.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I think we have a solution for our [C2]fuel problem[/C2] - come see me at the [C0]Generator[/C0] and I'll give you the rundown.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You dock at a small metal wharf. Four giant legs stretch down into the deep, lifting a mountain of metal into the sky.
rows.raw_text: You dock at a small metal wharf. Four giant legs stretch down into the deep, lifting a mountain of metal into the sky.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: HERE IS A ROD THAT I PREPARED EARLIER.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: HERE IS A ROD THAT I PREPARED EARLIER.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Do you have those samples from [C0]The Marrows[/C0] yet?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Do you have those samples from [C0]The Marrows[/C0] yet?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Have you had time to gather samples from [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Have you had time to gather samples from [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0]?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Have you collected all of those samples from [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0] yet?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Have you collected all of those samples from [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0] yet?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The fish...from [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0]...do you have them?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The fish...from [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0]...do you have them?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Closer...pure...[C0]Devil's Spine[/C0]...the wretches...where are they?!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Closer...pure...[C0]Devil's Spine[/C0]...the wretches...where are they?!

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: I WILL TRANSFORM HERE.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: I WILL TRANSFORM HERE.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Admittedly, the [C2]fissure[/C2] is larger than my models suggested, but it appears to have stabilized. We should consider [C0]halting the drilling[/C0] for now.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Admittedly, the [C2]fissure[/C2] is larger than my models suggested, but it appears to have stabilized. We should consider [C0]halting the drilling[/C0] for now.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Using that rod, I need you to [C0]collect specimen samples[/C0] from [C0]The Marrows[/C0], just to check that the fish species are unaffected by our operations here.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Using that rod, I need you to [C0]collect specimen samples[/C0] from [C0]The Marrows[/C0], just to check that the fish species are unaffected by our operations here.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU HAVE CONSTRUCTED THE FACTORY AND RECEIVED A ROD.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU HAVE CONSTRUCTED THE FACTORY AND RECEIVED A ROD.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM THE MARROWS.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM THE MARROWS.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU SHOULD MAKE SOME DEFENCES. TALK TO MY STUDENT IN STELLAR BASIN, SHE HAS THE TECH.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU SHOULD MAKE SOME DEFENCES. TALK TO MY STUDENT IN STELLAR BASIN, SHE HAS THE TECH.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM STELLAR BASIN.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM STELLAR BASIN.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM TWISTED STRAND.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM TWISTED STRAND.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM DEVIL'S SPINE.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: YOU SHOULD GO AND GET SOME SAMPLES FROM DEVIL'S SPINE.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: NOW THAT YOU HAVE AN ADVANCED ROD, YOU CAN COLLECT SAMPLES.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: NOW THAT YOU HAVE AN ADVANCED ROD, YOU CAN COLLECT SAMPLES.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Scientist is interrupted by the Foreman outside, shouting through his megaphone again. The Foreman bellows an order.
rows.raw_text: The Scientist is interrupted by the Foreman outside, shouting through his megaphone again. The Foreman bellows an order.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Engage reverse gear! Get that drill out of there!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Engage reverse gear! Get that drill out of there!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.
rows.raw_text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: FIRE UP THE DRILL!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: FIRE UP THE DRILL!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.
rows.raw_text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: FIRE UP THE DRILL!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: FIRE UP THE DRILL!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: What's that noise?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: What's that noise?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: FIRE UP THE DRILL!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: FIRE UP THE DRILL!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.
rows.raw_text: OUTSIDE, YOU HEAR A CLAMOR OF SHOUTING WORKERS. THE FOREMAN SAYS SOMETHING.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: FIRE UP THE DRILL!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: FIRE UP THE DRILL!

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: ...as I was saying. I'll run some quick tests on these specimens. Though from the sounds of things, you may have some additional samples to gather.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: ...as I was saying. I'll run some quick tests on these specimens. Though from the sounds of things, you may have some additional samples to gather.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Unfortunately there have been reports of some [C3]contaminatants[/C3] leaking from the fissure in isolated pockets.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Unfortunately there have been reports of some [C3]contaminatants[/C3] leaking from the fissure in isolated pockets.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Have you collected a canister of that [C3]contaminant[/C3] yet?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Have you collected a canister of that [C3]contaminant[/C3] yet?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Thank you. It's always important to know what we're dealing with in operations such as these.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Thank you. It's always important to know what we're dealing with in operations such as these.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: There's something gigantic, something incredibly powerful, gripping the rig! So...it's really here.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: There's something gigantic, something incredibly powerful, gripping the rig! So...it's really here.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Fisherman. This structure...the people on it...can't stand up to this. I have - well, [C0]I had a student[/C0]. She was developing some [C1]technology[/C1].
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Fisherman. This structure...the people on it...can't stand up to this. I have - well, [C0]I had a student[/C0]. She was developing some [C1]technology[/C1].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: IT'S BAD ENOUGH THAT THE FLEET SERVICES BUILDING ISN'T UP AND RUNNING YET. CAN YOU HELP WITH THAT?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: IT'S BAD ENOUGH THAT THE FLEET SERVICES BUILDING ISN'T UP AND RUNNING YET. CAN YOU HELP WITH THAT?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Someone from the Ironhaven Corporation sent me.
rows.raw_text: Someone from the Ironhaven Corporation sent me.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: And we're back on track. While he overstepped his corporate responsibility, it appears the Foreman was right to enlist your assistance.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: And we're back on track. While he overstepped his corporate responsibility, it appears the Foreman was right to enlist your assistance.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He walks away, muttering something about modulating voices and waves.
rows.raw_text: He walks away, muttering something about modulating voices and waves.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Yes...remarkable...the power spikes. Hmm. Fisherman, don't forget about those samples.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Yes...remarkable...the power spikes. Hmm. Fisherman, don't forget about those samples.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: MAYBE THE EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE SOME DIALOGUE HERE TOO.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: MAYBE THE EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE SOME DIALOGUE HERE TOO.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Excellent. Remember Fisherman, I'll permit the workers to [C1]upgrade your hull[/C1] with our tech here.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Excellent. Remember Fisherman, I'll permit the workers to [C1]upgrade your hull[/C1] with our tech here.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I didn't expect that name to follow me all the way out here. Perhaps that was naive of me.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I didn't expect that name to follow me all the way out here. Perhaps that was naive of me.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I couldn't give a damn about the rig, or the corp. But not everyone there deserves to face the consequences of the corp's actions.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I couldn't give a damn about the rig, or the corp. But not everyone there deserves to face the consequences of the corp's actions.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)

rows.text: About those defenses on the rig...
rows.raw_text: About those defenses on the rig...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You walk the perimeter of the tower. One of the electrical panels hasn't been securely fastened.
rows.raw_text: You walk the perimeter of the tower. One of the electrical panels hasn't been securely fastened.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You open the panel. Inside, a bundle of cables travels from a [C0]black box[/C0], up into the heights of the tower.
rows.raw_text: You open the panel. Inside, a bundle of cables travels from a [C0]black box[/C0], up into the heights of the tower.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: After finding the loose panel housing the electrical guts of the tower, you pull out the blueprint for the "[C3]RISE[/C3]" module.
rows.raw_text: After finding the loose panel housing the electrical guts of the tower, you pull out the blueprint for the "[C3]RISE[/C3]" module.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You remove the old module and insert the new one. As it clicks into place, the sound from the tower changes into a deep rumble.
rows.raw_text: You remove the old module and insert the new one. As it clicks into place, the sound from the tower changes into a deep rumble.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With the last scraps of metal still falling from the destroyed drill tower, the Executive boards his helicopter, rotors already spinning.
rows.raw_text: With the last scraps of metal still falling from the destroyed drill tower, the Executive boards his helicopter, rotors already spinning.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: What do you want?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: The ships delivering [C0]crates of materials[/C0] keep [C2]going missing[/C2] - and HQ said they're not able to dispatch any more for a few weeks.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: The ships delivering [C0]crates of materials[/C0] keep [C2]going missing[/C2] - and HQ said they're not able to dispatch any more for a few weeks.

rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Look, I wouldn't normally ask a civilian for help, but we're already so far behind... Why don't I mark the [C0]last known coordinates of those ships on your map[/C0]?

rows.raw_text: You approach an old man, pacing back and forth near a cordoned off area on the main platform. He's muttering to himself quietly.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: All good things, I promise. Say, you must know a great deal about the fish species around here, yes? What've you encountered in these waters?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: All good things, I promise. Say, you must know a great deal about the fish species around here, yes? What've you encountered in these waters?

rows.text: You may have certain...preconceived notions about the Ironhaven Corporation's modus operandi, but I assure you, everything we do is with the good of the greater ecosystem in mind.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: You may have certain...preconceived notions about the Ironhaven Corporation's modus operandi, but I assure you, everything we do is with the good of the greater ecosystem in mind.

rows.raw_text: Instead of rolling his eyes, as most people do when they sense a fisherman's tale approaching, the Scientist's eyes glisten with an intense curiosity.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Is that so? Perhaps you'll find me a little more imaginative than others.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Is that so? Perhaps you'll find me a little more imaginative than others.

rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Before we get into all of that though, it seems my laboratory is also a victim of a missing supply shipment.

rows.text: I was on the radio to HQ: apparently, this is a [C0]Biofuel Generator[/C0]. It's some new tech the corp wanted to trial out here - and they expected us to supply it ourselves.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I was on the radio to HQ: apparently, this is a [C0]Biofuel Generator[/C0]. It's some new tech the corp wanted to trial out here - and they expected us to supply it ourselves.

rows.text: Thing is, they didn't think to outfit us with any gear for harvesting biomass, and the [C0]Fleet Services[/C0] construction is way down the project list.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Thing is, they didn't think to outfit us with any gear for harvesting biomass, and the [C0]Fleet Services[/C0] construction is way down the project list.

rows.text: Ever since we got the legs of the platform seated on the seafloor, the supply ships started going missing. HQ told us they'd left port, but they never showed up.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Ever since we got the legs of the platform seated on the seafloor, the supply ships started going missing. HQ told us they'd left port, but they never showed up.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I guess the crews thought they could make some money sailing off with the materials and selling them elsewhere. Doesn't seem worth the risk to me.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I guess the crews thought they could make some money sailing off with the materials and selling them elsewhere. Doesn't seem worth the risk to me.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: The rig is your standard setup, designed to pierce the seabed and collect from fluid reservoirs. It doesn't have much storage capacity though, which is odd. Maybe they're not expecting huge throughput.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: The rig is your standard setup, designed to pierce the seabed and collect from fluid reservoirs. It doesn't have much storage capacity though, which is odd. Maybe they're not expecting huge throughput.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I didn't actually think there was an oil field out here, but I suppose the surveyors must have found something - else I wouldn't be here talking to you.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I didn't actually think there was an oil field out here, but I suppose the surveyors must have found something - else I wouldn't be here talking to you.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I've been with the corp for about a decade now; started out as a laborer on projects like this one - not always out to sea, mind you - and I've worked my way up to site foreman.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I've been with the corp for about a decade now; started out as a laborer on projects like this one - not always out to sea, mind you - and I've worked my way up to site foreman.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: The corp itself? It's pretty successful, bit of an institution. It's been around for hundreds of years, in one form or another. They always seem to be diversifying into new areas.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: The corp itself? It's pretty successful, bit of an institution. It's been around for hundreds of years, in one form or another. They always seem to be diversifying into new areas.

rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: The whole drilling division is guided by the [C0]Scientist[/C0]. He calls the shots when it comes to deciding on sites. Boss seems to listen to him, too.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I'm the site foreman, and this is the [C0]Ironhaven Corporation[/C0]'s new drilling rig. Or, it would be, if we were on schedule. Right now it's just a platform.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I'm the site foreman, and this is the [C0]Ironhaven Corporation[/C0]'s new drilling rig. Or, it would be, if we were on schedule. Right now it's just a platform.

rows.raw_text: The Scientist walks over, gripping handrails to counteract the shockwaves from the drill.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: We've broken through! We're underway at last!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: We've broken through! We're underway at last!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: And what about that [C2]huge crack[/C2] that opened up?! Is the reservoir stable?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: And what about that [C2]huge crack[/C2] that opened up?! Is the reservoir stable?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Also, we would be remiss in our duties to the local population if we didn't [C0]survey the area[/C0] and [C0]gather some data[/C0]. In that vein, fisherman, I have something for you.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Also, we would be remiss in our duties to the local population if we didn't [C0]survey the area[/C0] and [C0]gather some data[/C0]. In that vein, fisherman, I have something for you.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The [C0]Factory[/C0] has recently become operational, allowing us to manufacture [C1]equipment infused with the corporation's latest breakthroughs[/C1]. This is a new design.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The [C0]Factory[/C0] has recently become operational, allowing us to manufacture [C1]equipment infused with the corporation's latest breakthroughs[/C1]. This is a new design.

rows.raw_text: The Scientist looks taken aback. He consults some papers on his desk, then leafs through an old encyclopedia.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: This is...remarkable. Some of these species...have you caught these before? They haven't been seen outside the fossil record since...well, ever!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: This is...remarkable. Some of these species...have you caught these before? They haven't been seen outside the fossil record since...well, ever!

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: I suppose it could make sense; the fissure opening caused some kind of disturbance in the deep, possibly spooking some of these fish up the water column.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: I suppose it could make sense; the fissure opening caused some kind of disturbance in the deep, possibly spooking some of these fish up the water column.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: I'll run some tests on these -
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: I'll run some tests on these -

rows.speaker: Scientist

rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: We must know...where these creatures entered...where the [C3]blood[/C3]...
