rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: GIVE HULL REPAIR KIT HERE.
rows.raw_text: GIVE HULL REPAIR KIT HERE.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: THERE MAY BE ANOTHER CUTSCENE HERE WHERE THE EXECUTIVE FLIES AWAY.
rows.raw_text: THERE MAY BE ANOTHER CUTSCENE HERE WHERE THE EXECUTIVE FLIES AWAY.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Uh, is everyone alright?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Uh, is everyone alright?

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: All accounted for in the Factory.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: All accounted for in the Factory.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Mmmh. Yep. Foundry's fine.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Mmmh. Yep. Foundry's fine.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I guess we'll wait for our airlifts outta here. There's no way I'm travelling anywhere by boat.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I guess we'll wait for our airlifts outta here. There's no way I'm travelling anywhere by boat.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Yeah, I'll sit tight for now. Fisherman, the main buildings are mostly undamaged, so if you still need stuff made, we can sort you out.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Yeah, I'll sit tight for now. Fisherman, the main buildings are mostly undamaged, so if you still need stuff made, we can sort you out.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He holds it up to the light. For a moment, the fluorescent bulbs in the room flicker and buzz, light recoiling in a pattern against the ceiling.
rows.raw_text: He holds it up to the light. For a moment, the fluorescent bulbs in the room flicker and buzz, light recoiling in a pattern against the ceiling.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: If he saw anything noteworthy about the liquid, he doesn't let on.
rows.raw_text: If he saw anything noteworthy about the liquid, he doesn't let on.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Scientist arranges the specimens, now laid out on a metal table in front of him. He connects electrodes and wires to the head of each.
rows.raw_text: The Scientist arranges the specimens, now laid out on a metal table in front of him. He connects electrodes and wires to the head of each.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The brains of fish are primitive. In many ways, their simplicity is a kind of purity. No burdensome emotions to confuse the data.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The brains of fish are primitive. In many ways, their simplicity is a kind of purity. No burdensome emotions to confuse the data.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Just as rigor mortis locks the muscles, the final shape of the mind is held by the brain. But it can be...extracted.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Just as rigor mortis locks the muscles, the final shape of the mind is held by the brain. But it can be...extracted.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The room is pierced with the sharp sound of capacitors charging. The corpses on the bench jolt in unison, slackened muscles arch and tense before lying still again.
rows.raw_text: The room is pierced with the sharp sound of capacitors charging. The corpses on the bench jolt in unison, slackened muscles arch and tense before lying still again.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Scientist is already looking at the four monitors behind him. The same vague shape scrolls across each screen; ragged circle, writhing cell, lidless eye, yawning pit.
rows.raw_text: The Scientist is already looking at the four monitors behind him. The same vague shape scrolls across each screen; ragged circle, writhing cell, lidless eye, yawning pit.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The difficulty is in reading it.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The difficulty is in reading it.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: With the corporation leadership here...I have to focus. There are...pressures acting upon me.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: With the corporation leadership here...I have to focus. There are...pressures acting upon me.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He places the specimens into a large metal chamber before sealing the lid. A motor runs briefly, and a pressure gauge on the chamber rises.
rows.raw_text: He places the specimens into a large metal chamber before sealing the lid. A motor runs briefly, and a pressure gauge on the chamber rises.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The [C3]elder[/C3]...communicates in power...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The [C3]elder[/C3]...communicates in power...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He flips a large switch, and the metal chamber begins to spin. Slowly at first, then accelerating until the whole thing is a blur.
rows.raw_text: He flips a large switch, and the metal chamber begins to spin. Slowly at first, then accelerating until the whole thing is a blur.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Needles etch onto graph paper, transcribing the ascent of...something, scratched out at speed. A [C3]Dark Fluid[/C3] rises from a tube connected to the chamber.
rows.raw_text: Needles etch onto graph paper, transcribing the ascent of...something, scratched out at speed. A [C3]Dark Fluid[/C3] rises from a tube connected to the chamber.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Not yet...pure. We'll need more...down...deeper!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Not yet...pure. We'll need more...down...deeper!

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: IS THE SCIENTIST BEHIND THE BLACKBOARD HERE?
rows.raw_text: IS THE SCIENTIST BEHIND THE BLACKBOARD HERE?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With shocking speed he rushes towards the table, grabbing at the corpses.
rows.raw_text: With shocking speed he rushes towards the table, grabbing at the corpses.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The shape that bursts through the blackboard barely resembles the Scientist; no longer meek and cowed, now a frightening visage of stretched skin and sharp teeth.
rows.raw_text: The shape that bursts through the blackboard barely resembles the Scientist; no longer meek and cowed, now a frightening visage of stretched skin and sharp teeth.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With a sickening crunch, he bites down into the sea scorpion carcass, [C3]black liquid[/C3] dripping from his mouth.
rows.raw_text: With a sickening crunch, he bites down into the sea scorpion carcass, [C3]black liquid[/C3] dripping from his mouth.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: His terrible head snaps up to lock eyes with yours. A feral cry rises from his lungs, forming an accusatory scream with freshly born claws pointed in your direction.
rows.raw_text: His terrible head snaps up to lock eyes with yours. A feral cry rises from his lungs, forming an accusatory scream with freshly born claws pointed in your direction.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: With limbs overcome by frantic spasms, he stumbles towards the nearest window, slowly at first, then arriving at considerable speed.
rows.raw_text: With limbs overcome by frantic spasms, he stumbles towards the nearest window, slowly at first, then arriving at considerable speed.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: GLASS SHATTER HERE?
rows.raw_text: GLASS SHATTER HERE?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The aberrated form of the Scientist crashes through the glass, diving out, beyond the deck of the platform, down, hitting the water, then disappearing into the deep.
rows.raw_text: The aberrated form of the Scientist crashes through the glass, diving out, beyond the deck of the platform, down, hitting the water, then disappearing into the deep.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: MINI CUTSCENE HERE?
rows.raw_text: MINI CUTSCENE HERE?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Ah hell...that's enough! Drill is clear - I repeat - drill is clear. Shut it down!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Ah hell...that's enough! Drill is clear - I repeat - drill is clear. Shut it down!

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Down in the deep, something begins to brush against the legs of the rig.
rows.raw_text: Down in the deep, something begins to brush against the legs of the rig.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A droning voice begins to sound from the top of the rig, reverberating through the metal, down into the deep.
rows.raw_text: A droning voice begins to sound from the top of the rig, reverberating through the metal, down into the deep.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: But sir, the seafloor here...it shouldn't be disturbed; this whole rig is built on some kind of...living fault! You have to trust me!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: But sir, the seafloor here...it shouldn't be disturbed; this whole rig is built on some kind of...living fault! You have to trust me!

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Trust you? You, who couldn't even keep shipments in order, who involved locals, just to save your own hide?
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Trust you? You, who couldn't even keep shipments in order, who involved locals, just to save your own hide?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The Foreman cowers behind a clipboard.
rows.raw_text: The Foreman cowers behind a clipboard.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: You, who put this whole operation in jeopardy?!
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: You, who put this whole operation in jeopardy?!

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Enough of this! Your concerns end at steel and scaffolding; the future of this corporation is for me alone to decide!
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Enough of this! Your concerns end at steel and scaffolding; the future of this corporation is for me alone to decide!

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Fire it up.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Fire it up.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The drill descends once more into the blackness under the rig.
rows.raw_text: The drill descends once more into the blackness under the rig.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: We're almost there. Give it another push. How much power can we give this thing?
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: We're almost there. Give it another push. How much power can we give this thing?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Sir, I don't think - we really shouldn't...
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Sir, I don't think - we really shouldn't...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The executive shoots the foreman a glance, disdain and dismissal lacing the muscles on his face. The Foreman backs down, defeated.
rows.raw_text: The executive shoots the foreman a glance, disdain and dismissal lacing the muscles on his face. The Foreman backs down, defeated.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Setting the drill to full power, sir.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Setting the drill to full power, sir.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Machinery in the drill tower steps into overdrive, blurring the air with the sound of gears turning.
rows.raw_text: Machinery in the drill tower steps into overdrive, blurring the air with the sound of gears turning.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: It seems the reservoir is more unstable than we anticipated. Even with the [C1]drill removed[/C1], it appears the [C2]fissure is continuing to expand[/C2].
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: It seems the reservoir is more unstable than we anticipated. Even with the [C1]drill removed[/C1], it appears the [C2]fissure is continuing to expand[/C2].

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Scientist steps away from the nearby window, knuckles still white from gripping the frame moments before.
rows.raw_text: The Scientist steps away from the nearby window, knuckles still white from gripping the frame moments before.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He turns back and presses his forehead against the glass.
rows.raw_text: He turns back and presses his forehead against the glass.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: It was a way of...[C3]communicating[/C3], I suppose. We were working on emulating a language that we didn't fully understand. She began to twist the words.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: It was a way of...[C3]communicating[/C3], I suppose. We were working on emulating a language that we didn't fully understand. She began to twist the words.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: But she didn't agree with Ironhaven's methods. So, leveraging my role on the board for the Research Society, I pulled some strings and had her posted far away. To [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: But she didn't agree with Ironhaven's methods. So, leveraging my role on the board for the Research Society, I pulled some strings and had her posted far away. To [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Please, [C0]go and find her[/C0]. I hope she's progressed her research sufficiently to help us.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Please, [C0]go and find her[/C0]. I hope she's progressed her research sufficiently to help us.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: The man in the suit turns to you.
rows.raw_text: The man in the suit turns to you.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: There's one final building that needs to be constructed on this platform - [C0]Fleet Services[/C0]. Without this building, we're unable to scale our efforts efficiently.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: There's one final building that needs to be constructed on this platform - [C0]Fleet Services[/C0]. Without this building, we're unable to scale our efforts efficiently.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: I'll cut you a deal. If you assist in the construction of this building, I'll permit the workers to fit your vessel with a [C1]significant hull upgrade[/C1].
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: I'll cut you a deal. If you assist in the construction of this building, I'll permit the workers to fit your vessel with a [C1]significant hull upgrade[/C1].

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Get on with it.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Get on with it.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: As the roar of the [C0]giant creature[/C0] fades, it leaves behind a silence on all that witnessed it. Faces stare from windows and hands grip railings, trying to process the spectacle.
rows.raw_text: As the roar of the [C0]giant creature[/C0] fades, it leaves behind a silence on all that witnessed it. Faces stare from windows and hands grip railings, trying to process the spectacle.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Boss, that must have been the thing that got all our material shipments - and [C0]now it's coming for the rig[/C0]!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Boss, that must have been the thing that got all our material shipments - and [C0]now it's coming for the rig[/C0]!

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A murmur of panic begins to rise from the onlookers.
rows.raw_text: A murmur of panic begins to rise from the onlookers.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Uh, it still has a little way to go - but you can't be serious, surely? Not with that thing in the water here?! [C2]Our lives are in danger and you want to keep drilling?![/C2]
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Uh, it still has a little way to go - but you can't be serious, surely? Not with that thing in the water here?! [C2]Our lives are in danger and you want to keep drilling?![/C2]

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Get it done.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Get it done.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Executive turns and walks away towards his office, leaving the Foreman shaking his head.
rows.raw_text: The Executive turns and walks away towards his office, leaving the Foreman shaking his head.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: He's insane. What the hell are we doing here? This drill...whatever's down there. [S1]We shouldn't be disturbing it[/S1].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: He's insane. What the hell are we doing here? This drill...whatever's down there. [S1]We shouldn't be disturbing it[/S1].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Fisherman. You've got to help us. He won't listen to reason. But perhaps he'll listen to an...[C0]operational setback[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Fisherman. You've got to help us. He won't listen to reason. But perhaps he'll listen to an...[C0]operational setback[/C0].

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you have in mind?
rows.raw_text: What do you have in mind?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What do you mean by "operational setback"?
rows.raw_text: What do you mean by "operational setback"?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We can't shut down the drill ourselves - not without [C2]repercussions from the corporation following us for the rest of our lives[/C2].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We can't shut down the drill ourselves - not without [C2]repercussions from the corporation following us for the rest of our lives[/C2].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: But if it were to be damaged by a force of nature or...[C3]force of the deep[/C3], we'd have no choice but to abandon our positions.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: But if it were to be damaged by a force of nature or...[C3]force of the deep[/C3], we'd have no choice but to abandon our positions.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I know it sounds crazy. But if the [C0]defenses were to stop operating[/C0] suddenly, it would leave the [C1]drill vulnerable[/C1].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I know it sounds crazy. But if the [C0]defenses were to stop operating[/C0] suddenly, it would leave the [C1]drill vulnerable[/C1].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Please. Have a think, see what you can do.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Please. Have a think, see what you can do.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: So. What do you want?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: So. What do you want?

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: What else?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: What else?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Ironhaven Corporation has been constructing a drilling platform.
rows.raw_text: The Ironhaven Corporation has been constructing a drilling platform.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Ironhaven Corporation's head Scientist seems to know you.
rows.raw_text: Ironhaven Corporation's head Scientist seems to know you.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Tell me about the defensive tech you've been working on.
rows.raw_text: Tell me about the defensive tech you've been working on.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: We need to protect the rig and its workers.
rows.raw_text: We need to protect the rig and its workers.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: That's all.
rows.raw_text: That's all.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Oh, and you're helping them with that, I suppose? Do you have any idea what they're even doing?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Oh, and you're helping them with that, I suppose? Do you have any idea what they're even doing?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: She turns away and tries to recompose herself with a few deep breaths.
rows.raw_text: She turns away and tries to recompose herself with a few deep breaths.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Of course you don't. You're just trying to help. But you've seen what's happened to the water here - and elsewhere, I imagine.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Of course you don't. You're just trying to help. But you've seen what's happened to the water here - and elsewhere, I imagine.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: And I know him. He's the reason I was posted all the way out here, so far from home. He might've mentioned that I studied under him.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: And I know him. He's the reason I was posted all the way out here, so far from home. He might've mentioned that I studied under him.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: But I studied him, too. His theories on nature's cycles were...odd. He never went into much detail, but his work had some curious influences.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: But I studied him, too. His theories on nature's cycles were...odd. He never went into much detail, but his work had some curious influences.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I heard whispers through the door of his office, saw confusing diagrams that lingered in half-erased chalk dust and on torn up shreds of paper.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I heard whispers through the door of his office, saw confusing diagrams that lingered in half-erased chalk dust and on torn up shreds of paper.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Never could make much sense of it.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Never could make much sense of it.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Well, it's the same tech used in that Repulsion Machine I gave you.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Well, it's the same tech used in that Repulsion Machine I gave you.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Strictly speaking, I wouldn't call it a defense system. It doesn't interact with anything on a physical level.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Strictly speaking, I wouldn't call it a defense system. It doesn't interact with anything on a physical level.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: You see, Ironhaven's scientific communication division have long been working on projects to further their exertion over the natural world.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: You see, Ironhaven's scientific communication division have long been working on projects to further their exertion over the natural world.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: It's complicated stuff, but essentially they were trying to emit signals to communicate with...well, anything they wanted to, I suppose.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: It's complicated stuff, but essentially they were trying to emit signals to communicate with...well, anything they wanted to, I suppose.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: The tech I've been working on is along those lines, but instead of a wide spectrum of communication, it attempts to broadcast a single 'word': "[C2]FLEE[/C2]".
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: The tech I've been working on is along those lines, but instead of a wide spectrum of communication, it attempts to broadcast a single 'word': "[C2]FLEE[/C2]".

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: It emits the vocalized panic responses of every animal I was able to gather acoustic data for.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: It emits the vocalized panic responses of every animal I was able to gather acoustic data for.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I'll give you some schematics. I'm sure someone there is smart enough to decipher them and get it built.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I'll give you some schematics. I'm sure someone there is smart enough to decipher them and get it built.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Just...don't let them think this means I forgive them. Or that I approve of what they're doing.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Just...don't let them think this means I forgive them. Or that I approve of what they're doing.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Anything else about those defenses?
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Anything else about those defenses?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Yes, they worked.
rows.raw_text: Yes, they worked.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The workers on the rig want to find a way to sabotage them.
rows.raw_text: The workers on the rig want to find a way to sabotage them.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: That's all.
rows.raw_text: That's all.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Good. It's always nice to have additional data points.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Good. It's always nice to have additional data points.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Found their conscience, have they? I suppose they're wanting it to look like an accident. They wouldn't want to face the corp's wrath if they were found culpable.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Found their conscience, have they? I suppose they're wanting it to look like an accident. They wouldn't want to face the corp's wrath if they were found culpable.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: Hmm, I do have a pleasingly elegant idea, actually. We don't have to sabotage the defenses in a traditional sense.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: Hmm, I do have a pleasingly elegant idea, actually. We don't have to sabotage the defenses in a traditional sense.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: If you recall, they emit a sort of 'word'. At the moment, they're broadcasting a warning: "[C2]FLEE[/C2]".
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: If you recall, they emit a sort of 'word'. At the moment, they're broadcasting a warning: "[C2]FLEE[/C2]".

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: But we can change that. I have other recordings, of other words. Instead of a warning, it could broadcast an...invitation.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: But we can change that. I have other recordings, of other words. Instead of a warning, it could broadcast an...invitation.

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: There's one in particular. I've been referring to it by its closest human analogue:
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: There's one in particular. I've been referring to it by its closest human analogue:

rows.speaker: Researcher
rows.text: I'll prepare some blueprints for the module. You'll have to assemble it and slot it into the top of the black box.
rows.raw_text: RESEARCHER_NAME_KEY: I'll prepare some blueprints for the module. You'll have to assemble it and slot it into the top of the black box.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Still around, huh?
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Still around, huh?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A helmeted figure emerges from the shadows by a building site. He lifts his visor.
rows.raw_text: A helmeted figure emerges from the shadows by a building site. He lifts his visor.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He gestures to a pile of materials behind him.
rows.raw_text: He gestures to a pile of materials behind him.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: We're short on materials. Once they arrive, we can start working.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: We're short on materials. Once they arrive, we can start working.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Between you and me, the corp has a pretty ruthless reputation of tracking down anyone who moves against them. People tend to just make the one mistake, if you get what I mean.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Between you and me, the corp has a pretty ruthless reputation of tracking down anyone who moves against them. People tend to just make the one mistake, if you get what I mean.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A woman is stood just inside the doorway, sketching a design in her notebook.
rows.raw_text: A woman is stood just inside the doorway, sketching a design in her notebook.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Welcome back. Hope things have been steady for you out there.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Welcome back. Hope things have been steady for you out there.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Those enhanced rods are treating you well? I worked hard on those designs.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Those enhanced rods are treating you well? I worked hard on those designs.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We don't fully understand the properties of all the materials we're working with, but it's something the head Scientist is working on.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We don't fully understand the properties of all the materials we're working with, but it's something the head Scientist is working on.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Remember that the things we build here all need different ingredients. It's good to keep a stock of various materials on hand.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Remember that the things we build here all need different ingredients. It's good to keep a stock of various materials on hand.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Most of these projects I'm working on are for the rollout of the corp's new fleet. It'll be cutting edge.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Most of these projects I'm working on are for the rollout of the corp's new fleet. It'll be cutting edge.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We're still waiting for a [C0]materials[/C0] shipment before we can [C1]upgrade the factory[/C1]. When it arrives, we'll be able to [C1]make new items[/C1].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We're still waiting for a [C0]materials[/C0] shipment before we can [C1]upgrade the factory[/C1]. When it arrives, we'll be able to [C1]make new items[/C1].

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: HQ said they're not sending any more delivery ships, so if we want to get this place [C1]upgraded[/C1], we'll need [C0]materials[/C0] from elsewhere.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: HQ said they're not sending any more delivery ships, so if we want to get this place [C1]upgraded[/C1], we'll need [C0]materials[/C0] from elsewhere.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Almost there. One more delivery of [C0]materials[/C0] and we'll be [C1]fully operational[/C1].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Almost there. One more delivery of [C0]materials[/C0] and we'll be [C1]fully operational[/C1].

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Don't like these waters. But the corp seems to.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Don't like these waters. But the corp seems to.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Some advice, while you're on corp property: don't go poking around.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Some advice, while you're on corp property: don't go poking around.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: The work's hard, but as long as the pay's good, I'll do it. And it is.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: The work's hard, but as long as the pay's good, I'll do it. And it is.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Not much for small talk. Let's get on with it.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Not much for small talk. Let's get on with it.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Heat and metal. Beats the cold winds out here.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Heat and metal. Beats the cold winds out here.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Don't have the materials for this place yet.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Don't have the materials for this place yet.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: I have plans for an interchangeable module system. You'll see; I'll show you when we're set up here. But, uh...
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: I have plans for an interchangeable module system. You'll see; I'll show you when we're set up here. But, uh...

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: These modules can be attached to your ship. Placement's flexible too, they can be wired up to wherever they need to go.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: These modules can be attached to your ship. Placement's flexible too, they can be wired up to wherever they need to go.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: One more lot of [C0]materials[/C0], then we'll be able to [C1]upgrade some of your boat's basic functions[/C1].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: One more lot of [C0]materials[/C0], then we'll be able to [C1]upgrade some of your boat's basic functions[/C1].

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Can you believe the size of that squid? It's shaking the whole damn rig. Doesn't seem like it should be possible; the legs are anchored pretty deep.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Can you believe the size of that squid? It's shaking the whole damn rig. Doesn't seem like it should be possible; the legs are anchored pretty deep.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We're in the planning stages for an [C1]expansion to the Factory[/C1]. Maybe you'd be able to help out?
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We're in the planning stages for an [C1]expansion to the Factory[/C1]. Maybe you'd be able to help out?

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: I've been drawing up some plans for a [C1]new Factory wing[/C1]. Take a look if you get a chance.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: I've been drawing up some plans for a [C1]new Factory wing[/C1]. Take a look if you get a chance.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: We're about ready to start construction on the [C1]final section of the Factory[/C1].
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: We're about ready to start construction on the [C1]final section of the Factory[/C1].

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: Those tentacles seem angry. Not surprised.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: Those tentacles seem angry. Not surprised.

rows.speaker: Founder
rows.text: [C1]Foundry's about to get bigger soon[/C1]. Still waiting on a delivery though.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_NAME_KEY: [C1]Foundry's about to get bigger soon[/C1]. Still waiting on a delivery though.

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: That squid thing keeps shaking the rig. It's making it pretty damn hard to concentrate in here!
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: That squid thing keeps shaking the rig. It's making it pretty damn hard to concentrate in here!

rows.speaker: Engineer
rows.text: Foreman says we're due to start on an [C1]extension[/C1] to the building soon.
rows.raw_text: ENGINEER_NAME_KEY: Foreman says we're due to start on an [C1]extension[/C1] to the building soon.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Don't forget. The rig still needs some kind of defense system constructed. The people here are...depending on you, oddly enough.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Don't forget. The rig still needs some kind of defense system constructed. The people here are...depending on you, oddly enough.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: And...while you're there, try to [C0]catch some of the local specimens[/C0]. I think they hold the key to understanding what we're here for.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: And...while you're there, try to [C0]catch some of the local specimens[/C0]. I think they hold the key to understanding what we're here for.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The defenses are operational, emitting a droning sound that grates at the ears.
rows.raw_text: The defenses are operational, emitting a droning sound that grates at the ears.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We've gotta get this place operational, or the boss will have my head!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We've gotta get this place operational, or the boss will have my head!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: We can make [C1]improvements to your vessel here[/C1], including some cutting-edge Ironhaven tech that you [C0]won't find anywhere else[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: We can make [C1]improvements to your vessel here[/C1], including some cutting-edge Ironhaven tech that you [C0]won't find anywhere else[/C0].

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Outside, the Foreman is in conversation with a recent arrival to the rig; a stern looking man in a suit.
rows.raw_text: Outside, the Foreman is in conversation with a recent arrival to the rig; a stern looking man in a suit.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Outside, the Executive is talking to the Foreman.
rows.raw_text: Outside, the Executive is talking to the Foreman.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: After that, I don't want to see you around here any more. Our operation is confidential.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: After that, I don't want to see you around here any more. Our operation is confidential.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Now we can finally get this drill started! [S2]ALL CLEAR![/S2]
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Now we can finally get this drill started! [S2]ALL CLEAR![/S2]

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's the purpose of this rig?
rows.raw_text: What's the purpose of this rig?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Aren't you going to stop the drill?
rows.raw_text: Aren't you going to stop the drill?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know anything about these mutated fish I've been finding?
rows.raw_text: Do you know anything about these mutated fish I've been finding?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's going to happen to the fissure that opened up?
rows.raw_text: What's going to happen to the fissure that opened up?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Do you know anything more about the prehistoric fish I found?
rows.raw_text: Do you know anything more about the prehistoric fish I found?

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: I've encountered strange creatures in the contaminated areas.
rows.raw_text: I've encountered strange creatures in the contaminated areas.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What's your opinion of your boss?
rows.raw_text: What's your opinion of your boss?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have you learned anything about the Dark Fluid I collected?
rows.raw_text: Have you learned anything about the Dark Fluid I collected?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: You seem concerned.
rows.raw_text: You seem concerned.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Are you okay?
rows.raw_text: Are you okay?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Our current executive's father hired me when I was fresh out of college. He must've seen something in me, all those years ago.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Our current executive's father hired me when I was fresh out of college. He must've seen something in me, all those years ago.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: If my hypothesis proves correct, it'll yield a significant asset for the corporation's business diversification strategy.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: If my hypothesis proves correct, it'll yield a significant asset for the corporation's business diversification strategy.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Ah, yes, I believe the drill has already stopped operating. The Foreman should be making preparations to withdraw it from the seabed.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Ah, yes, I believe the drill has already stopped operating. The Foreman should be making preparations to withdraw it from the seabed.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: It's not something you can just yank out, apparently. The drill team will take their time to try to ensure minimal disturbance.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: It's not something you can just yank out, apparently. The drill team will take their time to try to ensure minimal disturbance.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Mutations are present in almost all species, and fish are certainly no exception. In my years of study I've seen fish with extra fins, eyes, and even heads!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Mutations are present in almost all species, and fish are certainly no exception. In my years of study I've seen fish with extra fins, eyes, and even heads!

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Yes, they're a relatively normal part of the development of a species. Occasionally they can be influenced by external factors, but only in exceptional circumstances.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Yes, they're a relatively normal part of the development of a species. Occasionally they can be influenced by external factors, but only in exceptional circumstances.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Now that the drill has withdrawn, it should settle down - provided nothing else disturbs the seabed. I expect that, given enough time, it will be filled in with sediment entirely.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Now that the drill has withdrawn, it should settle down - provided nothing else disturbs the seabed. I expect that, given enough time, it will be filled in with sediment entirely.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: In the meantime, it appears to have opened up some interesting opportunities for research!
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: In the meantime, it appears to have opened up some interesting opportunities for research!

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Nothing useful, aside from confirming with some peers that they are indeed species that were previously thought to be extinct.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Nothing useful, aside from confirming with some peers that they are indeed species that were previously thought to be extinct.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: There's even a special name for that, you know. A Lazarus taxon - a species seemingly raised from the dead.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: There's even a special name for that, you know. A Lazarus taxon - a species seemingly raised from the dead.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Oh? What did they look like?
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Oh? What did they look like?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: You begin to describe the creatures to the Scientist, but as you grasp at the images in your head, they melt away, replaced with a swirling blackness in your mind's eye.
rows.raw_text: You begin to describe the creatures to the Scientist, but as you grasp at the images in your head, they melt away, replaced with a swirling blackness in your mind's eye.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: After your description trails off, the Scientist looks at you with some concern.
rows.raw_text: After your description trails off, the Scientist looks at you with some concern.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Long nights at sea, unusual weather conditions, sleep deprivation - they can all lead to auditory and visual hallucinations. Not to worry, best to get some rest.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Long nights at sea, unusual weather conditions, sleep deprivation - they can all lead to auditory and visual hallucinations. Not to worry, best to get some rest.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: My...master? Oh, the Executive, yes. It's...he's...everywhere. Very hard working. Always has been. Always will be...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: My...master? Oh, the Executive, yes. It's...he's...everywhere. Very hard working. Always has been. Always will be...

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: He needs me...my work. It all has to be correct. Do you understand? We have to be in the right place. Or else...there's not much time left.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: He needs me...my work. It all has to be correct. Do you understand? We have to be in the right place. Or else...there's not much time left.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: It's...unlike any substance I've ever seen...touched. It's smooth one moment...silky...and the next...sharp...stabbing.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: It's...unlike any substance I've ever seen...touched. It's smooth one moment...silky...and the next...sharp...stabbing.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Scientist flinches at something in the air above him. A moment later, the lights flicker. The subtle pop of a blown capacitor can be heard somewhere on the nearby bench.
rows.raw_text: The Scientist flinches at something in the air above him. A moment later, the lights flicker. The subtle pop of a blown capacitor can be heard somewhere on the nearby bench.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: His voice drops to a breathy murmur.
rows.raw_text: His voice drops to a breathy murmur.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: It holds...secrets...instructions...whispers...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: It holds...secrets...instructions...whispers...

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Concerned...no. Concern implies...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Concerned...no. Concern implies...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He turns to look at you. One of his eyes is bloodshot, the white completely overrun with dark red blood.
rows.raw_text: He turns to look at you. One of his eyes is bloodshot, the white completely overrun with dark red blood.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Concern implies...that we didn't know this would happen.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Concern implies...that we didn't know this would happen.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: The inevitable...conclusion...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: The inevitable...conclusion...

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: He rocks back and forth, hand shading his eyes from the harsh lights above.
rows.raw_text: He rocks back and forth, hand shading his eyes from the harsh lights above.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Our work...almost complete...
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Our work...almost complete...

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: Is whatever you're here for really worth risking the lives of your people?
rows.raw_text: Is whatever you're here for really worth risking the lives of your people?

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: He scoffs.
rows.raw_text: He scoffs.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: Honestly, even if I cared to know myself, I'm not sure why you think I'd tell you.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: Honestly, even if I cared to know myself, I'm not sure why you think I'd tell you.

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: The Executive makes a show of looking around and peering over a nearby railing.
rows.raw_text: The Executive makes a show of looking around and peering over a nearby railing.

rows.speaker: Executive
rows.text: My "people"? These are employees.
rows.raw_text: EXECUTIVE_NAME_KEY: My "people"? These are employees.

rows.speaker: Unattributed
rows.attribution_basis: no speaker tag; cannot safely infer
rows.text: Have there been any patches of contamination sighted in the area?
rows.raw_text: Have there been any patches of contamination sighted in the area?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]The Marrows[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]The Marrows[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Gale Cliffs[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Stellar Basin[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Twisted Strand[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0].
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: There have been areas of [C3]contamination[/C3] sighted in [C0]Devil's Spine[/C0].

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: This hull schematic will add a little [C1]more storage[/C1] to your vessel, but the primary benefit is all the [C1]new slots for fishing equipment[/C1]!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: This hull schematic will add a little [C1]more storage[/C1] to your vessel, but the primary benefit is all the [C1]new slots for fishing equipment[/C1]!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Hope she serves you well, fisherman!
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Hope she serves you well, fisherman!

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Hey, fisherman - thanks again for your help filling that generator. I've reported our new operational status to HQ.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Hey, fisherman - thanks again for your help filling that generator. I've reported our new operational status to HQ.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: In fact, they've given me a budget to [C1]compensate you for any additional biomass[/C1] you bring in. Just see me at the [C0]Generator[/C0] and I'll pay you.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: In fact, they've given me a budget to [C1]compensate you for any additional biomass[/C1] you bring in. Just see me at the [C0]Generator[/C0] and I'll pay you.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: I can now [C1]pay you for any biomass you add to the generator[/C1]. The bigger the better, I assume? This isn't really my area...
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: I can now [C1]pay you for any biomass you add to the generator[/C1]. The bigger the better, I assume? This isn't really my area...

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Generator's always hungry. Any biomass to throw in?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Generator's always hungry. Any biomass to throw in?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: Energy levels are good, but I won't say no to a top-up. Add some fish if you've got 'em.
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: Energy levels are good, but I won't say no to a top-up. Add some fish if you've got 'em.

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: This BioFuel system is great! More places oughta run on fish. And crabs too, I guess. Got any for the hopper today?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: This BioFuel system is great! More places oughta run on fish. And crabs too, I guess. Got any for the hopper today?

rows.speaker: Foreman
rows.text: [C2]I can't pay a premium for your fish[/C2] here, but it's better than nothing, right?
rows.raw_text: FOREMAN_NAME_KEY: [C2]I can't pay a premium for your fish[/C2] here, but it's better than nothing, right?

rows.speaker: Narrator / scene text
rows.text: A figure emerges from lower decks and beckons you over into the shadows.
rows.raw_text: A figure emerges from lower decks and beckons you over into the shadows.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: If you're going to be hanging around...maybe we can do business. Come see me at the [C0]Undermarket[/C0] - alone.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: If you're going to be hanging around...maybe we can do business. Come see me at the [C0]Undermarket[/C0] - alone.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: Got some [C0]items you might be interested in[/C0]. Don't ask where they come from - better off not knowing. Can make some [C0]basic repairs[/C0] too, but it'll cost ya.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: Got some [C0]items you might be interested in[/C0]. Don't ask where they come from - better off not knowing. Can make some [C0]basic repairs[/C0] too, but it'll cost ya.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: Don't tell anyone from the corp about this place. I'm doing you a favour, you know.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: Don't tell anyone from the corp about this place. I'm doing you a favour, you know.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: Nobody ever does a thorough stocktake at big corporations. Lucky for us.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: Nobody ever does a thorough stocktake at big corporations. Lucky for us.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: Things go missing all the time. Who knows where they end up? Doesn't matter in a place like this.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: Things go missing all the time. Who knows where they end up? Doesn't matter in a place like this.

rows.speaker: Founder (Undermarket)
rows.text: The bigwigs don't bother with the lower decks and the folks down here. Why would they mingle with people like us? I'm not complaining.
rows.raw_text: FOUNDER_MARKET_NAME_KEY: The bigwigs don't bother with the lower decks and the folks down here. Why would they mingle with people like us? I'm not complaining.

rows.speaker: Player (choice)
rows.attribution_basis: first-person, question or response text without NPC label
rows.text: What was I supposed to be doing?
rows.raw_text: What was I supposed to be doing?

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: Locals in The Marrows and Gale Cliffs have reported sightings of a [C3]strange ooze[/C3] on the surface of the water. I need you to collect a canister of it for me.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: Locals in The Marrows and Gale Cliffs have reported sightings of a [C3]strange ooze[/C3] on the surface of the water. I need you to collect a canister of it for me.

rows.speaker: Scientist
rows.text: You'll need to upgrade the [C0]Factory[/C0] and construct a [C0]Siphon Trawler[/C0] before you'll be able to do that, though.
rows.raw_text: SCIENTIST_NAME_KEY: You'll need to upgrade the [C0]Factory[/C0] and construct a [C0]Siphon Trawler[/C0] before you'll be able to do that, though.

rows.speaker: Scientist
